默认工况：F = 0.29 N、m = 0.360 kg、a = 0.81 m/: Default conditions: F = 0.29 N, m = 0.360 kg, a = 0.81 m/s²; a wooden block raises the ticker timer end (angle tag reads “raised 1.15°”); the 4 tape spacings are 44.03 / 52.08 / 60.14 / 68.19 mm.
本实验用槽码的重力当拉力（教材 p.88「小车所受的拉力可认为与槽码所受的重力相: This experiment uses the weight of the slotted masses as the pulling force (textbook p.88: “the pull on the cart can be taken as equal to the weight of the slotted masses”), the paper tape to find acceleration (p.89 Method 2), and a balance to weigh mass (p.89); the setup is reference case 1 in Fig. 4.2-2.
器材认得出：长木板一端垫高、滑轮在低的那一端、打点计时器在高的那一端、纸带从小车: Recognize the setup: one end of the long board raised, pulley at the low end, ticker timer at the high end, paper tape running from the back of the cart through the guide hole.
三个量各有各的测法：质量用天平、拉力用槽码重力、加速度用纸带。: Each of the three quantities has its own method: mass with the balance, pulling force from the weight of the slotted masses, acceleration from the tape.
教材 p.89 旁注问「用测力计手拉行不行」——不行：手保证不了大小和方向恒定，: A side note on textbook p.89 asks “Could you pull with a spring scale by hand?” No: a hand can't keep the size and direction constant, and it's hard to keep it parallel to the board.

① 未平衡（m = 0.360 kg，槽码 1→5 个）：a = 0.19 /: ① Not balanced (m = 0.360 kg, slotted masses 1→5): a = 0.19 / 0.33 / 0.47 / 0.61 / 0.75 m/s²; the line misses the origin, crossing the a-axis at −0.196 m/s² and the F-axis at +0.0706 N. ② Raised too far: a = 0.58 / 0.72 / 0.86 / 1.00 / 1.14, crossing the a-axis at +0.196 and the F-axis at −0.0706 (signs reversed). ③ Switch to real equipment: a = 0.38 / 0.50 / 0.62 / 0.74 / 0.86, 3.8 %~8.8 % below F/m, the top of the line bends down; k_F = 2.569 → m_meas = 0.389 kg, 8.1 % above the balance's 0.360 kg.
截距的符号就能判状态：与 F 轴交于正半轴 = 摩擦没抵消（没平衡好）；与 a: The sign of the intercept tells you the state: crossing the positive F-axis = friction not cancelled (not balanced); crossing the positive a-axis = raised too far. When the slotted masses aren't “much lighter than the cart,” the assumption F = m_h·g itself fails (textbook p.88 side note: “provided the slotted masses are much lighter than the cart”), showing up as a line that bends at the top and a mass from the slope that's too high.
facts A2.16, A7.2, A7.5; B2.1 items 12, 13; B1.5; standard values tables E, G

facts A2.6、A7.5；B2.1 第 10 条、B3 第 6 条；标准值: facts A2.6, A7.5; B2.1 item 10, B3 item 6; standard values table G

氨的制备与性质（含喷泉实验）: Preparation and Properties of Ammonia (Fountain Experiment)
一瓶氨气，凭什么能把烧杯里的水自己「吸」到瓶子里去？: How can a flask of ammonia gas “suck” the water from a beaker up into the flask all by itself?
铵盐与强碱共热，管口略向下、用碱石灰干燥: Heat an ammonium salt with a strong base, tube mouth tilted slightly down, dry with soda lime
氨比空气轻 → 瓶口向下收集，收得越久越纯: Ammonia is lighter than air → collect with the mouth down; the longer, the purer
氨极易溶于水: Ammonia is extremely soluble in water
1 体积水溶约 700 体积氨 → 瓶内压强骤降: 1 volume of water dissolves about 700 volumes of ammonia → pressure in the flask drops sharply
大气压压水上来: Air pressure pushes the water up
内外差 94.5 kPa 把水压进烧瓶 → 酚酞红色喷泉: A 94.5 kPa inside-outside difference pushes water into the flask → red phenolphthalein fountain
一条气路 + 一瓶氨 + 一场喷泉: One gas line + one flask of ammonia + one fountain
整体 · 造氨、收氨、检验，最后用它做喷泉: Overview · make, collect and test ammonia, then use it for a fountain

喷泉是红色的：水里预先滴了酚酞，而氨水显弱碱性。: The fountain is red: phenolphthalein was added to the water beforehand, and aqueous ammonia is weakly basic.

Once water enters the flask, almost all the gas dissolves, flask pressure drops far below atmospheric, and air pressure pushes water from the beaker up through the glass tube into the flask, forming a fountain; aqueous ammonia is weakly basic, so phenolphthalein turns red.

视窗里 40 个淡蓝色氨分子，水一渗进来就成批进入液面、最后只剩 2 个，液面上: The window shows 40 light-blue ammonia molecules; as water seeps in they enter the liquid in batches until only 2 remain, 12 blue OH⁻ dots appear at the surface and the color turns pink; the number of gas molecules in the flask falls from a full flask to almost none. 变的是气体分子数（分子跑进水里了），不是「瓶里的空气被抽走了」。: What changes is the number of gas molecules (they went into the water), not “the air in the flask was pumped out”.
OH⁻ 是「氨水显碱性」的直接原因，酚酞变红就是它在起作用。: OH⁻ is the direct reason aqueous ammonia is basic; it's what turns phenolphthalein red.
水进去的体积约等于氨原来占的体积，所以最后水面几乎顶到瓶颈。: The volume of water that enters roughly equals the volume the ammonia took up, so the water ends up almost at the neck.

(Textbook [Experiment 5-6] asks you to “analyze possible reasons for these observations”; this explanation is the answer.)

全厂五个工段：上料 → 高炉本体 → 热风 → 渣铁 → 煤气净化，料和气在本体: Five process stages plant-wide: charging → furnace body → hot blast → slag & iron → gas cleaning; burden and gas run against each other in the body.

逆流是关键：煤气一路往上被消耗、被换热，才形成上部低温、下部高温的温度梯度。: Countercurrent flow is key: the gas is consumed and exchanges heat all the way up, creating a gradient that is cooler at the top and hotter at the bottom.
去掉上料与逆流：炉料不动、煤气没有通道，整座炉立刻停。: Remove charging and countercurrent flow: the burden stops, the gas has no path, and the whole furnace shuts down immediately.

焦炭要强度高、块度合适、硫磷灰分低，否则被压碎就堵死料柱。: Coke must be strong, well sized, and low in sulfur, phosphorus and ash; if it gets crushed, it chokes the burden column.
石灰石随矿批加进去，进炉后才分解成 CaO——在上料阶段它还不干活。: Limestone goes in with the ore charge and only decomposes into CaO inside the furnace; at the charging stage it isn't doing anything yet.
去掉分层布料：料柱堵死、煤气穿不动，只能休风。: Without layered charging: the burden column chokes, gas can't get through, and the blast has to be stopped.
常考「焦炭为什么要强度高、块度合适」：它同时是骨架，碎料会把透气通道堵死。: Common exam point “why coke must be strong and well sized”: it is also the skeleton, and crushed pieces block the gas channels.
分层不是为了好看：焦炭层是料柱的骨架兼透气窗，矿层夹在中间被上升的煤气一层层还原: Layering isn't for looks: the coke layers are the column's skeleton and gas windows, while the ore layers in between are reduced layer by layer by the rising gas. Mix them into one heap and the gas can't get through.

软熔带（约 1100–1400 ℃）是炉料软化到熔化、初渣形成的区间，它的位置决: The cohesive zone (about 1100–1400 ℃) is where the burden softens and melts and primary slag forms; its position decides how permeable the column is. Limestone first decomposes into CaO above it, at 800–1000 ℃.

去掉「看进去」：学生只背得出「高温还原」，不知道温度是连续变的。: Without “looking inside”, students can only recite “high-temperature reduction” and don't know the temperature changes continuously.
常考「高炉内温度为什么从上到下升高」：逆流换热 + 风口燃烧供热，不是一炉子均匀: Common exam point “why furnace temperature rises from top to bottom”: countercurrent heat exchange + combustion heat at the tuyeres, not a uniformly hot furnace.

这两步合起来，碳过量时的总结果相当于 2C + O₂ → 2CO——但不要因此把: Together, with excess carbon, the net result equals 2C + O₂ → 2CO, but that doesn't make the textbook's C + O₂ → CO₂ wrong.
教材原文还写明：C + CO₂ ⇌ 2CO 是一个可逆反应，并且自下而上发生在有: The textbook also states that C + CO₂ ⇌ 2CO is reversible and happens from the bottom up wherever there is coke. That's why top gas always contains unused CO (next section, “The Top-Gas Puzzle”).
去掉这一步：没有 CO、没有热源，还原与熔化都不发生。: Without this step: no CO and no heat source, so neither reduction nor melting happens.

CO 不是一步烧出来的：焦炭先在风口烧成 CO₂（放热），CO₂ 上升穿过炽热焦: CO isn't made in one burn: coke first burns to CO₂ at the tuyeres (exothermic), then CO₂ rises through the glowing coke and is reduced to CO (endothermic, reversible). The tuyeres are the furnace's only heat source and the origin of its CO.

常考「C + CO₂ ⇌ 2CO 是吸热还是放热、升温往哪移」：吸热，升温向生成: Common exam point “is C + CO₂ ⇌ 2CO endo- or exothermic, and which way does heating shift it”: endothermic; heating shifts it toward CO.

渣浮在铁水上、从渣口排；铁水从位置更低的铁口出——方向别弄反。: Slag floats on the molten iron and leaves through the slag notch; molten iron leaves through the lower taphole. Don't mix up the directions.
去掉石灰石：渣排不出去、硫进铁，铁水又脏又脆。: Without limestone: slag can't be drained, sulfur gets into the iron, and the iron is dirty and brittle.
常考「加石灰石的作用」：不是提供 CO₂，是分解出 CaO 造渣除 SiO₂。: Common exam point “purpose of adding limestone”: not to supply CO₂, but to decompose into CaO, which forms slag and removes SiO₂.
CaCO₃ 先分解出 CaO（吸热），CaO 再拉走 SiO₂ 变成 CaSiO: CaCO₃ first decomposes into CaO (endothermic), then CaO pulls out SiO₂ as liquid CaSiO₃ slag floating on the iron. Thin slag means clean iron; skipping limestone saves coke but leaves the impurities in.
把风温调高一点，真的能省下焦炭吗？: Does raising the blast temperature a bit really save coke?
把热风温度从 1200 拖到 1100 ℃，看焦比和产量: Drag the hot-blast temperature from 1200 to 1100 ℃ and watch coke rate and output
风温 1200 → 1100 ℃：焦比 350 → 370 kg/t（+20）、: Blast temp 1200 → 1100 ℃: coke rate 350 → 370 kg/t (+20), hot metal 10000 → 9459 t/d, CO utilization 50.0 % → 48.0 %, slag still 330 kg/t.
课件设定：风温系数 0.20 kg/(t·℃)，即每降 100 ℃ 焦比约多 2: Lesson setting: blast-temperature coefficient 0.20 kg/(t·℃), i.e. about 20 kg/t more coke per 100 ℃ drop
风温经「带进显热」直接替换烧掉的焦炭，是本课最便宜的一招。: Blast temperature directly replaces burned coke by “bringing in sensible heat”: the cheapest trick in this lesson.
焦比降了，单位时间的出铁量也跟着升（本课按 产量 ∝ 1/焦比 建模，属课件设定: When the coke rate falls, iron output per unit time rises too (this lesson models output ∝ 1/coke rate; a lesson setting, not a textbook law).
风温不是越高越好：越 1300 ℃ 风口与围管烧穿，低于 950 ℃ 炉缸热量不: Hotter isn't always better: above 1300 ℃ the tuyeres and bustle pipe burn through; below 950 ℃ the hearth runs short of heat and goes cold.
去掉这一步：学生会以为「多烧焦炭就行」，看不到风温这条免费的账。: Without this step, students think “just burn more coke” and miss the free savings from blast temperature.
常考「提高风温为什么能降焦比」：风口带入显热替代了焦炭燃烧供热；但受热风炉与风口: Common exam point “why raising blast temperature lowers the coke rate”: sensible heat brought in at the tuyeres replaces heat from burning coke; but it's limited by stove and tuyere life.
风温每降 100 ℃，焦比大约多 20 kg/t、产量跟着掉——反过来说提高风温: Every 100 ℃ drop in blast temperature adds about 20 kg/t of coke and output falls. Conversely, raising blast temperature is the most direct way to save coke; the cost is what the stove checker bricks and tuyeres can withstand (industrial band 1100–1250 ℃).
焦比、碱度、产量同时卡住时，你先动哪一个？: With coke rate, basicity and output all constrained, which do you move first?

焦比 ≤ 360 kg/t 把风温压到 ≥ 1150 ℃ 左右，产量缺口靠富氧补: Coke rate ≤ 360 kg/t forces blast temperature up to about ≥ 1150 ℃; the output gap is made up with oxygen enrichment.
碱度窗口把石灰石锁在 150–210 kg/t，取多了渣量大、焦比反升。: The basicity window locks limestone at 150–210 kg/t; too much means more slag and a higher coke rate.
风温 < 950 ℃ 走「3 s 倒计时 → 炉凉冻结」，> 1300 ℃ 走「: Blast temperature < 950 ℃ leads to “3 s countdown → furnace chills and freezes”; > 1300 ℃ leads to “tuyere burn-through”. Understand both incident chains.
去掉考核：学生只会背「提高风温降低焦比」，不会在多约束里取舍。: Without the test, students only memorize “raise blast temperature to lower coke rate” and can't make trade-offs under several constraints.
常考「为什么不取最低焦比点」：风温受设备上限约束，焦比压到极限要靠富氧与炉料质量: Common exam point “why not take the lowest coke-rate point”: blast temperature is capped by equipment, pushing coke rate to the limit needs oxygen enrichment and better burden, so industry uses a compromise band of 1100–1250 ℃.
焦比 ≤ 360 kg/t 把风温压到 ≥ 1150 ℃ 左右，碱度窗口把石灰石: Coke rate ≤ 360 kg/t forces blast temperature to about ≥ 1150 ℃, the basicity window locks limestone at 150–210 kg/t, and output still needs oxygen enrichment. What's feasible is the small patch of 1150–1250 ℃; the compromise is calculated.

A. 为了省焦，把热风温度一路往下调: A. To save coke, keep turning the hot-blast temperature down

本课目标：搞清风口怎么造 CO、铁氧化物怎么逐级还原、石灰石为什么要加，最后在焦: Lesson goal: understand how the tuyeres make CO, how iron oxides are reduced step by step and why limestone is added, then keep the furnace stable within the coke-rate and basicity window for 15 seconds.
按教材口径，高炉里的 CO 是怎么来的: According to the textbook, where does the CO in a blast furnace come from
焦炭在风口一步烧成 CO: Coke burns to CO in one step at the tuyeres
焦炭先在风口燃烧生成 CO₂（放热），CO₂ 再被焦炭还原成 CO（吸热、可逆）: Coke first burns at the tuyeres to CO₂ (exothermic), then CO₂ is reduced to CO by coke (endothermic, reversible)
由铁矿石与水蒸气反应产生: From iron ore reacting with steam
人教必修2 p.48 的原句是：C(焦炭) + O₂(空气) = CO₂（放出热: PEP Required Vol. 2 p.48 says: C(coke) + O₂(air) = CO₂ (releases heat), C(coke) + CO₂ = 2CO (absorbs heat), and notes that C + CO₂ ⇌ 2CO is reversible and occurs from the bottom up wherever there is coke. With excess carbon the net result equals 2C + O₂ → 2CO, but that is just the sum of the two steps.
高炉里铁的还原剂主要是: The main reducing agent for iron in a blast furnace is
焦炭先在风口与高温区变成 CO，由 CO 去逐级夺氧：Fe₂O₃ → Fe₃O₄: Coke first becomes CO at the tuyeres and hot zone, and CO strips oxygen step by step: Fe₂O₃ → Fe₃O₄ → FeO → Fe. Coke's direct roles are supplying heat, supplying the reducing agent and acting as the skeleton.
加石灰石的作用是: The purpose of adding limestone is
分解出 CaO，与 SiO₂ 成渣把杂质带走: To decompose into CaO, which forms slag with SiO₂ and carries off impurities
增加铁水含碳量: To raise the carbon content of the iron
CaCO₃ 先分解成 CaO（吸热），CaO 再与酸性杂质 SiO₂ 生成 Ca: CaCO₃ first decomposes into CaO (endothermic), then CaO reacts with the acidic impurity SiO₂ to form liquid CaSiO₃ slag, which floats on the iron and leaves through the slag notch.
把石灰石整条旁路以后，炉渣碱度: With limestone fully bypassed, slag basicity
矿石脉石与焦炭灰分本身带来约 30 kg/t 的 CaO，所以碱度不会到 0，而: Ore gangue and coke ash bring about 30 kg/t of CaO themselves, so basicity doesn't reach 0 but drops to 0.279: the slag isn't basic enough, thickens, and can't remove sulfur.
铁氧化物逐级还原的正确顺序是: The correct order of stepwise reduction of iron oxides is
按含氧量从高到低：Fe₂O₃（200–700 ℃）→ Fe₃O₄（约 850 ℃: From highest to lowest oxygen content: Fe₂O₃ (200–700 ℃) → Fe₃O₄ (about 850 ℃) → FeO (completed at about 1200 ℃) → Fe.
提高热风温度能降焦比，原因是: Raising the hot-blast temperature lowers the coke rate because
风温让矿石更容易熔化: Hot blast makes the ore melt more easily
风口带入的显热替代了焦炭燃烧供热: Sensible heat brought in at the tuyeres replaces heat from burning coke
风温提高了 CO 利用率却没代价: Hot blast raises CO utilization at no cost
风温增加了煤气量: Hot blast increases the gas volume
单位铁需要的热量由「焦炭燃烧 + 热风显热」共同提供；风温越高，显热带进来的越多: The heat needed per unit of iron comes from “coke combustion + hot-blast sensible heat”; the hotter the blast, the more sensible heat comes in, and the less coke has to burn. The cost is what the stoves and tuyeres can withstand.
炉料要分层交替加入，主要是因为: The burden is charged in alternating layers mainly because
焦炭层的骨架保证料柱透气，煤气才穿得上去: The coke-layer skeleton keeps the column permeable so gas can rise through
让炉料熔化更快: It makes the burden melt faster
避免石灰石提前分解: It stops limestone from decomposing early
煤气要从下往上穿过整根料柱；焦炭层是透气窗与骨架。混成一堆或焦炭被压碎，料柱就堵: Gas must pass up through the whole burden column; coke layers are its gas windows and skeleton. Mixed into one heap, or with crushed coke, the column chokes and the blast has to be stopped.
为什么工业高炉把风温控制在 1100–1250 ℃，而不是一路拉高: Why do industrial blast furnaces keep blast temperature at 1100–1250 ℃ instead of pushing it ever higher
风温越高焦比越高: Higher blast temperature means a higher coke rate
热风炉格子砖与风口寿命给出了上限，越 1300 ℃ 会烧风口: Stove checker-brick and tuyere life set an upper limit; above 1300 ℃ tuyeres burn
风温与焦比无关: Blast temperature has nothing to do with coke rate
在设备能力范围内，风温越高焦比越低；但超过热风炉与风口的承受温度就会烧穿风口。所: Within equipment capacity, higher blast temperature means a lower coke rate, but beyond what the stoves and tuyeres can withstand, tuyeres burn through. So it's a compromise band set by equipment limits, not a calculated optimum.

海水提溴：空气吹出法: Bromine from Seawater: The Air Blow-Out Process
必修第二册 · 第八章第一节 · 海水资源的开发利用: Required Vol. 2 · Ch. 8, Sec. 1 · Developing and Using Seawater Resources
海水里的溴只有 65 mg/L，怎么把它变成一瓶液溴？: Seawater holds only 65 mg/L of bromine. How do we turn it into a bottle of liquid bromine?
酸化到 pH 3.5，抑制歧化: Acidify to pH 3.5 to suppress disproportionation
再氯化 + 蒸馏得液溴: Re-chlorinate + distill to get liquid bromine
加 H₂SO₄ 把海水调到 pH 3.5: Add H₂SO₄ to bring seawater to pH 3.5
通入 Cl₂ 把 Br⁻ 氧化成 Br₂: Feed Cl₂ to oxidize Br⁻ to Br₂
80 ℃、气水比 300:1 逆流吹出 Br₂: Counterflow blow-out of Br₂ at 80 ℃, air-to-water ratio 300:1
SO₂ 水溶液吸收富集，浓缩 255 倍: Absorbed and enriched in SO₂ solution, concentrated 255×
二次氯化 + 蒸馏得液溴: Second chlorination + distillation to get liquid bromine
酸化不足：Br₂ 与 Cl₂ 都会歧化，吹出率腰斩: Under-acidified: Br₂ and Cl₂ both disproportionate, and blow-out yield is cut in half
Br⁻（−1）→ Br₂（0）：Cl₂ 是氧化剂: Br⁻ (−1) → Br₂ (0): Cl₂ is the oxidizing agent
Br₂ 沸点 58.8 ℃：蒸馏分离: Br₂ boils at 58.8 ℃: separated by distillation
海水里溴只有 65 mg/L，为什么不能直接把它蒸出来？: Seawater has only 65 mg/L of bromine. Why can't we just evaporate it out directly?
拖动视角，把五个工段看一圈: Drag to rotate the view and look around all five process stages
参考工况在跑：溴回收率 84.2 %、液溴 54.7 kg/h: Reference conditions running: bromine recovery 84.2 %, liquid bromine 54.7 kg/h
溴太稀（65 mg/L），直接蒸发整片海水不现实；工业用「氧化—吹出—吸收」先把: Bromine is too dilute (65 mg/L) to evaporate a whole sea of water; industry uses “oxidation, blow-out, absorption” to first enrich bromine 255×, then chlorinates and distills.
海水里 Br⁻ 只有 65 mg/L，1 m³ 海水里只有 65 g 溴。: Seawater has only 65 mg/L of Br⁻, just 65 g of bromine per 1 m³.
全流程两次氯化、一次吸收：溴的价态走 −1 → 0 → −1 → 0。: The whole process has two chlorinations and one absorption: bromine's oxidation state goes −1 → 0 → −1 → 0.
富集发生在吸收工段（浓缩 255 倍），不靠蒸馏。: Enrichment happens in the absorption stage (255× concentration), not in distillation.
去掉富集这一步：1 L 液溴要从 57 m³ 海水里拿，等于把几万吨水搬一遍。: Remove enrichment: 1 L of liquid bromine would need 57 m³ of seawater, like moving tens of thousands of tonnes of water.
考点：海水提溴的五个工段与它们的先后顺序。: Exam point: the five process stages of bromine extraction and their order.
Br⁻ → Br₂ → HBr → Br₂ → 液溴: Br⁻ → Br₂ → HBr → Br₂ → liquid bromine
四个价态台阶：氧化—吹出—吸收—再氧化 + 蒸馏: Four oxidation-state steps: oxidation, blow-out, absorption, re-oxidation + distillation
海水近中性，为什么一定要先加硫酸酸化？: Seawater is nearly neutral. Why must sulfuric acid be added first?
把酸化 pH 从 3.5 拖到 7（等于不加硫酸）: Drag the acidification pH from 3.5 to 7 (same as adding no sulfuric acid)
海水近中性，Br₂ 与 Cl₂ 都会歧化，溴白丢、氯白耗；酸化到 pH 3.5: Seawater is nearly neutral, so Br₂ and Cl₂ both disproportionate, wasting bromine and chlorine; acidifying to pH 3.5 keeps bromine as Br₂ molecules so it can be blown out.
海水近中性，Br₂ 在碱性条件下歧化：Br₂ + 2OH⁻ = Br⁻ + Br: Seawater is nearly neutral, and Br₂ disproportionates under alkaline conditions: Br₂ + 2OH⁻ = Br⁻ + BrO⁻ + H₂O.
Cl₂ 在碱性条件下也歧化，等于白耗氯气。: Cl₂ also disproportionates under alkaline conditions, wasting chlorine.
酸化到 pH 3.5，溴以 Br₂ 分子存在，才容易被空气带走。: Acidified to pH 3.5, bromine exists as Br₂ molecules and is easily carried away by air.
去掉酸化：吹出率从 88.5 % 掉到 39.8 %。: Remove acidification: blow-out yield falls from 88.5 % to 39.8 %.
考点：为什么先酸化再通氯气（抑制歧化、减少氯耗）。: Exam point: why acidify before adding chlorine (suppress disproportionation, cut chlorine use).
通氯气这一步，到底把溴变成了什么？: What exactly does adding chlorine turn the bromine into?
把通氯比从 0.6 拖到 1.1（理论量的 1.1 倍）: Drag the chlorine ratio from 0.6 to 1.1 (1.1 times the theoretical amount)
Cl₂ 氧化性强于 Br₂（卤族自上而下非金属性减弱），2Br⁻ + Cl₂ =: Cl₂ is a stronger oxidizer than Br₂ (nonmetallic character decreases down the halogen group), 2Br⁻ + Cl₂ = Br₂ + 2Cl⁻, and Br rises from −1 to 0; chlorine is fed at 1.1 times the theoretical amount, and excess leaves chlorine in the liquid bromine (purity 95.0 → 72.5 %).
Cl₂ 的氧化性比 Br₂ 强（同主族自上而下非金属性减弱），所以能把 Br⁻: Cl₂ is a stronger oxidizer than Br₂ (nonmetallic character decreases down a group), so it can oxidize Br⁻.
Br 由 −1 升到 0，Cl 由 0 降到 −1，电子转移 2 mol / m: Br rises from −1 to 0, Cl falls from 0 to −1, transferring 2 mol of electrons per mol Br₂.
按理论量的 1.1 倍通氯；过量会让液溴带氯、纯度掉到 72.5 %。: Feed chlorine at 1.1 times the theoretical amount; excess leaves chlorine in the liquid bromine and purity falls to 72.5 %.
去掉氧化：Br⁻ 还是 Br⁻，后面一步也吹不出任何东西。: Remove oxidation: Br⁻ stays Br⁻, and the next step blows out nothing at all.
考点：离子方程式 2Br⁻ + Cl₂ = Br₂ + 2Cl⁻，以及「氯气为什: Exam point: the ionic equation 2Br⁻ + Cl₂ = Br₂ + 2Cl⁻, and “why chlorine can oxidize bromide ions.”
溴已经变出来了，为什么要用大量空气把它吹走？: The bromine has already formed. Why blow it away with huge amounts of air?
把吹出塔空气温度从 40 ℃ 升到 80 ℃，看剖开的塔里气液怎样接触: Raise the blow-out tower air temperature from 40 ℃ to 80 ℃ and watch how gas and liquid meet inside the cut-open tower
Br₂ 沸点只有 58.8 ℃、极易挥发；海水加温到 80 ℃、空气按 300:: Br₂ boils at only 58.8 ℃ and is very volatile; seawater is heated to 80 ℃ and air strips it in counterflow from bottom to top at an air-to-water ratio of 300:1, moving bromine from the liquid phase into the gas phase. If it's too cold, it won't blow out.
Br₂ 沸点 58.8 ℃，是常温下唯一的液态非金属单质，极易挥发。: Br₂ boils at 58.8 ℃; it is the only nonmetal element that is liquid at room temperature, and it is very volatile.
吹出是物理过程：溴从液相进入气相，价态仍然是 0。: Blow-out is a physical process: bromine moves from liquid to gas, and its oxidation state stays 0.
加温到 80 ℃ + 气水比 300:1 逆流，吹出率才有 88.5 %。: Only with heating to 80 ℃ + a 300:1 air-to-water ratio in counterflow does blow-out yield reach 88.5 %.
去掉吹出：溴留在几万吨海水里，后面的富集无从谈起。: Remove blow-out: the bromine stays in tens of thousands of tonnes of seawater, and later enrichment is impossible.
考点：吹出是物理变化，以及「为什么加热、为什么气量要大」。: Exam point: blow-out is a physical change, and “why heat, why so much air.”
吹出来的溴气那么稀，怎么变成能蒸馏的浓溶液？: The blown-out bromine vapor is so dilute. How does it become a concentrated solution that can be distilled?
打开 SO₂ 吸收塔（先看关着时候的后果）: Turn on the SO₂ absorption tower (first see what happens with it off)
用 SO₂ 水溶液把 Br₂ 还原吸收：Br₂ + SO₂ + 2H₂O = 2: SO₂ solution reduces and absorbs Br₂: Br₂ + SO₂ + 2H₂O = 2HBr + H₂SO₄ (Br 0→−1, S +4→+6); the absorbing liquid is only 1/300 of the seawater volume, so bromine concentration rises 255×. This step is the real “enrichment.”
SO₂ 是还原剂，把 Br₂ 还原成 HBr 溶进水里。: SO₂ is the reducing agent, reducing Br₂ to HBr, which dissolves in water.
Br 由 0 降到 −1，S 由 +4 升到 +6，电子守恒 2 mol e⁻: Br falls from 0 to −1, S rises from +4 to +6, conserving electrons at 2 mol e⁻ / mol Br₂.
吸收液只占海水量的 1/300，溴浓度放大 255 倍。: The absorbing liquid is only 1/300 of the seawater volume, so bromine concentration rises 255×.
去掉吸收：溴随尾气排空，回收率归零，还污染大气。: Remove absorption: bromine leaves with the tail gas, recovery drops to zero, and the air is polluted.
考点：吸收工段的方程式，以及「为什么这一步叫富集」。: Exam point: the equation for the absorption stage, and “why this step is called enrichment.”
吸收液里是 HBr，怎么变回液溴并拿到手？: The absorbing liquid holds HBr. How do we turn it back into liquid bromine and collect it?
投用二次氯化与蒸馏（吸收液 → Br₂ → 液溴）: Start second chlorination and distillation (absorbing liquid → Br₂ → liquid bromine)
吸收液再通氯气：2HBr + Cl₂ = Br₂ + 2HCl（Br −1→0）: Chlorine is fed into the absorbing liquid again: 2HBr + Cl₂ = Br₂ + 2HCl (Br −1→0), then distillation (Br₂ boils at 58.8 ℃) separates it from H₂SO₄ and water to give liquid bromine; the whole process theoretically uses 2 mol Cl₂ and 1 mol SO₂ per mol Br₂.
二次氯化：Br 由 −1 回到 0，又得到 Br₂。: Second chlorination: Br returns from −1 to 0, giving Br₂ again.
蒸馏靠沸点差分离：Br₂ 58.8 ℃，水 100 ℃，H₂SO₄ 难挥发。: Distillation separates by boiling point: Br₂ 58.8 ℃, water 100 ℃, H₂SO₄ barely volatile.
理论摩尔比 Cl₂ : SO₂ : Br₂ = 2 : 1 : 1，三段反应各转: Theoretical mole ratio Cl₂ : SO₂ : Br₂ = 2 : 1 : 1; each of the three reactions transfers 2 mol of electrons.
去掉蒸馏：只有吸收液，拿不到产品。: Remove distillation: you only have absorbing liquid and no product.
考点：二次氯化的作用，以及「溴的沸点低」在分离上的应用。: Exam point: the role of second chlorination, and how “bromine's low boiling point” is used in separation.
把溴回收率调到 ≥ 78 %、纯度 ≥ 93 %，并保持 15 s: Bring bromine recovery to ≥ 78 % and purity to ≥ 93 %, and hold for 15 s
达标横幅；越界走「3 秒倒计时 → 事故 → 复盘」: Target banner; going out of range triggers “3-second countdown → accident → review”
把每一步的条件都落在区间里：pH 3.5、通氯比 1.05、吹出 85 ℃、气水: Keep every step's conditions in range: pH 3.5, chlorine ratio 1.05, blow-out 85 ℃, air-to-water ratio 350.
回收率 = 氧化率 × 吹出率 × 吸收率 × 蒸馏收率，一环掉链子全盘掉。: Recovery = oxidation yield × blow-out yield × absorption yield × distillation yield; if one link fails, everything falls.
纯度由通氯比决定：过氯就让溴里带氯。: Purity is set by the chlorine ratio: too much chlorine leaves chlorine in the bromine.
温度、气水比、pH 三个条件互相牵制，要同时照顾。: Temperature, air-to-water ratio and pH constrain each other and must be managed together.
去掉任一工段：要么没有产品，要么产品不合格。: Remove any stage: either there's no product, or the product fails spec.
考点：综合评价一套提溴方案（回收率、纯度、氯耗）。: Exam point: evaluate a bromine extraction plan as a whole (recovery, purity, chlorine use).

溴由液相进入气相，价态不变，是物理过程；靠的是 Br₂ 沸点只有 58.8 ℃。: Bromine moves from liquid to gas with no change in oxidation state, a physical process; it works because Br₂ boils at only 58.8 ℃.
吸收工段中 SO₂ 的作用是: In the absorption stage, SO₂ acts as
Br₂ + SO₂ + 2H₂O = 2HBr + H₂SO₄：S 由 +4 升: Br₂ + SO₂ + 2H₂O = 2HBr + H₂SO₄: S rises from +4 to +6, so SO₂ is the reducing agent.
「富集」主要发生在哪个工段？: In which stage does “enrichment” mainly happen?
吹出把溴从大量海水搬进空气，吸收再把溴搬进少量 SO₂ 溶液，浓度放大 255: Blow-out moves bromine from a large volume of seawater into air, then absorption moves it into a small volume of SO₂ solution, raising concentration 255×.
最后用蒸馏分离液溴，依据是: Liquid bromine is finally separated by distillation, based on
Br₂ 沸点 58.8 ℃，远低于水，加热蒸馏时先汽化，冷凝即得液溴。: Br₂ boils at 58.8 ℃, far below water, so it vaporizes first when heated and condenses into liquid bromine.

生成 BrCl 等，沸点与 Br₂ 接近: Forms BrCl and the like, with boiling points close to Br₂
按理论量的 1.05–1.2 倍通氯，用余氯表在线监控: Feed chlorine at 1.05–1.2 times the theoretical amount, monitored online with a residual chlorine meter

布朗运动与扩散 · 3D 互动课件: Brownian Motion and Diffusion · 3D Interactive Lesson
看不见的分子，凭什么说它在乱动？: Molecules are invisible — so how can we say they are moving randomly?
显微镜下，悬浮的小炭粒在自己的位置附近无规则游走: Under the microscope, tiny suspended carbon particles wander randomly around where they are
每 30 s 记一个点，连成的折线不是它的真实路径: One point every 30 s; the connected zigzag is not the real path
液体分子四面撞它、撞击不平衡，微粒才改变运动状态: Liquid molecules hit it from all sides; only when the hits are unbalanced does the particle change its motion
微粒越小、温度越高，运动越明显（撞击数变少、η 变小）: The smaller the particle and the higher the temperature, the more obvious the motion (fewer hits, smaller η)
同一个根源（分子热运动），让浓度从高向低展开: The same root cause (thermal motion of molecules) spreads concentration from high to low
高倍显微镜 + 载玻片 + 稀释墨汁，结果由显示器呈现（教材 p.3）: High-power microscope + slide + diluted ink; the result is shown on a monitor (textbook p.3)
每 30 s 记一个位置，用线段依次连成折线（教材图 1.1-4）: Record a position every 30 s and join them in order with line segments (textbook Fig. 1.1-4)
炭粒被四面撞来的分子推着乱走（已放大绘制）: The carbon particle is pushed around by molecules hitting it from all sides (drawn enlarged)
静水里滴一滴墨，浓度从高向低展开: A drop of ink in still water; the concentration spreads from high to low
显微镜下，小炭粒为什么会自己动起来？: Why do tiny carbon particles move on their own under the microscope?
在 3D 里点一下前右侧那台显示器，把悬浊液的视野打开: In 3D, click the monitor at the front right to open the view of the suspension
显示器上出现一片浑浊的视野，几颗小黑点各自乱走、方向随时在变；水没有流动，也没有: The monitor shows a cloudy field with a few small black dots, each wandering randomly, changing direction all the time; the water isn’t flowing and nobody is stirring it. The lens is at 1 000× (the textbook uses 400× or 1 000×).
悬浮在液体中的微粒做无规则的、不停息的运动，这就是布朗运动；1827 年布朗首先: Particles suspended in a liquid move randomly and never stop — this is Brownian motion; Brown first studied it under a microscope in 1827. The particles are too small to see with the naked eye, so a high-power microscope is needed, and the result can be shown on a monitor (textbook pp. 3–4).
A2.3、A4.1、A6.1（人教选必3 · 印刷页 p.3–4）: A2.3, A4.1, A6.1 (PEP Elective Vol. 3 · printed pp. 3–4)
看到的是悬浮的微粒（约 10⁻⁶ m 级），不是分子——分子约 0.1 nm 级: What you see are suspended particles (about 10⁻⁶ m), not molecules — molecules are about 0.1 nm, far beyond what an optical microscope can resolve; the particles’ motion is only indirect evidence of molecular collisions (textbook p.4 side note).
必须用高倍显微镜：教材演示调至 400 倍或 1 000 倍，目镜里的结果可以通: A high-power microscope is needed: the textbook demo uses 400× or 1 000×, and the eyepiece image can be shown on a monitor (p.3).
没有定向漂移：它东一步、西一步，方向随时在变，不是被水流冲着走。: No steady drift: it steps one way, then another, changing direction all the time — it isn’t being carried by a current.
去掉这一步：学生会把布朗运动当成「分子自己在动」或「水把微粒冲着走」。: Without this step: students take Brownian motion to be “the molecules themselves moving” or “water carrying the particles along”.
常考：布朗运动是悬浮微粒的运动，不是分子的运动（教材 p.6 第 3 题 (1): Often tested: Brownian motion is the motion of suspended particles, not of molecules (textbook p.6 Q3 (1)(2)).
布朗运动 = 悬浮微粒的无规则运动: Brownian motion = random motion of suspended particles
把它的位置每 30 秒记一次，连起来是什么样子？: Record its position every 30 seconds and join the points — what does it look like?
把「记录次数」从 4 次拖到 10 次：方格纸上每 30 s 记一个点，看折线怎: Drag “Records” from 4 to 10: one point every 30 s on the graph paper — watch the zigzag grow
方格纸上出现 10 个记录点、9 段折线：从起点到第 10 点的净位移 16.5: The graph paper shows 10 recorded points and 9 segments: the net displacement from the start to point 10 is 16.50 μm, but the zigzag covers 64.8 μm in total; mean square displacement 512.3 μm².
每隔 30 s 记下一个位置，再用线段按时间顺序连起来，就得到教材图 1.1-4: Record a position every 30 s and join them with line segments in time order to get a zigzag like textbook Fig. 1.1-4. The zigzag is not the real path — textbook p.4 makes it clear: “even within 30 s, the particle’s motion is extremely irregular”.
A4.4、A6.2（教材 p.4 图 1.1-4）、A5.4、B2.2 表 1: A4.4, A6.2 (textbook p.4 Fig. 1.1-4), A5.4, B2.2 Table 1 ①
记录间隔 30 s 是教材给的值（p.4），不是「微粒每 30 s 才动一下」。: The 30 s recording interval is the textbook’s value (p.4); it does not mean “the particle moves only once every 30 s”.
折线只是采样连线：两个记录点之间，微粒照样在乱走（放大视窗里能看到那段锯齿）。: The zigzag only joins samples: between two recorded points the particle keeps wandering (you can see that jagged stretch in the zoom window).
净位移 16.50 μm 远小于路程 64.8 μm——它东一步西一步，大部分互: The net displacement of 16.50 μm is far smaller than the 64.8 μm path length — it steps back and forth, and most steps cancel out.
去掉这一步：学生会把折线当真实路径（教材 p.6 第 4 题「小李」的错误）。: Without this step: students take the zigzag as the real path (the mistake by “Xiao Li” in textbook p.6 Q4).
常考：折线是每隔 30 s 的位置连线，不是真实轨迹（教材 p.6 第 4 题）: Often tested: the zigzag joins positions taken every 30 s; it is not the real trajectory (textbook p.6 Q4).
记录时间从 2 分钟延到 10 分钟，均方位移怎么变？: Extend the recording from 2 minutes to 10 minutes — how does the mean square displacement change?
把记录次数拖到 20 次（10 分钟），看均方位移涨多少、折线总路程涨多少: Drag Records to 20 (10 minutes) and see how much the mean square displacement grows, and how much the total zigzag length grows
记录点从 4 个变成 20 个（t 从 120 s 到 600 s）：均方位移: Records go from 4 to 20 (t from 120 s to 600 s): mean square displacement 204.9 → 1024.6 μm², exactly 5× = the ratio of times; but the root-mean-square displacement grows only as √t (about √5×).
均方位移与时间成正比（⟨r²⟩ = 4Dt，二维投影；属拓展 L3，教材本节没有: Mean square displacement is proportional to time (⟨r²⟩ = 4Dt, 2D projection; extension L3 — this section of the textbook has no formula), so the RMS displacement grows only as √t, while the zigzag’s path length grows as t — keep the three apart.
⟨r²⟩ ∝ t：时间 5 倍，均方位移就 5 倍。: ⟨r²⟩ ∝ t: 5× the time, 5× the mean square displacement.
折线总路程 L ∝ t，跟时间同倍长——路程长不等于「走得远」。: Total zigzag length L ∝ t, growing in step with time — a longer path does not mean “going farther”.
去掉这一步：「折线越长＝扩散越快」（A7.6）和 ⟨r²⟩ 与 √⟨r²⟩ 混比: Without this step: neither “longer zigzag = faster diffusion” (A7.6) nor mixing up ⟨r²⟩ and √⟨r²⟩ (A7.11) can be prevented.

把「哪颗微粒」从①拨到②：坐标纸上换成第二颗微粒的折线: Switch “Which particle” from ① to ②: the graph paper now shows the second particle’s zigzag

布朗运动是统计规律：单次结果涨落很大，只有大量微粒（或很多次）平均起来，⟨r²⟩: Brownian motion follows a statistical law: single results fluctuate a lot, and ⟨r²⟩ is stable only when averaged over many particles (or many runs). Textbook Fig. 1.1-4 draws three particles with three completely different zigzags — exactly this point.
同一颗微粒、同一工况，每次读数逐位相同（带种子的随机数，不是每次重掷骰子）。: Same particle, same conditions: the readings match digit for digit every time (seeded random numbers, not a fresh roll each time).
换一颗微粒：净位移 16.50 → 29.26 μm，差了近一倍——这是单次结果: Switch particles: net displacement 16.50 → 29.26 μm, nearly double — that is the fluctuation of a single result.
⟨r²⟩ = 4Dt 是统计平均，不随单次结果变：512.3 μm² 一直在那儿: ⟨r²⟩ = 4Dt is a statistical average and does not change with a single result: 512.3 μm² stays put.

分子动理论的基本内容是: The basic content of the kinetic molecular theory is
物体由大量分子组成，分子永不停息地做无规则运动，分子之间有相互作用力: Matter consists of a huge number of molecules, molecules move randomly without ever stopping, and there are forces between molecules
分子之间只有引力: There is only attraction between molecules
温度越高分子越大: Molecules get bigger at higher temperature

篦冷机不是「放凉」，是换热器：冷风穿过料层，变成 1000 ℃ 上下的二次风回窑: The grate cooler doesn’t just “let it cool”: it’s a heat exchanger. Cold air passes through the clinker bed and returns to the kiln as secondary air at around 1000 ℃.
慢冷会让 C₃S 分解、活性掉，熟料发暗、易粉化。: Slow cooling lets C₃S decompose and lose reactivity; the clinker darkens and crumbles easily.

少了闪凝（36 min 就凝，来不及施工），多了 SO₃ 超限、可能膨胀。: Too little causes flash set (setting in 36 min, too fast to place); too much puts SO₃ over the limit and may cause expansion.
「适量」是算出来的窗口：初凝 ≥ 45 min 卡下限，SO₃ ≤ 3.5 %: “Appropriate amount” is a calculated window: initial set ≥ 45 min sets the lower bound, SO₃ ≤ 3.5 % the upper (390 min is the upper limit for final set, not initial set).
去掉石膏：水泥一拌就凝，工地上根本来不及浇。: Remove gypsum: cement sets as soon as it’s mixed, with no time to pour it on site.
常考「水泥中加石膏的作用」：调节凝结时间（缓凝），不是提供强度。: Common: “the role of gypsum in cement”: to regulate setting time (retard setting), not to add strength.
石膏是调凝剂：它和 C₃A 的水化产物生成钙矾石，把 C₃A 包住、拖慢凝结。少: Gypsum is a set regulator: with the hydration products of C₃A it forms ettringite, which coats the C₃A and slows setting. Too little causes flash set, too much puts SO₃ over the limit. The “appropriate amount” in the textbook’s “add an appropriate amount of gypsum” is this window.

教材里普通硅酸盐水泥的原料是: In the textbook, the raw materials of ordinary Portland cement are
纯碱、石灰石和石英砂: Soda ash, limestone and quartz sand
黏土和石灰石（加适量石膏调凝）: Clay and limestone (with an appropriate amount of gypsum to regulate setting)
人教必修2 印刷页 21 原句：「普通硅酸盐水泥的生产以黏土和石灰石为主要原料…: PEP Required Vol. 2, printed p.21: “Ordinary Portland cement is produced mainly from clay and limestone … an appropriate amount of gypsum is added to adjust the hardening rate, and it is ground into a fine powder.” Soda ash + limestone + quartz sand are the raw materials of glass.
水泥磨里加石膏的作用是: Gypsum is added in the cement mill to
调节凝结时间（缓凝），防止闪凝: Regulate setting time (retard setting) and prevent flash set
石膏与 C₃A 的水化产物生成钙矾石，把 C₃A 包住、拖慢凝结。少了闪凝（本课: Gypsum forms ettringite with the hydration products of C₃A, coating the C₃A and slowing setting. Too little causes flash set (in this lesson’s model, at 0.5 % the initial set is only 36 min); too much puts SO₃ over the limit.
生料要磨细混匀，主要是因为: Raw meal must be ground fine and mixed mainly because
颗粒细、成分匀，窑里才烧得透，f-CaO 才不会高: Fine, uniform particles burn through in the kiln, keeping f-CaO low
窑内反应靠颗粒接触；粗颗粒表面烧到了、芯里还没分解，CaO 游离留下，f-CaO: Kiln reactions depend on particle contact; the surface of a coarse particle is fired while its core is undecomposed, so CaO is left free, f-CaO rises and soundness suffers.
分解炉里发生的主要反应是: The main reaction in the precalciner is
分解炉在 850–900 ℃ 把 CaCO₃ 分解成 CaO 并放出 CO₂（吸: The precalciner decomposes CaCO₃ into CaO at 850–900 ℃, releasing CO₂ (endothermic); the decomposition rate at the kiln inlet can reach 90 %, so the kiln only handles sintering.
回转窑里物料和热气流的方向是: In a rotary kiln, the material and hot gas move
都从窑尾到窑头: Both from kiln inlet to outlet
都从窑头到窑尾: Both from kiln outlet to inlet
物料从窑尾（冷端）进、往窑头（热端）出；燃烧器在窑头，热气流反向朝窑尾走，两者逆: Material enters at the kiln inlet (cold end) and leaves at the outlet (hot end); the burner is at the outlet and hot gas flows the other way toward the inlet, exchanging heat in counterflow.
烧成带温度不足会直接导致: A burning zone that is too cool directly causes
C₃S 生成不足、f-CaO 升高: Too little C₃S and higher f-CaO
液相量不足，C₂S 与 CaO 结合成 C₃S 的反应走不动，CaO 以游离态留: There isn’t enough liquid phase, so the reaction of C₂S with CaO to form C₃S stalls and CaO is left free (in this lesson’s model, f-CaO is 2.15 % at 1350 ℃).
熟料出窑要急冷（篦冷机），原因是: Clinker must be quenched (grate cooler) on leaving the kiln because
保住 C₃S 与活性，同时把热量变成二次风回收: It preserves C₃S and reactivity, and recovers heat as secondary air
急冷避免 C₃S 分解、活性下降；同时冷风穿过料层变成约 1000 ℃ 的二次风: Quenching prevents C₃S from decomposing and losing reactivity; meanwhile cold air passing through the bed becomes secondary air at about 1000 ℃ returned to the kiln, directly cutting heat consumption.
工业上把烧成带温度控制在 1350–1450 ℃，而不是越高越好，因为: Industry holds the burning zone at 1350–1450 ℃ rather than “the hotter the better” because
窑温越高 f-CaO 越高: The hotter the kiln, the higher the f-CaO
够出液相生成 C₃S 即可，再高就结圈、窑皮垮、热耗涨: It only needs enough liquid phase to form C₃S; any hotter and rings form, the coating collapses and heat consumption rises
窑温与熟料质量无关: Kiln temperature has nothing to do with clinker quality
窑温高了初凝会变短: A hotter kiln shortens initial set
液相约 1280 ℃ 以上出现，1350–1450 ℃ 液相量才够生成 C₃S；: Liquid phase appears above about 1280 ℃, and only at 1350–1450 ℃ is there enough to form C₃S; above 1480 ℃ there is too much, the coating won’t hold, rings form and the kiln glows red.

一套装置给三样产品：阴极得 H₂ 和 NaOH，阳极得 Cl₂，所以氯碱厂天然是: One unit makes three products: H₂ and NaOH at the cathode, Cl₂ at the anode, so a chlor-alkali plant is naturally “three-in-one.”
精制（①）只做一件事：把盐水里的钙镁洗掉，替②的膜挡掉结垢。: Purification (①) does just one job: wash calcium and magnesium out of the brine so they don't scale the membrane in ②.
氯气（③）、氢气（④）、烧碱（⑤）是电解之后三条并联的产品线，不是串联。: Chlorine (③), hydrogen (④) and caustic soda (⑤) are three parallel product lines after electrolysis, not a series.
去掉电解这一步：三条产品线全部无料可处理，全厂停产。: Remove electrolysis: all three product lines have nothing to process, and the whole plant stops.
常考「电解饱和食盐水得到什么」：阴极 H₂ 与 NaOH、阳极 Cl₂；不是金属: Common exam point: “what does electrolysis of saturated brine give?” H₂ and NaOH at the cathode, Cl₂ at the anode; not sodium metal.
一套电解装置同时产三样：Cl₂、H₂、NaOH。原料只有食盐和水，难的是把产物分: One electrolysis unit makes three products at once: Cl₂, H₂ and NaOH. The only raw materials are salt and water; the hard part is keeping the products apart while keeping efficiency up, which is exactly the job of the membrane in the middle.
原料只是食盐和水，为什么进槽前要先把盐水洗一遍？: The raw materials are just salt and water. Why wash the brine before it enters the cell?
把「盐水精制」切断，盯着电流效率看: Cut off “Brine purification” and watch the current efficiency
电流效率从 95 % 开始往下掉（每 6 s 掉 1 个百分点，最低 80 %）: Current efficiency starts falling from 95 % (1 percentage point every 6 s, down to 80 %), and power per tonne rises with it; turning it back on only stops the fall, it doesn't reverse it.
一次精制后 Ca²⁺+Mg²⁺ ≤ 5 mg/L；二次螯合树脂 ≤ 20 μg/: After primary purification Ca²⁺+Mg²⁺ ≤ 5 mg/L; after secondary chelating resin ≤ 20 μg/L
一次精制用化学沉淀 + 过滤，把 Ca²⁺+Mg²⁺ 降到 ≤ 5 mg/L。: Primary purification uses chemical precipitation + filtration to bring Ca²⁺+Mg²⁺ down to ≤ 5 mg/L.
离子膜要求更高：再过螯合树脂塔做二次精制，降到 ≤ 20 μg/L。: The ion-exchange membrane demands more: a chelating resin tower does secondary purification down to ≤ 20 μg/L.
只有两条硬约束：Na₂CO₃ 必须在 BaCl₂ 之后（顺带沉淀过量 Ba²⁺）: There are only two hard rules: Na₂CO₃ must come after BaCl₂ (to also precipitate excess Ba²⁺), and hydrochloric acid must come after filtration (or the precipitates dissolve again); when to add NaOH is a process choice.
去掉精制：钙镁在膜里结垢，电流效率掉下来修不回来。下一步开局视同换新膜（课件设定: Remove purification: calcium and magnesium scale the membrane, and the current efficiency drops and can't be restored. The next step starts as if with a new membrane (lesson setting), so you'll see efficiency back at 95 %.
常考两点：盐水为什么要两次精制；沉淀剂顺序的两条硬约束（其余不是「必须」）。: Two common exam points: why brine is purified twice; the two hard rules for the order of precipitating agents (the rest are not “musts”).
Ca²⁺、Mg²⁺ 进膜后生成 Ca(OH)₂、Mg(OH)₂ 沉积在靠阴极的羧: Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺ enter the membrane and form Ca(OH)₂ and Mg(OH)₂ deposits in the carboxylate layer near the cathode: current efficiency falls, cell voltage rises, and the damage is irreversible.
一层膜夹在两块电极板中间，它到底把什么分开？: A membrane sits between two electrode plates. What exactly does it separate?
拖动视角，从剖开的那一面看两个室: Drag to rotate the view and look at the two compartments from the cut-away side
阳极室（+x）里是黄绿色气泡，阴极室（−x）里是近白气泡，中间一片半透明的膜；阳: The anode compartment (+x) has yellow-green bubbles, the cathode compartment (−x) has near-white bubbles, with a translucent membrane in between; anolyte and catholyte are kept separate.
阴极得电子的是水，不是 Na⁺: At the cathode, water gains electrons, not Na⁺
阳极是钛基涂钌铱：催化层让 Cl⁻ 优先放电、把水的析氧压住，否则氯气纯度下降、: The anode is titanium coated with ruthenium and iridium: the catalytic layer makes Cl⁻ discharge first and suppresses oxygen evolution from water; otherwise chlorine purity drops and the anode corrodes.
阴极是镍基活性涂层：降低析氢过电位，水得电子生成 H₂ 和 OH⁻。: The cathode has a nickel-based active coating: it lowers the hydrogen overpotential, and water gains electrons to form H₂ and OH⁻.
阴极得电子的是水，不是 Na⁺——水溶液里 Na⁺ 不放电，电解熔融 NaCl: At the cathode, water gains electrons, not Na⁺: in aqueous solution Na⁺ does not discharge; sodium metal comes only from electrolyzing molten NaCl.
去掉这一层膜：产物不再被分开，后果见第 ⑦ 步。: Remove this membrane: the products are no longer separated; see Step ⑦ for the consequences.
常考「阴极产物为什么不是 Na」：水溶液中 Na⁺ 不放电，阴极是 2H₂O +: Common exam point: “why isn't the cathode product Na?” In aqueous solution Na⁺ does not discharge; at the cathode, 2H₂O + 2e⁻ → H₂↑ + 2OH⁻.
两块电极各管一半：+x 侧 Cl⁻ 放电出 Cl₂，−x 侧水得电子出 H₂ 和: Each electrode handles half: on the +x side Cl⁻ discharges to give Cl₂, on the −x side water gains electrons to give H₂ and OH⁻; the membrane separates the two compartments so the products don't mix.
离子交换膜让什么通过、又把什么挡回去？: What does the ion-exchange membrane let through, and what does it push back?
在 3D 里点一下槽前那块放大板上的膜: In 3D, click the membrane on the magnified panel in front of the cell
Na⁺ 带着水从阳极室（+x）跳进阴极室（−x）；Cl⁻ 留在 +x 侧、OH⁻: Na⁺ hops with water from the anode compartment (+x) into the cathode compartment (−x); Cl⁻ stays on the +x side and OH⁻ on the −x side, bouncing back when they near the membrane.
阳离子交换膜：只放 Na⁺ 带水通过: Cation-exchange membrane: lets only Na⁺ through, with water
膜是多层复合膜：靠阳极的磺酸层厚、电阻低，管的是槽电压。: The membrane is a multilayer composite: the sulfonate layer on the anode side is thick with low resistance and governs cell voltage.
靠阴极的羧酸层薄、排斥 OH⁻，管的是电流效率——这一层做不好，效率就到不了实用: The carboxylate layer on the cathode side is thin and repels OH⁻, governing current efficiency; if this layer is poor, efficiency can't reach a practical level.
Na⁺ 从一个固定负电荷跳到下一个，同时带大量水过去；所以阴极室要持续补纯水，把: Na⁺ hops from one fixed negative charge to the next, carrying lots of water with it, so pure water must be added to the cathode compartment continuously to keep the caustic at about 32 %.
去掉膜的排斥：Cl⁻ 与 OH⁻ 互窜，烧碱被污染、电流效率下降（见第 ⑦ 步）: Remove the membrane's repulsion: Cl⁻ and OH⁻ cross over, the caustic soda is contaminated, and current efficiency drops (see Step ⑦).
常考「离子交换膜是什么膜」：阳离子交换膜，只让 Na⁺（带着水）通过，Cl⁻ 与: Common exam point: “what kind of membrane is the ion-exchange membrane?” A cation-exchange membrane that lets only Na⁺ (with water) through; Cl⁻ and OH⁻ are repelled by fixed negative charges.
固定负电荷排斥阴离子，只放 Na⁺ 带水通过：挡 Cl⁻ 保住烧碱纯度，挡 OH: Fixed negative charges repel anions and let only Na⁺ through with water: blocking Cl⁻ keeps the caustic pure, blocking OH⁻ keeps current efficiency up.
想让这座厂多产烧碱，把电流密度加大就行吗？: To make this plant produce more caustic soda, is it enough to raise the current density?

产碱 30.31 → 55.11 t/d，吨碱电耗 2187 → 2712 kW: Caustic output 30.31 → 55.11 t/d, power per tonne 2187 → 2712 kW·h/t, cell voltage 3.100 → 3.845 V, and the risk bar starts to rise.
32 % NaOH、90 ℃、η 0.95（由手册公式计算 · 课件拟合参数）: 32 % NaOH, 90 ℃, η 0.95 (calculated from handbook formulas · parameters fitted for this lesson)
产量与电流密度成正比，槽电压只是线性上升——斜率固定、截距 2.19 V 不为零: Output is proportional to current density, while cell voltage only rises linearly: the slope is fixed and the 2.19 V intercept is not zero.
所以电耗涨得比产量慢，但绝对值确实在涨：多产碱一定要多付电费。: So power use per tonne rises more slowly than output, but it does rise: more caustic always means a bigger power bill.
手册的分级：3.5–4.5 kA/m² 属中电流密度，4.5–6.0 属高，超过: Handbook classes: 3.5–4.5 kA/m² is medium current density, 4.5–6.0 is high, and above 6.0 is ultra-high, which strains both the cell and the membrane.
去掉这一步：学生会以为电流越大越划算，看不到电耗这条并行的账。: Without this step: students think more current is always better value and miss the parallel account of power use.
常考「电流密度与槽电压、电耗的关系」：线性增加但不成正比（截距不为零），与电流密: Common exam point: “how cell voltage and power use relate to current density”: they increase linearly but not proportionally (non-zero intercept); output is what is proportional to current density.
产量随电流密度成正比涨，吨碱电耗也随槽电压线性涨；两者一起涨，才有「折中」这道题: Output rises in proportion to current density, and power per tonne rises linearly with cell voltage; because both rise together, there is a “trade-off” question to answer.
槽温只差几度，为什么也算进成本？: Why do just a few degrees of cell temperature count toward cost?
把槽温从 90 拖到 85 ℃，看槽电压和电耗: Drag the cell temperature from 90 to 85 ℃ and watch the cell voltage and power use
3.3 kA/m² 下 90 → 85 ℃：槽电压 3.100 → 3.532: At 3.3 kA/m², 90 → 85 ℃: cell voltage 3.100 → 3.532 V, power per tonne 2187 → 2492 kW·h/t, caustic output still 30.31 t/d.
温度系数 0.095 /℃（手册 5.5.1）；85 / 90 / 95 ℃ 三: Temperature coefficient 0.095 /℃ (handbook 5.5.1); 85 / 90 / 95 ℃ all use the same formula
槽温升高，膜里离子迁移更容易、电阻变小，槽电压与吨碱电耗一起下降。: At higher cell temperature, ions move more easily through the membrane and resistance falls, so cell voltage and power per tonne both drop.
但槽温不是越高越好：碱浓度会掉、膜效率有最佳峰值、氯气含水与设备腐蚀都加重。: But hotter is not always better: caustic concentration falls, membrane efficiency has an optimum peak, and moisture in the chlorine and equipment corrosion both get worse.
所以工业把槽温稳在 90 ℃ 左右，本课的考核步也把槽温锁在 90 ℃。: So industry keeps the cell at about 90 ℃, and this lesson's test step also locks the cell temperature at 90 ℃.
去掉这一步：只看电流密度，会漏掉另一条同样进成本的变量。: Without this step: watching only current density, you'd miss another variable that also feeds into cost.
常考「提高槽温好不好」：槽电压降、电耗降，但膜效率有最佳峰值，还要顾氯气含水与腐: Common exam point: “is raising cell temperature good?” Cell voltage and power use fall, but membrane efficiency has an optimum peak, and moisture in chlorine and corrosion must also be considered.
槽温经槽电压直接影响电耗：90 ℃ 是工业标准温度，降到 85 ℃ 时每吨碱要多: Cell temperature affects power use directly through cell voltage: 90 ℃ is the industrial standard; at 85 ℃ each tonne of caustic costs 305 kW·h more (2187 → 2492 kW·h/t).
把这层膜抽掉，槽里会发生什么？: If this membrane is pulled out, what happens in the cell?

冷稀碱写法；90 ℃、32 % 热浓碱下主要生成氯酸钠 3Cl₂ + 6NaOH: Written for cold, dilute caustic; in hot, concentrated 32 % caustic at 90 ℃ it mainly forms sodium chlorate, 3Cl₂ + 6NaOH → 5NaCl + NaClO₃ + 3H₂O
氢氯在同一空间: H₂ and Cl₂ in one space
① 氯气被碱吸收：教材写法（常温）是 Cl₂ + 2NaOH → NaCl +: ① Chlorine is absorbed by the caustic: the textbook equation (room temperature) is Cl₂ + 2NaOH → NaCl + NaClO + H₂O; hot, concentrated 32 % caustic at 90 ℃ mainly forms sodium chlorate. The caustic is contaminated and the chlorine is wasted.
② OH⁻ 反渗到阳极室，抬高阳极液 pH，促生成 HClO / ClO₃⁻，腐: ② OH⁻ back-migrates into the anode compartment, raising the anolyte pH and promoting HClO / ClO₃⁻, which corrode the anode and lower chlorine purity.
H₂ 与 Cl₂ 混在同一空间，在一定组成与条件下受光照、火花等引发才可能爆炸—: H₂ and Cl₂ mix in the same space; only at certain compositions and conditions, triggered by light, sparks and the like, can they explode. They don't explode just because light hits them. In practice, hydrogen-in-chlorine analysis + interlock shutdown guard against this.
去掉这一步：学生会把膜当成一块「隔板」，看不出它同时管着纯度和安全。: Without this step: students see the membrane as just a “divider” and miss that it governs both purity and safety.
常考「没有膜会怎样」：烧碱被次氯酸盐污染，且 H₂ 与 Cl₂ 混合在一定条件下: Common exam point: “what happens without a membrane?” The caustic soda is contaminated by hypochlorite, and H₂ mixed with Cl₂ may explode under certain conditions.
没有膜，Cl₂ 与 NaOH 反应把烧碱污染，H₂ 与 Cl₂ 也混到了一起；膜: Without a membrane, Cl₂ reacts with NaOH and contaminates the caustic, and H₂ and Cl₂ mix too; the membrane's second role is a safety barrier.
产量和电耗同时卡死时，你调哪一个？: When output and power use are both at their limits, which do you adjust?

氯中含氢在线分析仪 + 超限联锁停车（本课不出百分比，工业上是必测指标）: Online hydrogen-in-chlorine analyzer + over-limit interlock shutdown (this lesson shows no percentage; in industry it is a required measurement)
阳极液加酸、控制 pH，减少氯酸盐与阳极腐蚀: Add acid to the anolyte and control pH to reduce chlorate and anode corrosion
控制膜两侧压差，防止膜抖动与反渗（本课只作定性提示，不出数字）: Control the pressure difference across the membrane to prevent membrane flutter and back-migration (qualitative note only in this lesson, no numbers)
定期测膜、按期换膜，别等穿孔: Test the membrane regularly and replace it on schedule; don't wait for a rupture
记住这条链：电流越大 → 槽电压与发热上升 → 膜干涸穿孔 → 氢氯相遇。保护正: Remember this chain: more current → higher cell voltage and heating → membrane dries and ruptures → H₂ meets Cl₂. When protection works, the result is a shutdown, not an explosion.
本课目标：搞清膜为什么必须挡、电流密度与电耗的账怎么算，最后在操作带里把产碱稳在: Lesson goal: understand why the membrane must block ions and how to weigh current density against power use, then keep caustic output above 28 t/d within the operating band for 15 seconds.
电解饱和食盐水时，阴极的产物是: When saturated brine is electrolyzed, the products at the cathode are
水溶液里 Na⁺ 不放电，阴极是 2H₂O + 2e⁻ → H₂↑ + 2OH⁻: In aqueous solution Na⁺ does not discharge; at the cathode 2H₂O + 2e⁻ → H₂↑ + 2OH⁻, so the products are H₂ and NaOH; sodium metal requires electrolyzing molten NaCl.
盐水精制里属于「硬约束」的是: Which is a “hard rule” in brine purification?
必须严格按 BaCl₂ → Na₂CO₃ → NaOH 的唯一顺序: You must follow exactly one order: BaCl₂ → Na₂CO₃ → NaOH
Na₂CO₃ 必须在 BaCl₂ 之后、盐酸必须在过滤之后: Na₂CO₃ must come after BaCl₂, and hydrochloric acid must come after filtration
盐酸必须和 Na₂CO₃ 同时加: Hydrochloric acid must be added together with Na₂CO₃
Na₂CO₃ 既要沉淀 Ca²⁺，也要把过量 Ba²⁺ 变成 BaCO₃，所以必: Na₂CO₃ must precipitate Ca²⁺ and also turn excess Ba²⁺ into BaCO₃, so it must come after BaCl₂; adding hydrochloric acid early would redissolve the precipitated CaCO₃ and Mg(OH)₂. When to add NaOH is a process choice (its flocs help settling).
氯碱离子交换膜让什么通过: What does the chlor-alkali ion-exchange membrane let through?
Na⁺（带水）通过，Cl⁻ 与 OH⁻ 被排斥: Na⁺ (with water) passes; Cl⁻ and OH⁻ are repelled
膜内固定基团带负电（—SO₃⁻、—COO⁻），排斥阴离子，只放 Na⁺ 带水通过: Fixed groups in the membrane are negatively charged (—SO₃⁻, —COO⁻), repelling anions and letting only Na⁺ through with water: blocking Cl⁻ keeps the caustic pure, blocking OH⁻ keeps current efficiency up.
没有膜时烧碱被污染的直接原因是: Without a membrane, the direct cause of caustic contamination is
Cl₂ 与 NaOH 反应生成次氯酸盐（热浓碱下还会生成氯酸钠）: Cl₂ reacts with NaOH to form hypochlorite (and sodium chlorate in hot, concentrated caustic)
无膜时阳极的 Cl₂ 会溶进阴极液与 NaOH 反应：教材写法（常温）Cl₂ +: Without a membrane, Cl₂ from the anode dissolves into the catholyte and reacts with NaOH: textbook equation (room temperature) Cl₂ + 2NaOH → NaCl + NaClO + H₂O; hot, concentrated 32 % caustic at 90 ℃ mainly forms sodium chlorate.
其他条件不变，把电流密度从 3.3 提到 6.0 kA/m²，吨碱直流电耗: With other conditions unchanged, raising current density from 3.3 to 6.0 kA/m² makes DC power per tonne of caustic
上升，因为槽电压随电流密度线性上升: Rise, because cell voltage rises linearly with current density
U = 2.19 + 0.27576·i，电流密度越大槽电压越大；W = 100: U = 2.19 + 0.27576·i, so higher current density means higher cell voltage; W = 1000·U/(1.492·η), so power use rises (2187 → 2712 kW·h/t).
工业上为什么不用电耗最低的 1.0 kA/m²: Why doesn't industry use 1.0 kA/m², which has the lowest power use?
同样大的槽产量太小（9.18 t/d），设备投资摊不回来: Output from the same cell is too small (9.18 t/d) to recover the equipment investment
这一区间膜会穿孔: The membrane ruptures in this range
这一区间电流效率最低: Current efficiency is lowest in this range
电耗低是因为产量也低；1.0 kA/m² 只有 9.18 t/d，同样的槽和人工: Power use is low because output is low too; at 1.0 kA/m² you get only 9.18 t/d, so the same cell and labor produce a tenth of the caustic and can't pay for themselves. Industry uses an operating band that balances output and power use.
氯中含氢升高，工业上正确的处理是: When hydrogen in chlorine rises, the correct industrial response is
继续运行，等下次检修再说: Keep running and deal with it at the next maintenance
先降电流密度，靠在线分析与联锁停车把装置切出来: First lower current density, then rely on online analysis and interlock shutdown to take the unit offline
加大电流把氢气烧掉: Increase the current to burn off the hydrogen
把阳极液 pH 调得更低就不必管: Lower the anolyte pH and ignore it
氯中含氢是必测的安全指标：先降负荷，再由在线分析 + 联锁切断电流停车查膜。本课: Hydrogen in chlorine is a required safety measurement: first cut the load, then online analysis + interlock cut the current and shut down to inspect the membrane. This lesson's accident branch only demonstrates the worst-case path of “protection failure.”
在不超电耗线的条件下多产碱，真正起作用的是: To make more caustic without exceeding the power limit, what actually works is
提高槽温，因为它同时增产又降电耗: Raise cell temperature, since it both increases output and cuts power use
提高电流密度：产量成正比涨，电耗线性涨，所以在操作带内调: Raise current density: output rises proportionally and power use rises linearly, so adjust within the operating band
拆掉膜，减少电阻: Remove the membrane to cut resistance
产碱与电流密度成正比，电耗随电流密度线性升；槽温只通过槽电压影响电耗、不直接增产: Caustic output is proportional to current density, and power use rises linearly with it; cell temperature affects power use only through cell voltage and doesn't directly raise output (this lesson locks cell temperature at 90 ℃ in the test step). Removing the membrane doesn't cut resistance; it only contaminates the product.
膜已选中：看 Na⁺ 怎么带水穿过这层膜: Membrane selected: watch how Na⁺ crosses this membrane with water
盐水精制已切断：钙镁开始进膜，电流效率往下掉: Brine purification cut off: calcium and magnesium are entering the membrane, and current efficiency is falling
盐水精制已投用：效率停止下降，但已经结的垢不会自己掉: Brine purification back on: efficiency stops falling, but scale already formed won't come off by itself
膜已拆：Cl₂ 与 OH⁻ 互窜，烧碱被污染；H₂ 与 Cl₂ 已经在同一空间: Membrane removed: Cl₂ and OH⁻ cross over, and the caustic is contaminated; H₂ and Cl₂ are now in the same space
膜已装回：Na⁺ 带水通过，Cl⁻ 与 OH⁻ 被挡回本室: Membrane reinstalled: Na⁺ passes with water, and Cl⁻ and OH⁻ are kept in their own compartments
异常：夜班把电流密度调到 2.6 kA/m²（产碱 23.88 t/d）——自己: Fault: the night shift turned current density down to 2.6 kA/m² (output 23.88 t/d); bring it back into the operating band yourself
达标：产碱与电耗同时守住，保持 15 s: Target met: output and power use both held for 15 s
已回到参考工况：3.3 kA/m²、90 ℃、精制开、膜已装: Back to reference conditions: 3.3 kA/m², 90 ℃, purification on, membrane installed
紧急停车：电流已降回参考工况，联锁解除: Emergency shutdown: current back to reference conditions, interlock cleared
抢修完成：换膜、复位参数，重新开车: Repair complete: membrane replaced, parameters reset, restarted

人教版必修第一册 第二章第二节「氯及其化合物」p.44–52: PEP Required Vol. 1, Ch. 2, Sec. 2 “Chlorine and Its Compounds” pp. 44–52
要一瓶干燥、纯净的氯气，装置里每一段各管什么？少一段会怎样？: To get a bottle of dry, pure chlorine, what does each part of the apparatus do? What happens if one part is missing?
浓盐酸 + MnO₂ 加热才有 Cl₂，变稀就停: Conc. HCl + MnO₂ with heat gives Cl₂; it stops once the acid gets dilute
饱和食盐水洗掉挥发的 HCl: Saturated salt water washes out volatile HCl
浓硫酸除水汽，湿氯气才会漂白: Conc. H₂SO₄ removes water vapor; only moist chlorine bleaches
同温下比空气重 2.486 倍，向上排空气、长进短出: 2.486 times as dense as air at the same temperature: upward air displacement, long tube in, short tube out
NaOH 吸收多余 Cl₂，漏一段就中毒: NaOH absorbs excess Cl₂; leave out one part and you get poisoned

改一个开关，看整条链的后果: Change one switch and see what happens to the whole chain
全对！装置顺序、每段作用、氯水成分你都理顺了。: All correct! You've sorted out the apparatus order, each part's role and what's in chlorine water.
建议回看主线：发生 → 除杂 → 收集 → 尾气，再走一遍氯水那一步。: Review the main line: generation → purification → collection → exhaust, then go through the chlorine water step again.
气流方向：沿装置顺序进入下一段: Gas flow: into the next part in apparatus order
洗气瓶长进短出：进气管口低于液面: Gas-washing bottle long in, short out: inlet tube below the liquid surface
集气瓶长进短出：导管伸到瓶底: Gas jar long in, short out: tube reaches the bottom
有色布条与干布条的对照: Colored cloth strip vs dry cloth strip
进气管口插到液面下: Inlet tube below the liquid surface
出气管口只在瓶口: Outlet tube only at the bottle mouth
浓硫酸瓶同样长进: Conc. H₂SO₄ bottle also long in
HClO 光照分解出 O₂: HClO decomposes in light, releasing O₂
圆底烧瓶 + 分液漏斗 + 酒精灯：MnO₂ 与浓盐酸共热: Round-bottom flask + separatory funnel + alcohol lamp: MnO₂ heated with conc. HCl
饱和食盐水洗 HCl、浓硫酸干燥，两段都能拆下来: Saturated salt water removes HCl, conc. H₂SO₄ dries; both parts can be removed
向上排空气法：导管伸到瓶底，瓶口短管出气: Upward air displacement: tube to the bottom, gas out through the short tube at the mouth
NaOH 溶液吸收多余的 Cl₂，防止中毒与污染: NaOH solution absorbs excess Cl₂ to prevent poisoning and pollution
新制氯水、对照、AgNO₃ 检验与光照管，外加粒子放大: Fresh chlorine water, control, AgNO₃ test and light-exposed tube, plus a zoomed view of particles
一套制氯气的装置，凭什么分成这么几段？: Why is an apparatus for making chlorine split into so many parts?
拖动视角，绕着这张实验台看一圈（滚轮拉近拉远）: Drag to rotate the view around the lab bench (scroll wheel to zoom)
看到从左到右五段：加热的圆底烧瓶、两个洗气瓶、集气瓶、NaOH 烧杯，台面前缘还: You'll see five parts from left to right: a heated round-bottom flask, two gas-washing bottles, a gas jar and an NaOH beaker, plus a row of chlorine water test tubes along the front of the bench
发生 → 除杂（如需要）→ 收集 → 尾气（如需要）: Generation → purification (if needed) → collection → exhaust (if needed)
教材 p.49「实验室中制取气体装置的设计」: Textbook p.49 “Designing lab apparatus for preparing gases”
发生装置看反应物的状态和反应条件：固体 MnO₂ 加液体浓盐酸，还要加热。: The generation unit depends on the reactants' states and conditions: solid MnO₂ plus liquid conc. HCl, with heating.
除杂装置看杂质的性质：浓盐酸挥发出的 HCl 极易溶于水。: The purification unit depends on the impurity's properties: HCl evaporating from conc. HCl is very soluble in water.
收集装置看密度、溶解性、是否与水反应：Cl₂ 比空气重、又溶于水。: The collection unit depends on density, solubility and reaction with water: Cl₂ is denser than air and dissolves in water.
去掉分段思路：只能照着图抄装置，换一种气体就不知道怎么设计了。: Drop the part-by-part approach and you can only copy the diagram, with no idea how to design for a different gas.
常考「制气装置由哪几部分组成、按什么顺序连」：发生 → 除杂 → 收集 → 尾气: Common: “what parts make up a gas preparation apparatus and in what order”: generation → purification → collection → exhaust.
教材图 2-17 的三段是「发生 → 收集 → 尾气」；p.49 方法导引允许「: The three parts in textbook Fig. 2-17 are “generation → collection → exhaust”; the method guide on p.49 allows adding purification “if needed” and gives the order: generation → purification → collection → exhaust. This lesson makes purification and drying each a removable part.
不点酒精灯，氯气还出得来吗？: Without lighting the alcohol lamp, will chlorine still come out?
把「加热」打开，盯住烧瓶里的 MnO₂ 和导管里的气流: Turn on “Heating” and watch the MnO₂ in the flask and the gas flow in the tube
气泡从无到有：产生速率 0.0 → 30.0 mL/min，MnO₂ 表面开始持: Bubbles appear from nothing: generation rate 0.0 → 30.0 mL/min, the MnO₂ surface starts bubbling steadily, and gas-flow balls travel along the tube to the next part
反应物是固体 MnO₂ 加液体浓盐酸，方程式条件写「△」。: The reactants are solid MnO₂ and liquid conc. HCl; the equation condition is written “△”.
不加热时产生速率 0.0 mL/min：装置再完整，也没有气体出来。: Without heating the generation rate is 0.0 mL/min: however complete the apparatus, no gas comes out.
加热用酒精灯垫石棉网，让烧瓶均匀受热，别局部暴沸。: Heat with an alcohol lamp over asbestos gauze so the flask heats evenly and doesn't bump locally.
去掉加热：整条链一个气泡都不出，后面的除杂、收集全是空跑。: Skip heating and the whole chain produces not a single bubble; purification and collection run empty.
方程式漏写「△」是最高频失分点，和「稀盐酸不反应」常一起考。: Leaving out “△” in the equation is the most common way to lose marks, often tested together with “dilute HCl doesn't react”.
浓盐酸与 MnO₂ 的反应要加热才进行：不加热，滴多少浓盐酸都不产生 Cl₂。: Conc. HCl and MnO₂ only react when heated: without heat, no amount of conc. HCl produces Cl₂.
一直滴下去，为什么氯气会自己停下来？: Keep adding acid, so why does the chlorine stop by itself?
什么都不用动，看约一分钟：盐酸越来越稀，气泡越来越少，最后停住: Don't touch anything and watch for about a minute: the acid gets more dilute, bubbles get fewer, and finally stop
盐酸质量分数从 37 % 降到 20 %，产生速率从 30.0 mL/min 掉: HCl mass fraction drops from 37 % to 20 %, generation rate falls from 30.0 mL/min to 0.0 mL/min, and the point on the curve slides to 20 % and hits zero
浓盐酸 37 % → 20 % 后停止（稀盐酸与 MnO₂ 不反应）: Conc. HCl 37 % → stops at 20 % (dilute HCl doesn't react with MnO₂)
实际要多称 MnO₂: Weigh out extra MnO₂ in practice
反应消耗 HCl，浓盐酸逐渐变稀，稀盐酸与 MnO₂ 不再反应。: The reaction consumes HCl, so the conc. acid gradually gets dilute, and dilute HCl no longer reacts with MnO₂.
所以 HCl 不能完全反应：教材第 7 题问「为什么实际称取的 MnO₂ 要适当: So the HCl can't all react: textbook Question 7 asks “why weigh out somewhat more MnO₂ than the theoretical amount?” — this is the answer.
按教材第 7 题算：4 瓶 100 mL 氯气理论上需要 MnO₂ 1.427: By textbook Question 7: 4 bottles of 100 mL chlorine theoretically need 1.427 g MnO₂ (about 1.43 g).
去掉这一步的观察：会误以为「多加盐酸就多产气」，按 HCl 完全反应算产量，结果: Skip this observation and students assume “more acid means more gas” and calculate yield as if all HCl reacts, getting too high a result.
「浓盐酸不能完全反应」与「MnO₂ 过量还是盐酸过量」是同一道题的两问。: “Conc. HCl can't fully react” and “is MnO₂ or HCl in excess” are two parts of the same question.
浓盐酸在反应中变稀，稀盐酸与 MnO₂ 不反应，气体自己就停了——这正是实际称取: Conc. HCl gets dilute during the reaction, dilute HCl doesn't react with MnO₂, and the gas stops by itself — which is why somewhat more MnO₂ than the theoretical amount is weighed out in practice.
挥发的 HCl 跟着氯气跑进集气瓶，会怎样？: What happens if volatile HCl follows the chlorine into the gas jar?
先把「饱和食盐水」这一段拆掉（错误操作），盯住集气瓶纯度和进气管口: First remove the “Saturated salt water” part (wrong operation) and watch the gas jar purity and the inlet tube
Gas jar purity 99.4 % → 87.9 %, HCl impurity 0.5 % → 12.0 %; reconnect and it recovers at once
HCl(g) 溶于饱和食盐水: HCl(g) dissolves in saturated salt water
长进短出 · 进气管口低于液面: Long in, short out · inlet tube below the liquid surface
除杂装置依据「杂质的性质」选：HCl 极易溶于水，用饱和食盐水洗掉它。: Choose the purification unit by “the impurity's properties”: HCl is very soluble in water, so wash it out with saturated salt water.
不能用 NaOH、NaHCO₃、碱石灰除 HCl：它们会连 Cl₂ 一起吸收。: NaOH, NaHCO₃ or soda lime can't be used to remove HCl: they absorb the Cl₂ too.
洗气瓶必须长进短出：进气管口低于液面，气体才能被洗涤液充分接触。: Gas-washing bottles must be long in, short out: only with the inlet below the liquid does the gas fully contact the washing liquid.
去掉这一段：集气瓶纯度掉到 87.9 %，瓶里混着 HCl，做性质实验会被白雾干: Skip this part and gas jar purity drops to 87.9 %; the jar contains HCl, and its white mist interferes with property experiments.
「除 HCl 能不能用 NaOH 溶液」几乎年年出现，答案是能除 HCl 但会把: “Can NaOH solution remove HCl?” comes up almost every year; the answer: it removes HCl but eats the Cl₂ too.
浓盐酸易挥发，气流里带着 HCl；饱和食盐水吸收 HCl，同时抑制 Cl₂ 溶解: Conc. HCl is volatile, so the gas stream carries HCl; saturated salt water absorbs HCl while suppressing Cl₂ dissolving, so the first bottle washes out HCl.
为什么先除 HCl 再干燥，两个瓶子能对调吗？: Why remove HCl first and dry afterwards? Can the two bottles be swapped?
把「浓硫酸干燥」这一段拆掉（错误操作），看集气瓶内壁和两条布条: Remove the “Conc. H₂SO₄ drying” part (wrong operation) and watch the gas jar's inner wall and the two cloth strips
纯度 99.4 % → 97.0 %，水汽 0.1 % → 2.5 %，集气瓶内: Purity 99.4 % → 97.0 %, water vapor 0.1 % → 2.5 %, mist forms on the jar's inner wall; moist chlorine bleaches the colored strip, the dry strip doesn't change
顺序不能颠倒：先干燥再经食盐水，水汽又被带回来。: The order can't be reversed: drying first and then passing through salt water brings water vapor back.
浓硫酸只除水汽，不与 Cl₂ 反应，所以放在除 HCl 之后。: Conc. H₂SO₄ only removes water vapor and doesn't react with Cl₂, so it goes after HCl removal.
干氯气不能漂白干燥布条：真正漂白的是 Cl₂ 与水生成的 HClO。: Dry chlorine can't bleach a dry cloth strip: what really bleaches is the HClO formed by Cl₂ and water.
去掉这一段：水汽 2.5 %，布条褪色，会误判「Cl₂ 有漂白性」。: Skip this part and water vapor is 2.5 %, the strip fades, and you'd wrongly conclude “Cl₂ bleaches”.
「干燥氯气无漂白性、湿润氯气有」是必考设问，配 p.51 第 3 题那样的装置图: “Dry chlorine doesn't bleach, moist chlorine does” is a must-know question, paired with an apparatus diagram like p.51 Question 3.
干燥要放在除 HCl 之后；而且只有湿氯气（真正起作用的是它溶水生出的 HClO: Drying goes after HCl removal; and only moist chlorine (really the HClO it forms in water) fades colored cloth strips.
氯气比空气重还是轻？导管该插到哪儿？: Is chlorine heavier or lighter than air? Where should the tubes go?
在 3D 里点一下集气瓶，看两根导管分别插到哪里: Click the gas jar in 3D and see where each of the two tubes reaches
进气导管伸到瓶底、出气短管在瓶口；瓶里黄绿色从下往上积；氯气密度 3.214 g: The inlet tube reaches the bottom, the short outlet tube is at the mouth; yellow-green gas builds up from the bottom; chlorine's density of 3.214 g/L is 2.486 times air's 1.293 g/L
向上排空气法 · 长进短出: Upward air displacement · long in, short out
密度判据：3.214 / 1.293 = 2.486 > 1，氯气比空气重，所以: Density test: 3.214 / 1.293 = 2.486 > 1, chlorine is heavier than air, so use upward air displacement (both densities at 0 ℃).
不能用排水法：25 ℃ 时 1 体积水溶解约 2 体积 Cl₂，还与水反应。: Can't collect over water: at 25 ℃, 1 volume of water dissolves about 2 volumes of Cl₂, and it also reacts with water.
长进短出才能把瓶里的空气顶干净：短进长出只会在瓶口打转。: Only long in, short out pushes all the air out of the jar: short in, long out just swirls around the mouth.
去掉这一段（改成排水法）：氯气溶掉、又混进水汽，白制一场。: Skip this part (collect over water instead) and the chlorine dissolves and picks up water vapor — all that work wasted.
「能不能用排水法收集氯气」与「进气导管长还是短」是成对出现的两道判断。: “Can chlorine be collected over water?” and “is the inlet tube long or short?” come as a pair of judgment questions.
密度比空气大的气体用向上排空气法：气体从瓶底进、把空气从瓶口顶出，所以进气长、出: Gases denser than air use upward air displacement: the gas enters at the bottom and pushes air out of the mouth, so the inlet is long and the outlet short; Cl₂ dissolves in and reacts with water, so it can't be collected over water.
最后一个烧杯不接，会出什么事？: What happens if the last beaker isn't connected?
把「NaOH 尾气吸收」拆掉（错误操作），看导管口和顶栏状态: Remove “NaOH exhaust absorption” (wrong operation) and watch the tube outlet and the top bar status
排放从 0.0 升到 30.0 mL/min，风险条 0.00 → 1.00、顶: Emission rises from 0.0 to 30.0 mL/min, the risk bar goes 0.00 → 1.00 and the top bar turns to “Alarm”; the tube outlet lifts and a yellow-green cloud pours from the jar mouth
多余氯气必须吸收，不能排空: Excess chlorine must be absorbed, not released
氯气有毒：吸入少量刺激鼻咽喉黏膜、引起咳嗽和胸部疼痛，吸入大量会中毒致死。: Chlorine is toxic: a little irritates the nose and throat and causes coughing and chest pain; a lot can be fatal.
NaOH 吸收氯气生成 NaCl 与 NaClO，这也正是漂白液的制取原理。: NaOH absorbs chlorine to form NaCl and NaClO — also how bleach solution is made.
不用澄清石灰水：Ca(OH)₂ 浓度太低，不能确保把氯气吸收完全。: Don't use clear limewater: Ca(OH)₂ is too dilute to be sure of absorbing all the chlorine.
去掉这一段：30.0 mL/min 全部排空，这样的实验在教室里根本不能做。: Skip this part and all 30.0 mL/min escapes; such an experiment simply can't be done in a classroom.
「尾气为什么用 NaOH 而不是澄清石灰水」是经典简答题。: “Why use NaOH for exhaust instead of clear limewater?” is a classic short-answer question.
多余的 Cl₂ 必须用 NaOH 溶液吸收：Cl₂ + 2NaOH = NaCl: Excess Cl₂ must be absorbed with NaOH solution: Cl₂ + 2NaOH = NaCl + NaClO + H₂O; without exhaust treatment, chlorine goes straight into the classroom.
把氯气溶进水里，水里到底有几种东西？: Dissolve chlorine in water: how many different things are actually in the water?
把光照时间从 0 s 推到 150 s，盯住 pH、c(Cl⁻) 和示意放大里的: Push the light exposure time from 0 s to 150 s and watch pH, c(Cl⁻) and the particles in the zoomed diagram
pH 2.10 → 1.62、c(Cl⁻) 200 → 850 mg/L、氧气体: pH 2.10 → 1.62, c(Cl⁻) 200 → 850 mg/L, oxygen volume fraction 20.0 % → 21.1 %; in the zoomed diagram HClO keeps decomposing and releasing O₂, and the yellow-green in the tube fades
次氯酸见光分解，氯水久置会失效: Hypochlorous acid decomposes in light; chlorine water loses its effect over time
氯水里有 Cl₂、H₂O、HClO，以及 H⁺、Cl⁻、ClO⁻；漂白消毒的是: Chlorine water contains Cl₂, H₂O, HClO, and H⁺, Cl⁻, ClO⁻; it's HClO that bleaches and disinfects, not Cl₂.
次氯酸见光分解：2HClO —光照→ 2HCl + O₂↑。: Hypochlorous acid decomposes in light: 2HClO —light→ 2HCl + O₂↑.
所以光照后 pH 下降、c(Cl⁻) 上升、氧气体积分数上升，三个方向都能测出来: So after light exposure pH falls, c(Cl⁻) rises and oxygen volume fraction rises — all three directions can be measured.
去掉这一步：只知道「氯水能漂白」，解释不了久置失效，也说不清 AgNO₃ 检验的: Skip this step and students only know “chlorine water bleaches”, can't explain why it loses effect over time, or where the white precipitate in the AgNO₃ test comes from.
教材图 2-16 的三个量（pH、c(Cl⁻)、φ(O₂)）变化方向，是新课标情: The directions of change of the three quantities in textbook Fig. 2-16 (pH, c(Cl⁻), φ(O₂)) are the prototype for new-curriculum context questions.
氯水里有 Cl₂、H₂O、HClO 和 H⁺、Cl⁻、ClO⁻；次氯酸见光分解出: Chlorine water contains Cl₂, H₂O, HClO and H⁺, Cl⁻, ClO⁻; hypochlorous acid decomposes in light to O₂ and HCl, so pH falls, c(Cl⁻) rises and oxygen increases, and chlorine water left standing loses its effect.
给你一套装置，能不能一次收满一瓶又纯又安全的氯气？: Given this apparatus, can you collect a full bottle of pure, safe chlorine in one go?
纯度 ≥ 99.0 %、集气瓶收够 95 mL、尾气接好、风险在警戒线下，保持: Purity ≥ 99.0 %, at least 95 mL collected, exhaust connected, risk below the warning line, hold for 12 seconds; partway through, the drip rate will be set to 0
达标横幅「一瓶纯净的氯气」；第 6 秒滴加速率被拨到 0，要重新拨回 40 滴/: Target-met banner “A bottle of pure chlorine”; at 6 seconds the drip rate is set to 0, and you must set it back to 40 drops/min to continue collecting
少接除杂：纯度 87.9 %，不达标。: Purification missing: purity 87.9 %, target not met.
少接干燥：纯度 97.0 %，不达标。: Drying missing: purity 97.0 %, target not met.
关掉尾气：风险立刻满格 1.00，顶栏转报警。: Exhaust off: risk immediately maxes out at 1.00 and the top bar turns to alarm.
没有新内容：前八步的条件同时满足，就是通过。: Nothing new: meet the conditions of the first eight steps at the same time and you pass.
满分结构：装置顺序 + 每段作用 + 纯度判据，三条一起写。: Full-marks structure: apparatus order + each part's role + purity criterion, written together.
考核没有新结论：五段各就位、加热、滴加速率合适，才收得到 ≥ 99.0 % 的氯: The test adds no new conclusion: only with all five parts in place, heating on and a suitable drip rate do you collect ≥ 99.0 % chlorine.
未达标：滴加归零: Not met: drip rate at zero
未达标：浓盐酸已变稀: Not met: conc. HCl has become dilute
Shift goal: purity ≥ 99.0 %, collected ≥ 95 mL, exhaust connected, risk < 0.4, hold for 12 seconds
实验室制氯气的化学方程式，正确的是: The correct equation for preparing chlorine in the lab is
教材 p.48：MnO₂ + 4HCl(浓) —△→ MnCl₂ + Cl₂↑: Textbook p.48: MnO₂ + 4HCl(conc.) —△→ MnCl₂ + Cl₂↑ + 2H₂O. Neither the “△” condition nor “conc.” can be left out; balance by electrons gained and lost, 1 : 2.
制得的氯气总比按 HCl 完全反应算出的理论量少，主要原因是: The chlorine obtained is always less than the theoretical amount calculated as if all HCl reacted, mainly because
浓盐酸在反应中变稀，稀盐酸与 MnO₂ 不反应: Conc. HCl gets dilute during the reaction, and dilute HCl doesn't react with MnO₂
收集时氯气比空气重: Chlorine is heavier than air during collection
教材 p.52 第 7(2)：随反应进行浓盐酸变稀，稀盐酸与 MnO₂ 不再反应: Textbook p.52 Question 7(2): as the reaction proceeds the conc. HCl gets dilute, and dilute HCl no longer reacts with MnO₂, so extra MnO₂ is weighed out in practice.
除去氯气中混有的少量 HCl，应选用的试剂是: To remove a small amount of HCl from chlorine, the reagent to use is
HCl 极易溶于水，饱和食盐水还能抑制 Cl₂ 溶解；其余三种都会把 Cl₂ 一: HCl is very soluble in water, and saturated salt water also suppresses Cl₂ dissolving; the other three would absorb the Cl₂ as well.
关于除杂与干燥的顺序，正确的是: The correct order for purification and drying is
先用浓硫酸干燥，再经饱和食盐水除 HCl: Dry with conc. H₂SO₄ first, then remove HCl with saturated salt water
先除 HCl，再用浓硫酸干燥: Remove HCl first, then dry with conc. H₂SO₄
两瓶可以对调，效果一样: The two bottles can be swapped with the same effect
只要接了浓硫酸就不必除 HCl: With conc. H₂SO₄ connected there's no need to remove HCl
先干燥再经食盐水洗气，水汽又被带回来；所以顺序是除杂 → 干燥。: Drying first and then washing with salt water brings water vapor back; so the order is purification → drying.
关于氯气的收集，正确的是: Which statement about collecting chlorine is correct?
可用排水法收集: It can be collected over water
用向上排空气法，进气导管伸到瓶底: Use upward air displacement with the inlet tube reaching the bottom of the jar
集气瓶口朝下最稳妥: It's safest with the jar mouth facing down
0 ℃ 时氯气密度 3.214 g/L，约为同温空气 1.293 g/L 的 2: At 0 ℃ chlorine's density is 3.214 g/L, about 2.486 times that of air (1.293 g/L) at the same temperature; and chlorine dissolves in and reacts with water, so use upward air displacement, long in, short out.
多余氯气的处理，正确的是: The correct way to handle excess chlorine is
直接排入空气: Release it directly into the air
Cl₂ + 2NaOH = NaCl + NaClO + H₂O；澄清石灰水浓度: Cl₂ + 2NaOH = NaCl + NaClO + H₂O; clear limewater is too dilute to absorb it all, and water absorbs little and not completely.
氯水光照后，下列变化正确的是: After chlorine water is exposed to light, which change is correct?
pH 下降、c(Cl⁻) 上升、氧气增多: pH falls, c(Cl⁻) rises, oxygen increases
2HClO —光照→ 2HCl + O₂↑：生成强酸 HCl，所以 pH 下降、: 2HClO —light→ 2HCl + O₂↑: strong acid HCl forms, so pH falls and c(Cl⁻) rises, while oxygen is released (textbook Fig. 2-16).
能说明「干燥氯气没有漂白性」的实验现象是: The observation that shows “dry chlorine doesn't bleach” is
湿润有色布条褪色: A moist colored cloth strip fades
干燥有色布条不褪色: A dry colored cloth strip doesn't fade
氯水使石蕊先变红后褪色: Chlorine water turns litmus red, then bleaches it
氯气使湿润淀粉碘化钾试纸变蓝: Chlorine turns moist starch-KI paper blue
干燥氯气接触干燥布条不褪色，说明起漂白作用的是氯气与水反应生成的 HClO（教材: Dry chlorine on a dry strip doesn't fade it, showing that what bleaches is the HClO formed when chlorine reacts with water (textbook p.46 Experiment 2-8, p.51 Question 3).
已加热：MnO₂ 与浓盐酸开始反应，产生氯气: Heated: MnO₂ and conc. HCl start reacting and produce chlorine
已停止加热：不再产生氯气: Heating stopped: no more chlorine produced
拆掉饱和食盐水：HCl 混进气流，集气瓶纯度掉到 87.9 %: Saturated salt water removed: HCl enters the gas stream, gas jar purity drops to 87.9 %
拆掉浓硫酸：湿氯气进瓶，水汽 2.5 %，布条褪色: Conc. H₂SO₄ removed: moist chlorine enters the jar, water vapor 2.5 %, strip fades
拆掉尾气吸收：氯气正在排空，有毒，风险满格: Exhaust absorption removed: chlorine is escaping, it's toxic, risk maxed out
异常：滴加速率被拨到 0——氯气停了，先把它拨回 40 滴/min: Fault: drip rate set to 0 — chlorine has stopped; set it back to 40 drops/min first
已回到参考工况：加热、40 滴/min、除杂干燥与尾气全接好: Back to reference conditions: heated, 40 drops/min, purification, drying and exhaust all connected
达标：一瓶纯净的氯气: Target met: A bottle of pure chlorine
本课目标：把五段装置和加热、滴加速率调到位，收满一瓶 ≥ 99.0 % 的氯气并: Lesson goal: set up all five parts, heating and drip rate, collect a full bottle of ≥ 99.0 % chlorine and hold for 12 seconds; partway through, the drip rate will be set to 0 — find it and set it back.
