影响酶活性的条件 · 3D 互动课件: Conditions Affecting Enzyme Activity · 3D Interactive Lesson
人教版 必修1 第5章第1节「降低化学反应活化能的酶」· 探究·实践「影响酶活性: PEP Required Vol. 1, Ch. 5, Sec. 1 “Enzymes Lower the Activation Energy of Chemical Reactions” · Inquiry & Practice “Conditions Affecting Enzyme Activity”
温度、pH 偏离最适 → 活性降低；过酸过碱或温度过高 → 永久失活: Temperature or pH away from optimum → lower activity; too acidic, too alkaline or too hot → permanent inactivation
同一支酶，为什么放进沸水里就再也救不回来，放进冰水里却还能醒过来？: Why can the same enzyme never be saved after boiling water, yet wake up again after ice water?
温度与 pH 是自变量，其余条件全部固定: Temperature and pH are the independent variables; every other condition is held fixed
一定条件下酶所催化某一化学反应的速率: The rate of a given chemical reaction catalyzed by the enzyme under given conditions
最适条件最高，偏高偏低都明显降低: Highest at the optimum, clearly lower on either side
低温只降活性；过酸过碱与高温破坏结构: Low temperature only lowers activity; extreme pH and high heat destroy the structure
三个实验站 + 一个放大视窗: Three lab stations + one magnified window
整体 · 一张实验台上三组对照，旁边放大到酶与底物: Overview · three controlled setups on one lab bench, with a close-up of enzyme and substrate beside them
改一个条件，看颜色、气泡、读数和曲线一起动: Change one condition and watch the color, bubbles, readings and curves move together
全对！温度与 pH 两条曲线、可逆与永久失活你都分清了。: All correct! You've sorted out the temperature and pH curves, and reversible vs. permanent inactivation.
建议回看主线：先看两条曲线（最适最高），再看「处理过还能不能回来」这三步。: Suggested review: first the two curves (highest at the optimum), then the three steps on “can it come back after treatment?”
温度站：保温后加碘液 —— 深蓝 = 淀粉还在: Temperature station: add iodine after incubation; dark blue = starch still there
pH 站：气泡快慢 = 分解快慢（示意倍数）: pH station: bubble rate = breakdown rate (schematic multiple)
处理与回温台：先处理 10 min，再回到 37 ℃ 测: Treatment and rewarming stand: treat for 10 min first, then measure back at 37 ℃
示意放大：凹槽 = 活性位点，形状与底物相配: Magnified schematic: the groove = active site, its shape matches the substrate
这支酶在 pH 2 里泡过 10 min：永久失活: This enzyme soaked in pH 2 for 10 min: permanently inactivated
两支试管各 2 mL 3% 淀粉溶液 + 2 mL 2% 淀粉酶溶液：一支固定泡: Two test tubes, each with 2 mL of 3% starch solution + 2 mL of 2% amylase solution: one fixed in the 37 ℃ control cup, one in the adjustable water bath cup (0–70 ℃); after incubation, add iodine and check the color
三支试管各 2 mL 3% H₂O₂：pH 7 对照 / 可调 pH 实验 /: Three test tubes, each with 2 mL of 3% H₂O₂: pH 7 control / adjustable-pH test / blank with only distilled water; add 2 drops of 20% liver extract to each and compare bubble rates
一支先在 0 ℃ 或 90 ℃ 里放过 10 min 的淀粉酶试管，现在站在 3: An amylase tube that first spent 10 min at 0 ℃ or 90 ℃ now stands in a 37 ℃ warm-water cup; beside it are the ice-water and hot-water cups just used
有凹槽的酶团块咬住 6 颗珠的淀粉长链，切成 3 条 2 颗珠的麦芽糖；凹槽形状: An enzyme blob with a groove grips a 6-bead starch chain and cuts it into 3 two-bead maltose pieces; groove shape = substrate shape (magnified schematic)
教材只给了一张材料清单，这些东西摆成什么样的实验才说得清？: The textbook only gives a list of materials. How should they be set up so the experiment proves its point?
四个单元都在：两支试管泡在两个水浴杯里、三支 H₂O₂ 试管、三个杯子加一支「回: All four units are in place: two test tubes in two water bath cups, three H₂O₂ tubes, three cups plus one “rewarmed” tube, and a magnified round window above the bench. Main reading 100.0 %
酶活性 = 一定条件下酶所催化某一化学反应的速率: Enzyme activity = the rate of a given chemical reaction catalyzed by the enzyme under given conditions
2% 淀粉酶 · 3% 淀粉 · 3% H₂O₂ · 20% 肝脏研磨液 · 碘: 2% amylase · 3% starch · 3% H₂O₂ · 20% liver extract · iodine · 0.01 mol/L hydrochloric acid and NaOH
三个站对应教材 p.83 的分工建议：淀粉酶测温度（碘液显色）、过氧化氢酶测 p: The three stations follow the division of labor suggested on textbook p.83: amylase tests temperature (iodine color), catalase tests pH (bubbles); each station watches its own observation.
每站都有对照管，而且只有要测的那一个变量不同 —— 这就是变量控制。: Each station has a control tube, and only the variable being tested differs; that's controlling variables.
读数把「颜色深不深、气泡多不多」换成一个 0–100 的数，才比得出差多少。: The reading turns “how dark the color, how many bubbles” into a number from 0 to 100, so you can compare how much they differ.
去掉对照：看不出颜色变浅是酶的功劳，还是本来就会变。: Without the control: you can't tell whether the color fading is due to the enzyme or would happen anyway.
实验设计题常问「自变量是什么、因变量怎么检测、其余条件怎么控制」。: Experimental design questions often ask “what's the independent variable, how is the dependent variable measured, how are other conditions controlled.”
教材的材料清单要摆成「一个变量一组对照」：测温度用淀粉酶加碘液，测 pH 用过氧: The textbook's materials list must be set up as “one variable, one controlled comparison”: amylase with iodine for temperature, catalase with bubbles for pH; then check one more thing separately: can a treated enzyme recover?
同一支酶，为什么换一个水温，碘液的颜色就不一样了？: Same enzyme, so why does the iodine color change when you change the water temperature?
把水浴从 37 ℃ 拖到 0 ℃（冰水），盯住碘液颜色和主读数；再拖到 70 ℃: Drag the water bath from 37 ℃ to 0 ℃ (ice water) and watch the iodine color and main reading; then drag to 70 ℃ to see the other end
水浴从 37 ℃ 拖到 0 ℃：活性由 100.0 % 掉到 4.2 %，碘液由: Water bath from 37 ℃ to 0 ℃: activity falls from 100.0 % to 4.2 %, and the iodine goes from “no blue” to dark blue (starch not fully hydrolyzed); at 70 ℃ only 7.2 % is left. Throughout the textbook's 35–40 ℃ range, it's ≥ 95 %
淀粉水解 → 麦芽糖；淀粉 + 碘 → 蓝: Starch hydrolysis → maltose; starch + iodine → blue
3% 淀粉溶液 2 mL + 2% 淀粉酶溶液 2 mL · 保温后加碘液: 3% starch solution 2 mL + 2% amylase solution 2 mL · add iodine after incubation
两支管只有水浴温度不同：酶量、淀粉量、保温时间全都一样。: The two tubes differ only in water bath temperature: amount of enzyme, amount of starch and incubation time are all the same.
颜色来自「碘液 + 淀粉」，不是酶的颜色 —— 不显蓝说明淀粉已经被水解完了。: The color comes from “iodine + starch,” not from the enzyme; no blue means the starch has been fully hydrolyzed.
测温度为什么不用过氧化氢酶？教材 p.77 的 2 号管只放在 90 ℃ 水浴里: Why not use catalase to test temperature? Textbook p.77's tube 2 is only placed in a 90 ℃ water bath with no catalyst and still bubbles: heating alone breaks down H₂O₂, so the bubbles can't be pinned on the enzyme (inferred from the textbook).
去掉温度这一站：学生只会背「温度影响酶活性」，说不出「有一个最适温度、两侧都掉」: Without the temperature station: students just memorize “temperature affects enzyme activity” and can't say “there's an optimum, and it drops on both sides.”
常考「最适温度两侧活性都下降」；也要分清「低温时活性低」和「失活」不是一回事。: Commonly tested: “activity drops on both sides of the optimum temperature”; also tell apart “low activity at low temperature” and “inactivation,” which are not the same thing.
其他条件相同时，温度偏高或偏低酶活性都明显降低；最适温度在教材给的动物酶区间 3: With other conditions the same, enzyme activity drops clearly when the temperature is too high or too low; the optimum lies within the textbook's 35~40 ℃ range for animal enzymes (set to 37 ℃ in this lesson, with activity taken as 100 %).
把溶液调酸，气泡为什么几乎不冒了？: Why do the bubbles almost stop when you make the solution acidic?
把溶液从 pH 6.8 拖到 pH 2，看三支管的气泡与主读数；再拖到 pH 1: Drag the solution from pH 6.8 to pH 2 and watch the bubbles in the three tubes and the main reading; then drag to pH 12 to see the alkaline side
pH 从 6.8 拖到 2：活性 100.0 % → 0.1 %，气泡先后停下，: pH from 6.8 to 2: activity 100.0 % → 0.1 %, bubbles stop one after another, bubble rate reading 1.00× → 0.00×; at 12, only 0.0 % is left too
3% H₂O₂ 各 2 mL + 2 滴 20% 肝脏研磨液 · 0.01 mo: 3% H₂O₂ 2 mL each + 2 drops of 20% liver extract · pH adjusted with 0.01 mol/L hydrochloric acid and NaOH
三支管只有 pH 与「有没有酶」不同：pH 7 对照、可调 pH 实验、加蒸馏水: The three tubes differ only in pH and “whether there's enzyme”: pH 7 control, adjustable-pH test, distilled-water blank.
气泡是 H₂O₂ 分解放出的 O₂；没有酶的那支几乎不冒泡，说明气泡确实来自酶。: The bubbles are O₂ released as H₂O₂ breaks down; the tube without enzyme barely bubbles, showing the bubbles really come from the enzyme.
去掉 pH 这一站：学生会以为 pH 只分强弱，不知道它也有最适值。: Without the pH station: students think pH is only about strong vs. weak, not knowing it also has an optimum.
常与温度并列考「酶为什么需要适宜条件」；胃蛋白酶最适 pH 1.5 是唯一的单点: Often tested alongside temperature as “why enzymes need suitable conditions”; pepsin's optimum pH of 1.5 is the one exception.
其他条件相同时，pH 偏高或偏低酶活性都明显降低；最适 pH 在教材给的动物酶区: With other conditions the same, enzyme activity drops clearly when the pH is too high or too low; the optimum lies within the textbook's 6.5~8.0 range for animal enzymes (set to 6.8 in this lesson).
在 90 ℃ 里放过 10 分钟的酶，回到 37 ℃ 还能干活吗？: Can an enzyme that spent 10 minutes at 90 ℃ still work back at 37 ℃?
把「预处理」拨到 90 ℃：这支酶先在 90 ℃ 里放了 10 min，现在回到: Set “Pretreatment” to 90 ℃: this enzyme first spent 10 min at 90 ℃ and is now measured back at 37 ℃
回到 37 ℃、pH 6.8 下活性 0.0 %、碘液深蓝、状态读「永久失活」；: Back at 37 ℃, pH 6.8: activity 0.0 %, iodine dark blue, status reads “permanently inactivated”; in the magnified window, the enzyme's groove has collapsed shut
高温 → 空间结构遭到破坏 → 永久失活: High heat → spatial structure destroyed → permanent inactivation
90 ℃ 水浴 10 min，再回到 37 ℃ · pH 6.8 测: 90 ℃ water bath for 10 min, then measured back at 37 ℃ · pH 6.8
回来的是同一个 37 ℃，唯一的区别是「之前被处理过」。: It's back at the same 37 ℃; the only difference is that it “was treated before.”
0.0 % 不是「测不出来」，是这支酶已经没有活性了。: 0.0 % doesn't mean “can't be measured”; it means this enzyme no longer has any activity.
读数「永久失活」、碘液的深蓝、放大窗里闭合的凹槽，是同一件事的三种写法。: The “permanently inactivated” reading, the dark blue iodine, and the closed groove in the magnified window are three ways of saying the same thing.
去掉这一步：学生会把「高温活性低」和「低温活性低」当成一回事，于是写出「低温也会: Without this step: students treat “low activity at high temperature” and “low activity at low temperature” as the same, and write the wrong conclusion that “low temperature also inactivates enzymes.”
「高温使酶变性失活、不可恢复」是必考句，也常问「酶制剂为什么不能煮沸」。: “High temperature denatures and inactivates enzymes irreversibly” is a must-know sentence; a common question is “why can't enzyme preparations be boiled?”
温度过高会使酶的空间结构遭到破坏，使酶永久失活 —— 回到最适温度也恢复不了。: Excessive temperature destroys the enzyme's spatial structure and inactivates it permanently; even returning to the optimum temperature can't restore it.
A5.3、A7.2、B2.1 常数 DENAT + D4: A5.3, A7.2, B2.1 constant DENAT + D4
在 0 ℃ 里冻了 10 分钟，它为什么还能醒过来？: After 10 minutes chilled at 0 ℃, why can it still wake up?
把「预处理」拨到 0 ℃：先在冰水里放 10 min，再回到 37 ℃ 测，与上: Set “Pretreatment” to 0 ℃: 10 min in ice water first, then measured back at 37 ℃; compare with the previous setting
回到 37 ℃、pH 6.8 下活性 100.0 %，与「未处理」完全一样，碘液: Back at 37 ℃, pH 6.8: activity 100.0 %, exactly the same as “untreated,” and the iodine shows no blue; in the magnified window the groove isn't deformed; it was just moving slowly before
低温 → 活性很低，但空间结构稳定 → 可恢复: Low temperature → very low activity, but the spatial structure stays stable → recoverable
0 ℃ 冰水 10 min，再回到 37 ℃ · pH 6.8 测: 0 ℃ ice water for 10 min, then measured back at 37 ℃ · pH 6.8
低温改的是「反应有多快」，不是「酶还在不在」。: Cold changes “how fast the reaction goes,” not “whether the enzyme is still intact.”
100.0 % 与未处理的 100.0 % 一模一样 —— 这就是「可恢复」的判: 100.0 % is identical to the untreated 100.0 %; that's the test for “recoverable.”
和第 4 步对着看：同一个读数、两种命运，区别只在处理温度。: Compare with Step 4: same reading, two fates; the only difference is the treatment temperature.
去掉这一步：学生会把冰箱当成「毁酶」的地方，也说不出酶制剂为什么要冷藏。: Without this step: students think of the fridge as a place that “destroys enzymes,” and can't explain why enzyme preparations are refrigerated.
「低温活性低但结构稳定、可恢复」常在选择题里与高温对调来考。: “Low activity at low temperature but stable structure, recoverable” often appears in multiple-choice questions swapped with high temperature.
在 0 ℃ 左右时酶的活性很低，但空间结构稳定，在适宜的温度下酶的活性会升高 —: At around 0 ℃ enzyme activity is very low, but the spatial structure is stable, and activity rises again at a suitable temperature; cold isn't inactivation, which is why enzyme preparations are best stored cold.
A5.3、A7.1、B2.1 常数 DENAT + D4: A5.3, A7.1, B2.1 constant DENAT + D4
酶到底把淀粉怎么了？: What exactly does the enzyme do to the starch?
点一下台面上方那个放大圆窗，看酶怎么咬住淀粉链: Click the magnified round window above the bench and see how the enzyme grips the starch chain
窗里：有凹槽的酶团块咬住 6 颗珠的淀粉长链，切成 3 条 2 颗珠的短链；活性: In the window: an enzyme blob with a groove grips a 6-bead starch chain and cuts it into 3 two-bead short chains; the higher the activity, the more often it cuts. Switch back to Step 4's 90 ℃ treatment setting and the groove collapses shut on the spot, never binding again
酶靠空间结构（活性位点）与底物结合: Enzymes bind substrates through their spatial structure (active site)
示意放大 · 6 颗珠的淀粉 → 3 条 2 颗珠的麦芽糖: Magnified schematic · 6-bead starch → 3 two-bead maltose pieces
酶不是把淀粉「搬走」，是把长链切成短链。: The enzyme doesn't “carry away” the starch; it cuts the long chain into short ones.
凹槽（活性位点）的形状要与底物的形状对上，这才叫锁-钥匙。: The shape of the groove (active site) has to match the shape of the substrate; that's what lock and key means.
低温时凹槽没坏，只是酶和底物都动得慢，碰上的机会就少。: At low temperature the groove isn't damaged; enzyme and substrate just move slowly, so they meet less often.
去掉这一步：可逆与不可逆只能靠背，学生说不出「为什么高温就回不来」。: Without this step: reversible vs. irreversible can only be memorized, and students can't say “why heat means no coming back.”
「酶的空间结构决定活性」是解释一切影响因素的根，简答题常要这一句。: “The enzyme's spatial structure determines its activity” is the root that explains every influencing factor; short-answer questions often want this sentence.
酶靠形状干活：凹槽的形状与底物相配，底物嵌进去才被切开。空间结构一破坏，凹槽没了: Enzymes work by shape: the groove matches the substrate, and only a substrate that fits in gets cut. Once the spatial structure is destroyed, the groove is gone, and so is the activity; that's what “permanent inactivation” looks like.
把这支酶泡在过酸的溶液里十分钟，再调回最适 pH，它还干活吗？: Soak this enzyme in an overly acidic solution for ten minutes, then bring it back to the optimum pH. Does it still work?

过酸、过碱 → 空间结构遭到破坏 → 永久失活: Too acidic, too alkaline → spatial structure destroyed → permanent inactivation
pH 2（或 pH 12）处理 10 min，再回到 37 ℃ · pH 6.8: Treated at pH 2 (or pH 12) for 10 min, then measured back at 37 ℃ · pH 6.8
错误操作就在这一步：酶被泡在没调好 pH 的溶液里 → 过酸过碱 → 永久失活: The wrong operation is in this step: the enzyme was soaked in a solution whose pH wasn't adjusted → too acidic or alkaline → permanent inactivation → still 0.0 % back at 6.8 (untreated is 100.0 %).
现象与读数一起变：气泡 0.00×、放大窗里凹槽塌陷闭合、状态读「永久失活」。: Observations and readings change together: bubbles 0.00×, the groove in the magnified window collapses shut, status reads “permanently inactivated.”
想接着做要「复位本步」或把预处理拨回「未处理」—— 那等于换一支新鲜酶。: To carry on, “Reset this step” or set pretreatment back to “Untreated,” which amounts to using a fresh enzyme.
去掉这一步：学生会把过酸过碱当成「可逆的降低」，在实验报告里写「pH 调回 7: Without this step: students treat extreme pH as a “reversible drop” and write in lab reports that “it recovered once pH was set back to 7.”
常与高温并列考「哪些条件使酶变性失活、能不能恢复」；这里的后果是归零，不是偏高偏: Often tested alongside high temperature: “which conditions denature enzymes, and can they recover?” The consequence here is dropping to zero, not just high or low.
过酸、过碱会使酶的空间结构遭到破坏，使酶永久失活；它和温度过高是同一种后果，调回: Being too acidic or too alkaline destroys the enzyme's spatial structure and inactivates it permanently; it's the same consequence as excessive heat, and returning to optimum conditions can't save it.
考核：把这个酶的活性调到 95 % 以上: Test: get this enzyme's activity above 95 %
把温度和 pH 同时调到最适、预处理留在「未处理」，让活性 ≥ 95 % 并保持: Set both temperature and pH to the optimum and leave pretreatment at “Untreated,” so activity is ≥ 95 % and holds for 15 seconds; partway through, the water bath will be raised to 60 ℃

只调对温度不够：pH 拖到 6.0 就掉到 93.6 %，出界。: Getting temperature right isn't enough: drag pH to 6.0 and it drops to 93.6 %, out of range.
只调对 pH 也不够：温度 30 ℃ 只有 87.8 %。: Getting pH right isn't enough either: at 30 ℃ it's only 87.8 %.
拨到 0 ℃ / 90 ℃ / 过酸 / 过碱任一处档，活性会掉到 0 或不合规: Switch to any of 0 ℃ / 90 ℃ / too acidic / too alkaline and activity drops to 0 or fails; the only fix is switching back to “Untreated.”
满分结构：温度落在教材区间 + pH 落在教材区间 + 变量控制（预处理没弄坏酶: Full-marks structure: temperature within the textbook range + pH within the textbook range + controlled variables (pretreatment didn't damage the enzyme).
考核没有新结论：温度落在教材 35–40 ℃、pH 落在教材 6.5–8.0、酶: The test has no new conclusion: temperature within the textbook's 35–40 ℃, pH within the textbook's 6.5–8.0, and an enzyme not damaged by treatment; all three must hold at once to meet the target.

横轴 温度 / ℃ · 虚线＝最适 pH: Horizontal axis temperature / ℃ · dashed = optimum pH

把同一支酶分别放在 0 ℃ 和 90 ℃ 里各 10 min，再都拿到 37 ℃: The same enzyme is kept at 0 ℃ and at 90 ℃ for 10 min each, then both are measured at 37 ℃. The result:
0 ℃ 的恢复、90 ℃ 的不恢复: The 0 ℃ one recovers, the 90 ℃ one doesn't
90 ℃ 的恢复、0 ℃ 的不恢复: The 90 ℃ one recovers, the 0 ℃ one doesn't

酶在 pH 2 的溶液里放一会儿，再调回最适 pH，活性会: After an enzyme sits in a pH 2 solution for a while and is then brought back to the optimum pH, its activity will
教材 p.84：过酸、过碱或温度过高，会使酶的空间结构遭到破坏，使酶永久失活 —: Textbook p.84: excessive acidity, alkalinity or heat destroys the enzyme's spatial structure and inactivates it permanently; returning to the optimum pH can't save it.
关于酶活性与温度、pH 的关系，正确的是: Which statement about enzyme activity, temperature and pH is correct?
温度越高活性越高: The higher the temperature, the higher the activity
在最适宜的温度和 pH 下活性最高，偏高偏低都明显降低: Activity is highest at the optimum temperature and pH, and clearly lower on either side
pH 只影响酶的数量，不影响活性: pH only affects the amount of enzyme, not its activity
教材 p.84 的结论句：在最适宜的温度和 pH 条件下酶的活性最高；温度和 p: Conclusion on textbook p.84: enzyme activity is highest at the optimum temperature and pH; if temperature or pH is too high or too low, activity drops clearly.
胃蛋白酶随食糜进入小肠（pH 约 7.6）后，活性会: After pepsin enters the small intestine with chyme (pH about 7.6), its activity will
教材 p.84 给的是「动物体内的酶最适 pH 大多 6.5~8.0，但胃蛋白酶: Textbook p.84 says “most enzymes in animals have an optimum pH of 6.5~8.0, but pepsin's optimum pH is 1.5”; p.82 also says gastric juice is pH 0.9~1.5 and intestinal juice pH 7.6. Different enzymes have different optimum conditions, and activity drops sharply away from their own optimum.
如果改用「出现同一结果所需的时间」来表示酶活性并画曲线，最适温度处的位置是: If enzyme activity is expressed as “the time needed to reach the same result” and plotted, where does the optimum temperature sit?
教材 p.83 的进一步探究就是用「出现同一结果所需的时间」表示活性：最适条件下: The further inquiry on textbook p.83 expresses activity as “the time needed to reach the same result”: the reaction is fastest and the time shortest at the optimum, so the optimum on this curve is a trough, not a peak. The two kinds of vertical axis can't be mixed on one graph.
绝大多数酶是蛋白质，少数 RNA 也有催化功能: Most enzymes are proteins; a few RNAs also have catalytic function
酶只能在细胞外起作用: Enzymes can only work outside cells
酶能降低活化能，也能改变产物的最终量: Enzymes lower activation energy and can also change the final amount of product
教材 p.81：绝大多数酶是蛋白质；p.80 明说 20 世纪 80 年代发现少: Textbook p.81: most enzymes are proteins; p.80 states that in the 1980s a few RNAs were found to have biological catalytic function. Enzymes only change the reaction rate, not the final amount of product.

过碱（pH 12）处理 10 min 后回到最适 pH：永久失活: Treated too alkaline (pH 12) for 10 min, then back to optimum pH: permanently inactivated

已回到参考工况：37 ℃ · pH 6.8 · 未处理: Back to reference conditions: 37 ℃ · pH 6.8 · untreated

选择性必修 1 · 第二章 实验活动 1（并 CHEM-34）: Elective Vol. 1 · Ch. 2 Lab Activity 1 (with CHEM-34)
改变一个条件，凭什么说平衡「往哪边移」？: Change one condition — how can we say which way the equilibrium “shifts”?
Q 与 K 比大小：Q<K 正向、Q>K 逆向: Compare Q with K: Q<K forward, Q>K reverse
加反应物使 Q 变小 → 正向；减反应物使 Q 变大 → 逆向: Adding a reactant makes Q smaller → forward; removing a reactant makes Q larger → reverse
温度改的是 K 本身：放热反应升温 K 变小 → 逆向: Temperature changes K itself: for an exothermic reaction, heating makes K smaller → reverse
读数要同温同体积才可比：温度没恢复就读会偏高: Readings are comparable only at the same temperature and volume: reading before the temperature recovers gives a high value
实验管加料、对照管不加；红色看 c(FeSCN²⁺): Add reagent to the test tube, not the control; the red shows c(FeSCN²⁺)
加碱变黄、加酸变橙；颜色看 c(CrO₄²⁻): Base turns it yellow, acid turns it orange; the color shows c(CrO₄²⁻)
1 号球在水浴里变温、2 号球 25 ℃ 对照: Bulb 1 changes temperature in the water bath; bulb 2 is the 25 ℃ control
当前体系的微粒按浓度等比放大（示意）: Particles of the current system, scaled in proportion to concentration (schematic)
颜色不变，反应就停了吗？: If the color stops changing, has the reaction stopped?
拖视角绕台面看一圈: Drag to rotate the view around the bench
四个站依次排开：红色的铁管、橙黄的铬管、红棕的两只球、示意放大的粒子框——粒子一: The four stations in a row: the red iron tubes, the orange-yellow chromium tubes, the two red-brown bulbs, and the schematic particle box — the particles keep converting both ways
平衡是动态的：v(正) = v(逆) ≠ 0，各组分浓度不变。「颜色不变」不等于: Equilibrium is dynamic: v(forward) = v(reverse) ≠ 0, and the concentrations of all components stay constant. “The color doesn’t change” does not mean the reaction stopped; to judge “which way it shifts”, compare Q and K.
两支试管的颜色不再变化，是达到平衡，不是反应停止。: The two tubes’ colors no longer change: equilibrium has been reached, the reaction has not stopped.
示意放大里粒子一直双向转化：v(正) = v(逆) ≠ 0。: In the schematic zoom the particles keep converting both ways: v(forward) = v(reverse) ≠ 0.
判断「是否平衡、往哪边移」，看浓度商 Q 与平衡常数 K 的大小。: To judge “is it at equilibrium, and which way does it shift”, compare the reaction quotient Q with the equilibrium constant K.
去掉这一步：学生会把「颜色不变」当成「反应停了」。: Without this step: students take “the color doesn’t change” to mean “the reaction stopped”.
常考「化学平衡状态的本质特征」——动态平衡、浓度不变、v(正) = v(逆)。: Often tested: “the essential features of chemical equilibrium” — dynamic equilibrium, constant concentrations, v(forward) = v(reverse).
再滴 5 滴 FeCl₃，红为什么更深？: Add 5 more drops of FeCl₃ — why does the red get deeper?
把滴数拖到 5 滴（教材做法），看红色和读数: Drag the drop count to 5 (the textbook method) and watch the red and the reading
c(FeSCN²⁺) 由 0.379 升到 1.095 mmol/L，红色明显加: c(FeSCN²⁺) rises from 0.379 to 1.095 mmol/L, and the red clearly deepens; Q = 26 < K = 146; the control tube is unchanged
加反应物的瞬间 Q 变小（< K），正反应速率大于逆反应，平衡正向移动；达到新平: The moment a reactant is added, Q gets smaller (< K), the forward rate exceeds the reverse rate, and the equilibrium shifts forward; at the new equilibrium Q returns to K.
0.05 mol/L FeCl₃ 5 滴 · 按 1:1 式读数: 0.05 mol/L FeCl₃ 5 drops · read by the 1:1 equation
加 Fe³⁺ 的瞬间，Q = 26 < K = 146。: The moment Fe³⁺ is added, Q = 26 < K = 146.
正向移动后 c(FeSCN²⁺) 从 0.379 升到 1.095 mmol/L: After the forward shift, c(FeSCN²⁺) rises from 0.379 to 1.095 mmol/L.
新平衡时 Q 又等于 K：K 只随温度变。: At the new equilibrium Q equals K again: K changes only with temperature.
去掉这一步：只看颜色加深，说不出「为什么」深。: Without this step: students only see the color deepen and can’t say “why”.
常考「加 FeCl₃ 后红色加深，用 Q 与 K 解释」。: Often tested: “after adding FeCl₃ the red deepens — explain with Q and K”.
加铁粉后红色为什么变浅？: Why does the red fade after iron powder is added?
加入少量铁粉，看红色褪去: Add a little iron powder and watch the red fade
c(FeSCN²⁺) 由 1.095 掉到 0.072 mmol/L，几乎褪色；: c(FeSCN²⁺) falls from 1.095 to 0.072 mmol/L, almost colorless; Q = 1.5×10³ > K = 146 (reverse)
铁粉把 Fe³⁺ 还原成 Fe²⁺（2Fe³⁺ + Fe = 3Fe²⁺），c(: Iron powder reduces Fe³⁺ to Fe²⁺ (2Fe³⁺ + Fe = 3Fe²⁺), so c(Fe³⁺) falls → Q grows above K → the equilibrium shifts in reverse.
少量铁粉 · c(Fe³⁺) 降到 5 %（示意）: A little iron powder · c(Fe³⁺) down to 5 % (schematic)
铁粉把 Fe³⁺ 还原，c(Fe³⁺) 变小。: Iron powder reduces Fe³⁺, so c(Fe³⁺) falls.
红色几乎褪掉（0.072 mmol/L），说明 FeSCN²⁺ 分解了。: The red almost disappears (0.072 mmol/L), showing that FeSCN²⁺ has dissociated.
去掉这一步：只讲「加料正向」，遇到「变浅」就答不出方向。: Without this step: students only learn “adding shifts forward” and can’t give the direction when the color “fades”.
易错：以为铁粉直接把 FeSCN²⁺ 还原——真正被消耗的是 Fe³⁺。: Common mistake: thinking iron powder reduces FeSCN²⁺ directly — what is actually used up is Fe³⁺.

c(CrO₄²⁻) 由 0.152 升到 178 mmol/L，橙色转黄；Q =: c(CrO₄²⁻) rises from 0.152 to 178 mmol/L, orange turns yellow; Q = 5.2×10⁻³⁵ < K = 2.3×10⁻¹⁵ (forward); the control tube stays orange
加碱中和了 H⁺，Q 变小（< K）→ 平衡正向移动：Cr₂O₇²⁻ + H₂O: The base neutralizes H⁺, so Q gets smaller (< K) → the equilibrium shifts forward: Cr₂O₇²⁻ + H₂O ⇌ 2CrO₄²⁻ + 2H⁺ moves toward forming CrO₄²⁻ (yellow).
铬管里是 Cr₂O₇²⁻，橙色。: The chromium tube holds Cr₂O₇²⁻, which is orange.

对照管（不加碱）仍然是橙色。: The control tube (no base) stays orange.

教材原文「减小生成物浓度，平衡正向移动」的标准例证。: The standard example of the textbook statement “lowering a product’s concentration shifts the equilibrium forward”.
接着滴 H₂SO₄，为什么又变回橙色？: Now add H₂SO₄ — why does it turn orange again?
从「NaOH 5 滴」往左拖到「H₂SO₄ 5 滴」，看黄色又变回橙色: Drag left from “NaOH 5 drops” to “H₂SO₄ 5 drops” and watch the yellow turn back to orange
c(CrO₄²⁻) 由 178 掉到 1.1×10⁻⁵ mmol/L，溶液回到橙: c(CrO₄²⁻) falls from 178 to 1.1×10⁻⁵ mmol/L, and the solution returns to orange; Q = 4.1×10⁻⁷ > K (reverse)
加酸使 c(H⁺) 变大，Q 变大（> K）→ 平衡逆向移动，溶液回到 Cr₂O: Adding acid raises c(H⁺), so Q gets larger (> K) → the equilibrium shifts in reverse, and the solution returns to the orange of Cr₂O₇²⁻.
加酸使 c(H⁺) 变大，Q 变大 → 逆向，回到橙色。: Adding acid raises c(H⁺), Q gets larger → reverse, back to orange.
与上一步合起来：同一支管，加碱变黄、加酸变橙。: Together with the last step: in the same tube, base turns it yellow and acid turns it orange.
两个方向都只是 Q 与 K 的比较，不需要另记一套规律。: Both directions are just a comparison of Q and K — no separate rule to memorize.
去掉这一步：只有一半规律，学生会以为「加什么都正向」。: Without this step: students only have half the rule and think “adding anything shifts forward”.

内外筒结构：内件耐高温，外筒只承压、保持较低壁温: Inner/outer shell design: the internals withstand high temperature, while the outer shell only bears pressure and stays at a lower wall temperature
定期测壁温壁厚、无损探伤，触媒按周期更换: Regular wall temperature and thickness checks, nondestructive testing, and scheduled catalyst replacement
记住这条链：升温 → 触媒烧结 → 塔体蠕变 → 破裂。温度不是越高越好。: Remember this chain: overheating → catalyst sinters → tower creeps → rupture. Hotter is not better.
A. 为提高平衡含量持续升压: A. Keep raising pressure to increase the equilibrium content
平衡确实在往右走，但收益递减，风险在累加。: The equilibrium does shift right, but returns diminish while risk builds up.
B. 越过 38 MPa 设计压力: B. Pressure passes the 38 MPa design limit
法兰垫片塑性变形，螺栓松弛，密封先失效。: Flange gaskets deform plastically, bolts loosen, and the seals fail first.
可燃气体报警，塔壁环向应力超过材料许用值。: Flammable-gas alarm; hoop stress in the tower wall exceeds the material's allowable value.
泄漏的 H₂、NH₃ 遇火源，装置停车、人员撤离。: Leaked H₂ and NH₃ meet an ignition source; the unit shuts down and staff evacuate.
安全阀 + 爆破片：超压自动泄放，定压在 38 MPa 以下: Safety valve + rupture disc: overpressure vents automatically, set below 38 MPa
压力联锁：自动降压并停压缩机: Pressure interlock: automatically depressurizes and stops the compressor
设计压力留足裕量，操作压强控制在 10～30 MPa: Ample design-pressure margin; operating pressure kept at 10–30 MPa
定期测壁厚、无损探伤，重点查焊缝与法兰: Regular wall-thickness checks and nondestructive testing, focusing on welds and flanges
记住这条链：升压 → 密封失效 → 氢泄漏 → 破裂。压强有物理上限，也有成本上: Remember this chain: pressure up → seals fail → hydrogen leaks → rupture. Pressure has a physical limit as well as a cost limit.

本课目标：把氨产率稳在 24 t/h 以上并保持 15 秒；把参数推过 640: Lesson goal: keep ammonia output above 24 t/h for 15 seconds; pushing the settings past 640 ℃ or 38 MPa causes an accident — understand the review before doing the emergency repair.
工业合成氨所需 H₂ 的主要来源是: The main source of H₂ for industrial ammonia synthesis is
天然气（或煤）与水蒸气反应: reaction of natural gas (or coal) with steam
空气液化分馏: liquefaction and fractional distillation of air
工业上用天然气（或煤）与水蒸气在高温、催化剂下转化制 H₂；电解水耗电太多、成本: Industry makes H₂ by reacting natural gas (or coal) with steam at high temperature over a catalyst; electrolyzing water uses too much electricity and costs too much. Liquefying and fractionally distilling air gives N₂.
原料气进入合成塔前必须净化，主要原因是: The feed gas must be purified before entering the synthesis tower, mainly to
硫化物、CO 等杂质会占据铁触媒的活性位点使其中毒失效。净化不改变平衡，只保护催: Sulfides, CO and other impurities occupy the active sites of the iron catalyst and poison it. Purification doesn't change the equilibrium; it only protects the catalyst.
变换反应 CO(g) + H₂O(g) ⇌ CO₂(g) + H₂(g) 在合成: In the ammonia process, the role of the shift reaction CO(g) + H₂O(g) ⇌ CO₂(g) + H₂(g) is
除去 CO，同时增加 H₂ 并调好氢氮比: to remove CO while adding H₂ and adjusting the hydrogen-to-nitrogen ratio
变换反应把 CO 转化成容易除掉的 CO₂，同时每 1 mol CO 多产 1: The shift reaction turns CO into easily removed CO₂, and each 1 mol of CO gives an extra 1 mol of H₂, helping to bring H₂∶N₂ close to 3.
合成氨采用 10～30 MPa 的高压，主要理由是: The main reason ammonia synthesis uses high pressures of 10–30 MPa is
高压使平衡常数增大: high pressure increases the equilibrium constant
气体分子数减少，加压使平衡正移，同时加快反应: the number of gas molecules decreases, so pressure shifts the equilibrium forward and also speeds up the reaction
高压使反应变为放热: high pressure makes the reaction exothermic
4 mol 气体 → 2 mol 气体，加压使平衡向生成 NH₃ 的方向移动，浓: 4 mol gas → 2 mol gas, so higher pressure shifts the equilibrium toward NH₃, and the higher concentration also speeds up the reaction. The equilibrium constant changes only with temperature.
选择 400～500 ℃ 的主要原因是: The main reason for choosing 400–500 ℃ is
正反应吸热，需要高温: the forward reaction is endothermic and needs high temperature
兼顾速率与限度，且铁触媒在此温度活性较好: it balances rate and extent, and the iron catalyst is fairly active at this temperature
正反应放热，低温平衡更有利但速率太慢、触媒活性不足；400～500 ℃ 是速率、: The forward reaction is exothermic, so low temperature favors the equilibrium but the rate is too slow and the catalyst isn't active enough; 400–500 ℃ is a compromise among rate, extent and catalyst activity.
使用铁触媒后，合成氨反应的: With an iron catalyst, the ammonia synthesis reaction's
催化剂同等程度加快正、逆反应，只缩短达到平衡的时间；平衡常数只随温度变化，ΔH: A catalyst speeds up the forward and reverse reactions equally and only shortens the time to reach equilibrium; the equilibrium constant changes only with temperature, and ΔH is set by the initial and final states.
把未反应的 N₂、H₂ 循环送回合成塔，主要目的是: The main purpose of recycling unreacted N₂ and H₂ back to the synthesis tower is to
循环让没反应的原料再进塔，提高总利用率（可达约 97%），但平衡转化率只由温度、: Recycling sends unreacted feedstock back into the tower, raising overall utilization (up to about 97%), but the equilibrium conversion is set only by temperature, pressure and ratio, and isn't changed by recycling.
既能加快合成氨反应速率、又能使平衡正向移动的措施是: Which measure both speeds up ammonia synthesis and shifts the equilibrium forward?
增大压强同时提高浓度（速率加快）并使气体分子数减少的方向（生成氨）移动。升温只加: Increasing pressure raises the concentrations (faster rate) and shifts the equilibrium toward fewer gas molecules (forming ammonia). Raising temperature only speeds up the rate, while the equilibrium shifts backward; a catalyst doesn't shift the equilibrium; removing ammonia only shifts the equilibrium and doesn't change the rate.
达产成功：产率稳定在 24 t/h 以上: Target met: output steady above 24 t/h
净化关闭：硫进入合成塔，触媒开始中毒: Purification off: sulfur enters the synthesis tower and the catalyst starts to be poisoned
净化恢复：活性回到已降低的上限: Purification restored: activity returns to its lowered ceiling
触媒未装：几乎不生成氨（平衡值不变）: No catalyst loaded: almost no ammonia forms (equilibrium value unchanged)
抢修完成：换塔、复位参数，重新开车: Repair complete: tower replaced, settings reset, plant restarted
循环已投用：未反应气送回压缩机，利用率回到 97 %: Recycling on: unreacted gas goes back to the compressor, utilization returns to 97%
循环已切断：未反应气放空，利用率大幅下跌: Recycling off: unreacted gas is vented, utilization drops sharply
异常：床层 385 ℃ 低于教材区间（400–500 ℃）——先升温再谈达标: Fault: bed at 385 ℃, below the textbook range (400–500 ℃) — raise the temperature before going for the target
紧急停车：泄压降温，联锁解除: Emergency shutdown: depressurized and cooled, interlock released

这是合成塔 R-401：立式厚壁圆筒，塔顶椭圆封头压在主法兰上，一串螺栓把内件检: This is synthesis tower R-401: an upright thick-walled cylinder with an elliptical top head pressed onto the main flange, where a ring of bolts seals the access opening for the internals; at the bottom it stands on a skirt support on the platform.

四段床的温度并不一样：越往上越热，一段 {0} ℃ 到四段 {1} ℃；叠加层的: The four beds aren't the same temperature: the higher, the hotter, from {0} ℃ in Bed 1 to {1} ℃ in Bed 4; the deeper the amber in the overlay, the hotter the bed.
两层床之间有一股冷激气从塔壁斜插进来，把下一段的入口温度压回去，反应才不至于沿塔: Between two beds, a stream of quench gas enters at an angle through the tower wall, pulling the next bed's inlet temperature back down so the reaction doesn't keep heating up all the way through the tower.
反应后的气体在塔底的分离空间汇成一股，沿中心管一路上升，从塔顶接管出塔；夹带的触: Reacted gas collects into one stream in the separation space at the bottom, rises up the center pipe and leaves through the top nozzle; entrained catalyst dust also settles in this bottom space.

太阳短波 → 地面长波 → 大气逆辐射: Solar shortwave → ground longwave → atmospheric counter-radiation
太阳晒了一整天的地面，为什么白天先热起来，夜里又凉得那么快——大气到底替地面留住: The ground bakes in the sun all day — so why does it warm up first by day and then cool so fast at night? How much heat does the atmosphere actually hold in for the ground?
太阳短波进来，小部分被大气吸收和反射: Solar shortwave comes in; a small part is absorbed and reflected by the atmosphere
到达地面的被地面吸收，地面增温: What reaches the ground is absorbed, and the ground warms up
地面以长波向上传热，波长是太阳的 19.94 倍: The ground sends heat upward as longwave radiation, at 19.94 times the Sun's wavelength
大气吸收长波，再向下发射大气逆辐射 → 保温: The atmosphere absorbs longwave and sends atmospheric counter-radiation back down → keeps the ground warm
云 · 温室气体 · 地表 · 有无大气 → 昼夜温差: Clouds · greenhouse gases · surface · with or without atmosphere → day–night temperature range
大气上界到地面之间的这一层：吸收、反射、逆辐射都发生在这里: The layer between the top of the atmosphere and the ground: absorption, reflection and counter-radiation all happen here
昼与夜共用的这条地面：吸收太阳辐射、向上发长波: The ground strip shared by day and night: it absorbs solar radiation and emits longwave upward
没有大气的对照面：没有削弱、也没有逆辐射: Control surface with no atmosphere: no weakening and no counter-radiation
太阳辐射穿过大气，少掉的那部分去哪了？: Solar radiation passes through the atmosphere — where does the missing part go?
拖动视角绕剖面台看一圈：浅黄色的短波箭头从上方竖直射下，一部分在大气上界折返: Drag to rotate the view around the cross-section bench: pale yellow shortwave arrows shoot straight down from above, and some turn back at the top of the atmosphere
入射的年均 340 W·m⁻² 里，云与大气反射 75、大气吸收短波 80、到达: Of the annual mean 340 W·m⁻² coming in, clouds and atmosphere reflect 75, the atmosphere absorbs 80 of shortwave, and 185 reaches the ground; total weakening 155, 155 + 185 = 340
参考工况 · 全球年平均（AR6 图 7.2）: Reference conditions · global annual mean (AR6 Fig. 7.2)
教材图 2.9 / 2.10 不画云，这里的云 = 参考工况云量 65 %: Textbook Figs. 2.9 / 2.10 don't draw clouds; the clouds here = reference cloud cover 65%
大气中的一切物理过程都伴随着能量转换，太阳辐射是地球大气最重要的能量来源。: Every physical process in the atmosphere involves energy conversion, and solar radiation is the most important energy source for Earth's atmosphere.
投射到地球上的太阳辐射要穿过厚厚的大气才能到达地面：小部分被大气吸收或反射，大部: Solar radiation reaching Earth must pass through a thick atmosphere to reach the ground: a small part is absorbed or reflected by the atmosphere, and most reaches Earth's surface.
大气削弱 = 大气吸收 + 云与大气的反射 = 80 + 75 = 155（地面: Atmospheric weakening = atmospheric absorption + reflection by clouds and atmosphere = 80 + 75 = 155 (the 25 reflected by the ground isn't atmospheric weakening — that belongs to the ground side, covered in Step 2).
去掉这一步：学生会以为太阳辐射「原样」到地面，「削弱 + 到达地面 = 入射」这: Without this step: students think solar radiation reaches the ground “unchanged”, and the balance “weakening + reaching the ground = incoming” has nothing to stand on.
常考：削弱作用 = 吸收 + 反射；说成「只有吸收」是错项。: Frequently tested: weakening = absorption + reflection; “absorption only” is a wrong option.
太阳辐射在传播过程中小部分被大气吸收或反射、大部分到达地面；大气削弱 = 大气吸: As solar radiation travels, a small part is absorbed or reflected by the atmosphere and most reaches the ground; atmospheric weakening = atmospheric absorption 80 + reflection by clouds and atmosphere 75 = 155, not absorption alone.
facts A2.1-b、A7-8；B2.1 式 1、表 1-1、B2.4 D7: facts A2.1-b, A7-8; B2.1 Eq. 1, Table 1-1, B2.4 D7
到达地面的太阳辐射，全都用来升温了吗？: Is all the solar radiation that reaches the ground used to warm it?
把「地表反照率」拖到新雪 0.80，看地面吸收的那一段怎么缩、向上反射的那一段怎: Drag “Surface albedo” to fresh snow 0.80 and watch the ground-absorbed part shrink and the upward-reflected part grow
到达地面仍是 185，但地面吸收由 160 掉到 37、向上的反射那一支明显变长: Radiation reaching the ground is still 185, but ground absorption drops from 160 to 37 and the upward reflection branch grows clearly longer; daytime warming falls from 5.8 ℃ to 1.3 ℃
到达地球表面的太阳辐射，被地面吸收和反射——不是全部用来升温。: Solar radiation reaching Earth's surface is absorbed and reflected by the ground — not all of it goes into warming.
吸收的那一部分才让地面增温；反射掉的那一部分回到大气与宇宙空间。: Only the absorbed part warms the ground; the reflected part goes back to the atmosphere and space.
反照率是地表自己的属性：全球平均 0.135，新雪 0.80，所以雪面上地面吸收: Albedo is a property of the surface itself: global mean 0.135, fresh snow 0.80, so on snow the ground absorbs only 37 W·m⁻².
去掉这一步：学生会把「到达地面 185」直接当成「升温用的 185」，白天地面吸: Without this step: students treat “185 reaching the ground” as “185 used for warming”, and the daytime ground-absorption path breaks.
易错：认为到达地面的太阳辐射全部用于升温（事实表 A7-10）。: Common mistake: thinking all solar radiation reaching the ground is used for warming (fact sheet A7-10).
到达地面的太阳辐射被地面吸收和反射，只有吸收的那部分增温；反照率越高、吸收越少。: Solar radiation reaching the ground is absorbed and reflected by it, and only the absorbed part warms it; the higher the albedo, the less is absorbed.
facts A2.1-c、A7-10；B2.1 式 2、表 1-1 与第 5 行: facts A2.1-c, A7-10; B2.1 Eq. 2, Table 1-1 and row 5, B2.4 D8
地面一升温，凭什么自己就往上「发热」？: Once the ground warms up, why does it start “giving off heat” upward on its own?
看 12 秒：橙色长波从地面升起，读出地面的温度与最强波长，和太阳的比一比: Watch for 12 seconds: orange longwave rises from the ground; read the ground's temperature and peak wavelength and compare them with the Sun's
地面温度 289.4 K、最强波长 10.01 µm；太阳 0.50 µm；两者: Ground temperature 289.4 K, peak wavelength 10.01 µm; Sun 0.50 µm; they differ by a factor of 19.94 — that's where shortwave and longwave come from
由实验得知：物体的温度越高，辐射中最强部分的波长越短；反之则波长越长。: Experiments show that the hotter an object, the shorter the wavelength of the strongest part of its radiation; the cooler, the longer.
太阳有效温度 5772 K，最强波长 0.50 µm，落在可见光；地面约 289: The Sun's effective temperature is 5772 K, peak wavelength 0.50 µm, in visible light; the ground is about 289.4 K, peak wavelength 10.01 µm, in the infrared.
波长差 19.94 倍，这才是「太阳辐射是短波、地面辐射是长波」的来历；地面长波: A wavelength difference of 19.94 times is the real reason “solar radiation is shortwave, ground radiation is longwave”; ground longwave is the main, direct heat source for the air near the ground.
去掉这一步：「短波 / 长波」成了背下来的标签，下一步为什么要挑波长吸收就没了根: Without this step: “shortwave / longwave” become memorized labels, and the next step's wavelength-selective absorption loses its basis.
易错：把地面辐射说成短波（温度越低，最强波长越长）。: Common mistake: calling ground radiation shortwave (the lower the temperature, the longer the peak wavelength).
温度越高、辐射最强部分的波长越短；地面温度远低于太阳，所以太阳辐射是短波、地面辐: The higher the temperature, the shorter the wavelength of the strongest radiation; the ground is far cooler than the Sun, so solar radiation is shortwave and ground radiation is longwave, and ground longwave is the main direct heat source for the air near the ground.

析出率 32.6 % → 2.0 %，产量 24.0 → 0.1 t/h（未取整: Precipitation yield 32.6 % → 2.0 %, output 24.0 → 0.1 t/h (unrounded 0.14): crystals in the tower barely grow and the material flow thins out
碱性溶液才吸得住大量 CO₂；没有 NH₃ 析出率只剩 2 %（课件设定）: Only a basic solution can absorb lots of CO₂; without NH₃ the precipitation yield is just 2 % (lesson setting)
NH₃ 极易溶于水，氨水显碱性，CO₂ 被大量吸收并以 HCO₃⁻ 的形式存在。: NH₃ is extremely soluble in water and ammonia water is basic, so CO₂ is absorbed in large amounts and exists as HCO₃⁻.
先通 CO₂ 则溶液偏酸，HCO₃⁻ 远远不够，大量 CO₂ 随尾气跑掉。: If CO₂ goes in first, the solution is slightly acidic, HCO₃⁻ falls far short, and most of the CO₂ escapes with the tail gas.
本课只演示「吸氨中断」这一种情形（模型没有气体累计量与顺序状态），不与「先通 C: This lesson only demonstrates the “ammonia absorption interrupted” case (the model has no cumulative gas amounts or order state), and doesn't treat it as the same as “CO₂ first, NH₃ added later”.
去掉吸氨：产量 24.0 → 0.1 t/h（未取整 0.14），只剩残余生产。: Without ammonia absorption: output 24.0 → 0.1 t/h (unrounded 0.14), only residual production.
常考「为什么先通 NH₃ 再通 CO₂」：氨水呈碱性，CO₂ 吸收量大增并以 H: Common exam question: why NH₃ before CO₂? Ammonia water is basic, so CO₂ absorption rises sharply and it exists as HCO₃⁻.
NH₃ 让溶液显碱性，CO₂ 才被大量吸收、以 HCO₃⁻ 存在；没有氨，过饱和: NH₃ makes the solution basic so that CO₂ is absorbed in large amounts and exists as HCO₃⁻; without ammonia, supersaturation can't build up and almost nothing precipitates.
生成的 NaHCO₃ 为什么会自己从溶液里掉出来？: Why does the NaHCO₃ that forms drop out of solution on its own?
转动视角，看塔板、自下而上的 CO₂ 气泡柱和塔底晶浆；同时看曲线图上 20 ℃: Rotate the view to see the trays, the rising column of CO₂ bubbles and the slurry at the bottom; also look at the 20 ℃ point on the chart
曲线游标停在 20 ℃：NaHCO₃ 9.6，NH₄HCO₃ 21.7、NaCl: Curve cursor at 20 ℃: NaHCO₃ 9.6, NH₄HCO₃ 21.7, NaCl 35.9, NH₄Cl 37.2; NaHCO₃ is the lowest of the four; crystals in the bottom slurry are growing
判据：NaHCO₃ 达到过饱和（溶解度排序只作定性参考）: Criterion: NaHCO₃ reaches supersaturation (the solubility ranking is only a qualitative reference)
20 ℃ 时 NaHCO₃ 的溶解度 9.6 g/100 g 水，是四种物质里最: At 20 ℃ NaHCO₃ has a solubility of 9.6 g/100 g water, the lowest of the four substances (NH₄HCO₃ 21.7, NaCl 35.9, NH₄Cl 37.2).
真正决定析出的是过饱和：氨盐水里生成的 NaHCO₃ 超过了它的溶解度上限，才以: What really decides precipitation is supersaturation: the NaHCO₃ formed in ammoniated brine exceeds its solubility limit, so it comes out as crystals.
「溶解度最小」只说明它最容易先走到那一步，是定性参考，不是充分条件。: “Lowest solubility” only means it gets there first. It is a qualitative reference, not a sufficient condition.
不做这一步：学生会把「溶解度排序 = 析出判据」当成结论——旧版这条主线改了 5: Without this step: students take “solubility ranking = precipitation criterion” as the conclusion. That is why this thread was revised five times in the old version.
常考「NaHCO₃ 析出说明它难溶吗」：不是，它仍是可溶盐（20 ℃ 9.6 g: Common exam question: does NaHCO₃ precipitating mean it's insoluble? No, it's still a soluble salt (9.6 g/100 g water at 20 ℃); it just reaches supersaturation first in this process's solution.
20 ℃ 时 NaHCO₃ 的溶解度 9.6 g/100 g 水是四种里最小的；: At 20 ℃ NaHCO₃'s solubility, 9.6 g/100 g water, is the lowest of the four, and in ammoniated brine it quickly becomes supersaturated. Supersaturation is the criterion for precipitation; the solubility ranking is only a qualitative reference.
既然温度越低越容易析出，为什么工业上还要控在 25~40 ℃？: If lower temperature makes precipitation easier, why does industry keep it at 25–40 ℃?
把碳化温度拖到 45 ℃，看析出率与产量: Drag the carbonation temperature to 45 ℃ and watch precipitation yield and output

温度越高、过饱和度越小，析出率从 32.6 % 单调降到 21.1 %。: The higher the temperature, the lower the supersaturation, and precipitation yield falls steadily from 32.6 % to 21.1 %.
温度太低反应又太慢（10 ℃ 只有 15.95 t/h），所以工业把碳化控在 2: Too low a temperature makes the reaction too slow (only 15.95 t/h at 10 ℃), so industry keeps carbonation at 25–40 ℃ and removes heat by cooling.
不控温：塔内一路升到 55 ℃，产量只剩 13.81 t/h（约额定的 58 %: Without temperature control: the tower climbs to 55 ℃ and output drops to 13.81 t/h (about 58 % of rated).
常考「碳化温度为什么不能太高」：溶解度变大、过饱和变小，析出率下降；同时氨挥发增: Common exam question: why can't carbonation run too hot? Solubility rises, supersaturation falls, and precipitation yield drops; more ammonia also escapes.
升温溶解度变大、过饱和变小，析出率单调下降；但温度太低动力学跟不上（10 ℃ 只: Heating raises solubility and lowers supersaturation, so precipitation yield keeps falling; but too cold and the kinetics can't keep up (only 15.95 t/h at 10 ℃), so industry uses 25–40 ℃ with cooling control.

塔底出来的晶浆，怎么变成两种东西？: How does the slurry from the bottom of the tower become two things?
点一下滤碱机，看晶浆分成哪两路: Click the bicarbonate filter and see which two streams the slurry splits into
滤碱机被选中，两条出料箭头亮起：重碱去煅烧、母液去冷析；产量仍是 24.0 t/: The bicarbonate filter is selected and two outlet arrows light up: crude bicarbonate to the calciner, mother liquor to cooling crystallization; output is still 24.0 t/h, since filtration doesn't change the equilibrium
过滤不改变析出量，只分两路：重碱去煅烧、母液去冷析并循环: Filtration doesn't change the amount precipitated; it only splits it in two: crude bicarbonate to calcining, mother liquor to cooling crystallization and recycling
碳化塔底出来的是晶浆：NaHCO₃ 晶体悬浮在母液里。: What leaves the bottom of the carbonation tower is a slurry: NaHCO₃ crystals suspended in mother liquor.
转鼓真空过滤把固体（重碱）与液体（母液）分开，这一步不改变平衡、也不改变析出量。: The rotary drum vacuum filter separates the solid (crude bicarbonate) from the liquid (mother liquor); this step changes neither the equilibrium nor the amount precipitated.
两路各有去处：重碱去煅烧，母液去冷析结晶器捞 NH₄Cl，剩下的母液循环回氨化。: Each stream has its destination: crude bicarbonate goes to the calciner, mother liquor goes to the cooling crystallizer to recover NH₄Cl, and the remaining mother liquor recycles to ammoniation.
去掉过滤：晶体混在母液里一起进煅烧炉，产品里混进 NH₄Cl 等杂质，纯碱不纯。: Without filtration: the crystals go into the calciner mixed with mother liquor, NH₄Cl and other impurities end up in the product, and the soda ash is impure.
常考「过滤后母液去哪」：去冷析结晶器加盐降温析出 NH₄Cl，再循环回氨化，不排: Common exam question: where does the mother liquor go after filtration? To the cooling crystallizer, where salt is added and it is cooled to crystallize NH₄Cl, then back to ammoniation. It isn't discharged.
过滤把重碱（去煅烧）与母液（去冷析结晶器）分开；母液处理后循环回氨化，这一步不改: Filtration separates crude bicarbonate (to the calciner) from mother liquor (to the cooling crystallizer); after treatment the mother liquor recycles to ammoniation. This step doesn't change the amount precipitated.
重碱要烧到什么程度才是纯碱？: How far must crude bicarbonate be heated to become soda ash?

分解率 100 % → 33.3 %，产量 24.0 → 8.00 t/h；再拖: Decomposition 100 % → 33.3 %, output 24.0 → 8.00 t/h; drag further to 100 ℃ and output is 0
工业 160~230 ℃；本课模型 100 ℃ 为 0、160 ℃ 起 100: Industry 160–230 ℃; in this lesson's model, 0 at 100 ℃ and 100 % from 160 ℃ (piecewise rule)
煅烧让 NaHCO₃ 分解：2NaHCO₃ → Na₂CO₃ + H₂O + C: Calcining decomposes NaHCO₃: 2NaHCO₃ → Na₂CO₃ + H₂O + CO₂↑, and the CO₂ released is recovered and reused.
工业区间 160~230 ℃；本课模型里 100 ℃ 分解率为 0、160 ℃: Industrial range 160–230 ℃; in this lesson's model decomposition is 0 at 100 ℃ and 100 % from 160 ℃ (a piecewise rule, not a measured limit).
温度不够，产品里还是小苏打，产量只有 8.00 t/h（分解率 33.3 %）；: If it's not hot enough, the product is still baking soda and output is only 8.00 t/h (33.3 % decomposition); too hot (> 320 ℃) and the material fuses, forcing a shutdown.
去掉煅烧：拿到的是小苏打而不是纯碱，CO₂ 也回不到碳化塔。: Without calcining: you get baking soda instead of soda ash, and the CO₂ can't return to the carbonation tower.
常考「煅烧温度过低 / 过高的后果」：过低分解不完全、产品残留小苏打；过高物料熔: Common exam question: what happens if calcining is too cold or too hot? Too cold: incomplete decomposition, baking soda left in the product; too hot: material fuses and sticks to the walls, forcing a shutdown.
2NaHCO₃ ─△→ Na₂CO₃ + CO₂↑ + H₂O，160 ℃ 以上: 2NaHCO₃ ─△→ Na₂CO₃ + CO₂↑ + H₂O decomposes completely only above 160 ℃; too cold and the product is still baking soda, too hot (> 320 ℃) and it fuses, forcing a shutdown.
母液里剩下的东西，怎么变成氮肥？: How does what's left in the mother liquor become nitrogen fertilizer?
把冷析温度降到 10 ℃，并打开 CO₂ 回收: Lower the cooling crystallization temperature to 10 ℃ and turn on CO₂ recovery
结晶率 15.4 % → 44.0 %；打开回收后供给覆盖率 30 % → 62: Crystallization yield 15.4 % → 44.0 %; with recovery on, supply coverage 30 % → 62 %, output 17.3 → 24.0 t/h
加 NaCl 至饱和 + 降温到 10 ℃ 以下（同离子效应 → 过饱和，物理结: Add NaCl to saturation + cool below 10 ℃ (common-ion effect → supersaturation, physical crystallization)
母液里还剩下 NH₄Cl：加 NaCl 到饱和（同离子效应）再降到 10 ℃ 以: NH₄Cl is left in the mother liquor: add NaCl to saturation (common-ion effect), then cool below 10 ℃, and only then does it supersaturate and crystallize.
冷析温度越低结晶率越高：30 ℃ 15.4 %、20 ℃ 30.0 %、10 ℃: The lower the cooling temperature, the higher the crystallization yield: 15.4 % at 30 ℃, 30.0 % at 20 ℃, 44.0 % at 10 ℃.
析出的 NH₄Cl 是氮肥；煅烧回收的 CO₂ 与合成氨副产一起供碳化，供给覆盖: The NH₄Cl that crystallizes is a nitrogen fertilizer; CO₂ recovered from calcining plus the ammonia plant's by-product feeds carbonation, with 62 % supply coverage, only 30 % with recovery off.
不回收母液：NH₄Cl 随废液排掉，既浪费氮又污染水体——这正是侯氏法比氨碱法多: Without recovering the mother liquor: NH₄Cl goes out with the waste liquid, wasting nitrogen and polluting water. This is exactly the extra gain Hou's process has over the Solvay process.
常考「母液为什么加盐又降温」「CO₂ 从哪来」：同离子效应 + 降温过饱和；CO: Common exam questions: why add salt to the mother liquor and cool it? Where does the CO₂ come from? Common-ion effect + supersaturation by cooling; CO₂ comes from the ammonia plant's by-product and recovery from calcining crude bicarbonate.
母液加 NaCl 到饱和（同离子效应）再降到 10 ℃ 以下，NH₄Cl 才过饱: Add NaCl to the mother liquor until saturated (common-ion effect), then cool below 10 ℃, and NH₄Cl supersaturates and crystallizes into nitrogen fertilizer; CO₂ recovered from calcining plus the ammonia plant's by-product feeds carbonation. That is the “combined” part.

达标要五段同时守住：吸氨开、碳化 25~40 ℃、煅烧 160~230 ℃、冷析: To meet the target, all five stages must hold at once: ammonia absorption on, carbonation 25–40 ℃, calcining 160–230 ℃, cooling ≤ 15 ℃ (relaxed to 15 ℃ in this lesson for easier operation, setting), recycling on.
产量 = 析出率 × 碳化程度 × 循环 × 分解率，任何一项塌下来产量就掉一个: Output = precipitation yield × degree of carbonation × recycling × decomposition; if any one factor collapses, output drops a notch.

达产不是某一个旋钮的事：只调一个滑块拿不到 22 t/h。: Full output isn't about one knob: adjusting just one slider won't get you to 22 t/h.
综合考点：把「顺序、过饱和、分解、循环」四条串起来解释这一班为什么达产（或为什么: Combined exam point: link “order, supersaturation, decomposition, recycling” to explain why this shift reached full output (or didn't).
达产 = 每一段都守在区间里：顺序对了、温度对了、分解完全、母液和 CO₂ 都循: Full output = every stage held within its range: right order, right temperatures, complete decomposition, and both mother liquor and CO₂ recycled.
煅烧 > 320 ℃ 才会熔结停车: Only calcining > 320 ℃ causes fusing and shutdown
让纯碱产量 ≥ 22 t/h 并保持 15 s（碳化 25~40 ℃、煅烧 16: Keep soda ash output ≥ 22 t/h for 15 s (carbonation 25–40 ℃, calcining 160–230 ℃, cooling ≤ 15 ℃, ammonia absorption and recycling both on)
吸氨中断：氨盐水里没有 NH₃，CO₂ 吸收不住，析出率只剩 2 %: Ammonia absorption interrupted: no NH₃ in the ammoniated brine, CO₂ isn't absorbed, precipitation yield down to 2 %
吸氨恢复：溶液重新显碱性，CO₂ 吸收与析出回到正常: Ammonia absorption restored: the solution is basic again, and CO₂ absorption and precipitation are back to normal
CO₂ 回收投用：煅烧气回到碳化，供给覆盖率 62 %: CO₂ recovery on: calciner gas returns to carbonation, supply coverage 62 %
CO₂ 回收停用：只剩合成氨副产，供给覆盖率 30 %: CO₂ recovery off: only the ammonia plant's by-product left, supply coverage 30 %

侯氏制碱为什么先把盐水变成氨盐水，再通 CO₂？: In Hou's process, why is the brine turned into ammoniated brine before CO₂ is passed in?
氨水显碱性，CO₂ 吸收量大增并以 HCO₃⁻ 存在: Ammonia water is basic, so CO₂ absorption rises sharply and it exists as HCO₃⁻
NH₃ 能把 NaCl 直接变成 NaHCO₃: NH₃ converts NaCl directly into NaHCO₃
为了把盐水里的钙镁离子沉淀掉: To precipitate the calcium and magnesium ions in the brine
为了让溶液降温、便于析出: To cool the solution so precipitation is easier
NH₃ 使溶液显碱性，CO₂ 被大量吸收并以 HCO₃⁻ 形式存在，NaHCO₃: NH₃ makes the solution basic, so CO₂ is absorbed in large amounts and exists as HCO₃⁻, which is what lets NaHCO₃ supersaturate and precipitate (A4, A5.2).
侯氏法比氨碱法革除了哪两步？: Which two steps of the Solvay process did Hou's process eliminate?
侯氏法不用石灰窑取 CO₂、也不用石灰乳蒸氨，因此不产生含 CaCl₂ 的蒸氨废: Hou's process uses no lime kiln to get CO₂ and no milk of lime to distill ammonia, so it produces no CaCl₂-containing ammonia-still waste (A2.2).
碳化塔里气液为什么逆流（CO₂ 从塔底上、氨盐水从塔顶下）？: Why do gas and liquid flow counter-current in the carbonation tower (CO₂ rising from the bottom, ammoniated brine falling from the top)?
浓度差最大，CO₂ 吸收更充分: The concentration difference is largest, so CO₂ is absorbed more fully
为了让 NaHCO₃ 溶解度变小: To lower the solubility of NaHCO₃
逆流接触时气相与液相的浓度差最大，吸收推动力最大（A5.1）。: In counter-current contact the concentration difference between gas and liquid is greatest, giving the largest driving force for absorption (A5.1).
碳化后 NaHCO₃ 为什么会析出？: Why does NaHCO₃ precipitate after carbonation?
在实际氨盐水里达到过饱和: It becomes supersaturated in the actual ammoniated brine
因为它完全难溶于水: Because it is completely insoluble in water
因为它和 NH₄Cl 生成了沉淀: Because it forms a precipitate with NH₄Cl
判据是过饱和；同温度下它溶解度绝对值最小只作定性参考（A3 结论 1、A7-E2: The criterion is supersaturation; having the lowest absolute solubility at the same temperature is only a qualitative reference (A3 conclusion 1, A7-E2/E13).
20 ℃ 时四种物质在水里的溶解度最小的是？: At 20 ℃, which of the four substances has the lowest solubility in water?
数据表 A3：20 ℃ 时 NaHCO₃ 9.6 g/100 g 水，四种里最小: Data table A3: at 20 ℃ NaHCO₃ is 9.6 g/100 g water, the lowest of the four.
过滤之后母液去哪？: Where does the mother liquor go after filtration?
去冷析结晶器加盐降温析出 NH₄Cl，再循环回氨化: To the cooling crystallizer, where salt is added and it is cooled to crystallize NH₄Cl, then back to ammoniation
回到碳化塔继续通 CO₂: Back to the carbonation tower for more CO₂
去煅烧炉烧掉: To the calciner to be burned off
母液加 NaCl 到饱和再降温，析出可作氮肥的 NH₄Cl，母液循环使用（A4、: Add NaCl to the mother liquor until saturated, then cool it, and NH₄Cl crystallizes for use as nitrogen fertilizer; the mother liquor is recycled (A4, A5.3, A7-E10).
煅烧温度过低会怎样？: What happens if the calcining temperature is too low?
NaHCO₃ 分解不完全，产品残留小苏打: NaHCO₃ decomposes incompletely, leaving baking soda in the product
纯碱分解成小苏打: Soda ash decomposes into baking soda
炉内物料熔结粘壁: Material in the calciner fuses and sticks to the walls
160 ℃ 以上才分解完全；温度太低分解不完全，产品里还是小苏打（A4、A7-E: Decomposition is complete only above 160 ℃; too cold and it is incomplete, so the product is still baking soda (A4, A7-E8).
下列说法中，哪一条不是侯氏法的优点？: Which of these is NOT an advantage of Hou's process?
用氨量比氨碱法少: Uses less ammonia than the Solvay process
副产 NH₄Cl 氮肥: Yields NH₄Cl nitrogen fertilizer as a by-product
侯氏法用氨量其实更大（氮进了 NH₄Cl 产品，但氨的总投入更多），有些情况下不: Hou's process actually uses more ammonia (the nitrogen goes into the NH₄Cl product, but total ammonia input is higher), so it doesn't suit every situation (A7-E4).
煅烧炉超温熔结 · 停车清炉: Calciner overheats and fuses · shutdown to clean
操作员为压住「分解率不够」的报警而持续提温: The operator keeps raising the temperature to silence the “decomposition too low” alarm
越过 320 ℃，炉内局部物料熔结成块、粘在扬料板上: Past 320 ℃, material in parts of the calciner fuses into lumps and sticks to the lifters
传热恶化、筒体局部超温变形，传动电流超限跳闸: Heat transfer worsens, the shell overheats and deforms in places, and the drive current trips on overload
停车清炉：敲掉结块、检查炉衬后才能重启（本课虚构情境）: Shutdown to clean: knock off the lumps and inspect the lining before restarting (a fictional scenario for this lesson)

浓度按教材 0.010 mol/L，不能靠稀释蒙过去。: Concentration follows the textbook's 0.010 mol/L; you can't get by through dilution.
满分结构：先加酸抑制 + 常温 + 按教材浓度，三件事写全。: Full-marks structure: acid first to suppress + room temperature + textbook concentration; write all three.
考核没有新结论：把「先溶于较浓盐酸、再稀释、不加热」三件事同时照顾好，水解度才压: The test has no new conclusion: take care of “dissolve in fairly concentrated HCl first, then dilute, no heating” all at once, and the hydrolysis stays down.
水解度 α（弱离子转化的比例）: Degree of hydrolysis α (fraction of weak ions converted)
按 Ka 复算 · 教材只给常温 Kw: Recalculated from Ka · textbook gives Kw at room temperature only

本班目标：FeCl₃ 溶液 α ≤ 10 %: This shift's target: FeCl₃ solution α ≤ 10 %
本班目标：按教材配 0.010 mol/L FeCl₃ 溶液——先加盐酸抑制水解: This shift's target: prepare 0.010 mol/L FeCl₃ solution the textbook way: add HCl first to suppress hydrolysis, temperature ≤ 30 ℃, degree of hydrolysis ≤ 10 %, hold for 15 s
下列盐溶液中，因盐类水解而呈酸性的是: Which of these salt solutions is acidic because of salt hydrolysis?
NH₄⁺ 水解生成 NH₃·H₂O 和 H⁺，溶液呈酸性；CH₃COOH 本身是: NH₄⁺ hydrolyzes to NH₃·H₂O and H⁺, so the solution is acidic; CH₃COOH is itself an acid, not a salt; Na₂SO₄ doesn't hydrolyze; NaHCO₃ hydrolyzes to give a basic solution.
用 Na₂CO₃ 溶液清洗油污时，加热能增强去污效果，原因是: When cleaning grease with Na₂CO₃ solution, heating improves cleaning because
温度升高使油脂溶解得更快，与水解无关: higher temperature dissolves the grease faster; it has nothing to do with hydrolysis
升温促进 CO₃²⁻ 的水解，使 c(OH⁻) 增大: heating promotes CO₃²⁻ hydrolysis, raising c(OH⁻)
升温使水的离子积变小，c(OH⁻) 增大: heating lowers water's ion product, raising c(OH⁻)
盐类水解吸热，升温使 CO₃²⁻ + H₂O ⇌ HCO₃⁻ + OH⁻ 右移，: Salt hydrolysis is endothermic, so heating shifts CO₃²⁻ + H₂O ⇌ HCO₃⁻ + OH⁻ right, raising c(OH⁻) and cleaning better. As calculated in this lesson: 0.100 mol/L Na₂CO₃ goes from 4.5×10⁻³ at 25 ℃ to 3.7×10⁻² at 100 ℃.
把 0.100 mol/L CH₃COONa 溶液加水稀释到 0.010 mol: A 0.100 mol/L CH₃COONa solution is diluted with water to 0.010 mol/L. Which statement is correct?
水解程度增大，溶液的碱性增强: The extent of hydrolysis increases and the solution becomes more basic
水解程度增大，但 c(OH⁻) 减小: The extent of hydrolysis increases, but c(OH⁻) decreases
水解程度减小，c(OH⁻) 增大: The extent of hydrolysis decreases and c(OH⁻) increases
水解程度与 c(OH⁻) 都不变: Neither the extent of hydrolysis nor c(OH⁻) changes
稀释促使水解平衡右移，水解度由 0.0076 % 增大到 0.024 %；但溶液: Dilution shifts the hydrolysis equilibrium right, and the degree of hydrolysis rises from 0.0076 % to 0.024 %; but the solution is more dilute, so c(OH⁻) falls from 7.6×10⁻⁶ to 2.4×10⁻⁶ and it becomes less basic.
实验室配制 FeCl₃ 溶液时，常把 FeCl₃ 晶体先溶于较浓的盐酸再稀释，目: When preparing FeCl₃ solution in the lab, FeCl₃ crystals are usually dissolved in fairly concentrated hydrochloric acid first and then diluted, in order to
增大 c(H⁺)，抑制 Fe³⁺ 水解: raise c(H⁺) and suppress Fe³⁺ hydrolysis
增大 c(Cl⁻)，抑制 Fe³⁺ 水解: raise c(Cl⁻) and suppress Fe³⁺ hydrolysis
增大 c(OH⁻)，促进 Fe³⁺ 水解: raise c(OH⁻) and promote Fe³⁺ hydrolysis
H⁺ 是 Fe³⁺ 水解的产物，增大 c(H⁺) 使平衡左移，抑制水解、防止溶液: H⁺ is a product of Fe³⁺ hydrolysis, so raising c(H⁺) shifts the equilibrium left, suppressing hydrolysis and keeping the solution from turning cloudy. As calculated in this lesson: adding acid to 0.010 mol/L FeCl₃ up to 0.060 mol/L lowers the degree of hydrolysis from 54 % to 9.4 %.
把 FeCl₃ 溶液蒸干并灼烧，最后得到的主要固体是: After FeCl₃ solution is evaporated to dryness and roasted, the main solid left is
加热使水解趋于完全，HCl 随蒸气挥发，平衡不断右移，最后得到 Fe(OH)₃；: Heating drives hydrolysis toward completion and HCl leaves with the vapor, so the equilibrium keeps shifting right and Fe(OH)₃ forms; roasting decomposes it to Fe₂O₃. To get the anhydrous salt, water must be removed by heating in an HCl atmosphere.
可溶性的铝盐、铁盐能净水，其原因是: Soluble aluminum and iron salts can purify water because
Al³⁺、Fe³⁺ 水解生成的胶体使悬浮颗粒聚集沉降: the colloids from Al³⁺ and Fe³⁺ hydrolysis make suspended particles gather and settle
Al³⁺、Fe³⁺ 与泥沙发生中和反应: Al³⁺ and Fe³⁺ undergo neutralization with the mud
铝盐、铁盐能增大水的密度，使泥沙下沉: aluminum and iron salts increase water's density, making the mud sink
教材原话：Al³⁺ 水解生成的 Al(OH)₃ 胶体、Fe³⁺ 水解生成的 Fe: Textbook wording: the Al(OH)₃ colloid from Al³⁺ hydrolysis and the Fe(OH)₃ colloid from Fe³⁺ hydrolysis can make fine suspended particles in water gather into larger particles and settle. It is not disinfection.
已加入 2 mL 净水剂：胶体把悬浮颗粒聚沉，浊度 100 → 15: 2 mL coagulant added: the colloid makes suspended particles settle, turbidity 100 → 15
未加净水剂（对照管）：泥水依旧浑浊，浊度 100: No coagulant (control tube): the muddy water stays cloudy, turbidity 100
净水剂换成 1 mol/L Al₂(SO₄)₃：同样有效，胶体由棕红变白: Coagulant switched to 1 mol/L Al₂(SO₄)₃: works just as well, the colloid turns from reddish-brown to white
净水剂为饱和 FeCl₃：解得红褐色 Fe(OH)₃ 胶体: Coagulant is saturated FeCl₃: hydrolyzes to red-brown Fe(OH)₃ colloid
异常：温度被抬到 60 ℃——水解度跳到 49 %，先把它拖回 25 ℃: Alarm: temperature pushed to 60 ℃, degree of hydrolysis jumped to 49 %. Drag it back to 25 ℃ first
已回到参考工况：NaCl 0.100 mol/L · 25 ℃ · 未加酸: Back to reference conditions: NaCl 0.100 mol/L · 25 ℃ · no acid

神经冲动的产生和传导 · 3D 互动课件: Generation and Conduction of Nerve Impulses · 3D Interactive Lesson
神经冲动的产生和传导: Generation and Conduction of Nerve Impulses
静息 K⁺ 外流 · 兴奋 Na⁺ 内流: Resting: K⁺ outflow · Excited: Na⁺ inflow
发令枪响后 0.1 s 内起跑就算抢跑（教材 p.27）——兴奋在身体里怎样「跑: Starting within 0.1 s of the starting gun counts as a false start (textbook p.27). How does excitation “run” through the body?
K⁺ 外流 · 内负外正: K⁺ outflow · inside negative, outside positive
Na⁺ 内流 · 内正外负: Na⁺ inflow · inside positive, outside negative
一段轴突、两个微电极接到同一台电表: A section of axon with two microelectrodes connected to the same meter
磷脂双分子层上的 K⁺ 通道与 Na⁺ 通道: K⁺ channels and Na⁺ channels in the phospholipid bilayer
突触小体、突触间隙与突触后膜上的受体: Synaptic knob, synaptic cleft and receptors on the postsynaptic membrane
刺激神经的一端，电表指针会怎么动？: Stimulate one end of the nerve: how will the meter needle move?
把「电刺激」拨到「刺激中」，盯住电表: Switch “Electrical stimulus” to “Stimulating” and watch the meter
指针先往负的一侧偏（a 处膜外变负电位），接着回零；随后 b 处再偏一次，方向相: The needle first swings to the negative side (outside of the membrane at a becomes negative), then returns to zero; then point b swings once more, in the opposite (positive) direction
静息时电表没有测出电位变化，说明神经表面各处电位相等。: At rest the meter shows no potential change, meaning the potential is the same everywhere on the nerve's surface.
刺激左端后，靠近刺激端的 a 处先变为负电位，接着恢复正电位。: After the left end is stimulated, point a near the stimulus first becomes negative, then returns to positive.
随后另一电极 b 处变为负电位，接着又恢复为正电位。: Then the other electrode, b, becomes negative, then returns to positive again.
去掉两个电极分开放：只会看到「一起偏」，看不出「先 a 后 b」。: Without placing the two electrodes apart: you'd only see “they swing together”, not “first a, then b”.
电表只在两点电位不同时才偏：先 a 后 b，说明兴奋是「走过去」的。: The meter swings only when the two points differ in potential: first a, then b shows that excitation “travels”.
兴奋是以电信号的形式沿着神经纤维传导的，这种电信号也叫神经冲动。: Excitation is conducted along the nerve fiber as an electrical signal, also called a nerve impulse.
没有刺激时，膜内外为什么是内负外正？: With no stimulus, why is the membrane negative inside and positive outside?
看几秒：数一数膜上哪个通道开着、离子往哪边走: Watch for a few seconds: count which channel on the membrane is open and which way the ions move
K⁺ 通道开着，K⁺ 不断从膜内流向膜外；膜电位稳在 −70 mV（课件设定），: K⁺ channels are open and K⁺ keeps flowing from inside to outside; the membrane potential holds at −70 mV (lesson setting), with “−” inside and “+” outside
静息：K⁺ 外流 → 内负外正: Resting: K⁺ outflow → inside negative, outside positive
细胞外的 Na⁺ 浓度比膜内高，K⁺ 浓度比膜内低。: Outside the cell, Na⁺ concentration is higher than inside, and K⁺ concentration is lower.
静息时膜主要对 K⁺ 有通透性，造成 K⁺ 外流。: At rest the membrane is mainly permeable to K⁺, so K⁺ flows out.
K⁺ 外流使膜外阳离子浓度高于膜内，膜两侧表现为内负外正，即静息电位。: K⁺ outflow makes the cation concentration outside higher than inside, so the membrane is negative inside and positive outside: the resting potential.
去掉 K⁺ 通道：就说不出「内负外正」是怎么来的，只能背结论。: Without K⁺ channels: you can't explain where “inside negative, outside positive” comes from, only memorize it.
静息电位是 K⁺ 外流「攒」出来的，不是 Na⁺。: The resting potential is “built up” by K⁺ outflow, not Na⁺.
静息时膜主要对 K⁺ 有通透性，K⁺ 外流使膜外阳离子浓度高于膜内，膜两侧表现为: At rest the membrane is mainly permeable to K⁺; K⁺ outflow makes the cation concentration outside higher than inside, so the membrane is negative inside and positive outside. This is the resting potential.
给膜一个刺激，膜电位会怎样变？: Give the membrane a stimulus: how does the membrane potential change?
把「电刺激」拨到「刺激中」，看膜电位与离子: Switch “Electrical stimulus” to “Stimulating” and watch the membrane potential and ions
Na⁺ 从膜外涌进膜内，膜电位由 −70 mV 升到 +30 mV（内正外负），: Na⁺ rushes in from outside, the membrane potential rises from −70 mV to +30 mV (inside positive, outside negative), then falls back; peak reading +30 mV
兴奋：Na⁺ 内流 → 内正外负: Excited: Na⁺ inflow → inside positive, outside negative
受刺激时细胞膜对 Na⁺ 的通透性增加，Na⁺ 内流。: When stimulated, the cell membrane becomes more permeable to Na⁺, and Na⁺ flows in.
这个部位出现暂时性的电位变化，表现为内正外负的兴奋状态。: That region shows a temporary potential change: an excited state, positive inside and negative outside.
此时的膜电位称为动作电位；邻近未兴奋部位仍是内负外正。: The membrane potential now is called the action potential; neighboring unexcited regions are still negative inside and positive outside.
去掉 Na⁺ 通道：怎么刺激都不再出现动作电位——麻药与毒素就是这样起作用的。: Without Na⁺ channels: no stimulus can produce an action potential. That's how anesthetics and toxins work.
内负外正 ↔ 内正外负，翻过来靠的是 Na⁺ 内流。: Inside −/outside + ↔ inside +/outside −: the flip depends on Na⁺ inflow.
受刺激时膜对 Na⁺ 通透性增加、Na⁺ 内流，该部位出现内正外负的兴奋状态，此: When stimulated, the membrane becomes more permeable to Na⁺ and Na⁺ flows in; that region becomes excited, positive inside and negative outside, and the membrane potential is then called the action potential.
兴奋是怎样沿神经纤维一段一段传下去的？: How is excitation passed along the nerve fiber section by section?
看几秒：兴奋带怎样一段一段往前推，后方怎样恢复: Watch for a few seconds: see how the excited zone moves forward section by section and how the area behind it recovers
兴奋带沿轴突一段一段往前推进，后方逐段恢复；剖开后能看到兴奋部位与未兴奋部位之间: The excited zone moves along the axon section by section, and the area behind recovers section by section; in cross-section you can see local-current arrows between excited and unexcited regions; the main reading (meter) swings twice along with it
向前传导，后方恢复静息: Conducted forward, area behind returns to rest
兴奋部位与未兴奋部位之间存在电位差，电荷移动形成局部电流。: There is a potential difference between excited and unexcited regions; moving charges form a local current.
局部电流又刺激相近的未兴奋部位发生同样的电位变化。: The local current in turn stimulates the nearby unexcited region to undergo the same potential change.
如此进行下去，兴奋向前传导，后方又恢复为静息电位。: This continues, so excitation is conducted forward and the area behind returns to the resting potential.
去掉局部电流：兴奋走不出受刺激的那一点。: Without local current: excitation never leaves the stimulated point.
传导不是「电沿导线流」，而是「一段一段重新兴奋」。: Conduction isn't “electricity flowing down a wire”; it's “re-excitation section by section”.
兴奋部位与未兴奋部位之间的电位差形成局部电流；局部电流刺激相近的未兴奋部位兴奋，: The potential difference between excited and unexcited regions forms a local current; the local current excites the nearby unexcited region, so excitation is conducted forward and the area behind returns to rest.
兴奋怎样跨过两个神经元之间的缝隙？: How does excitation cross the gap between two neurons?
在 3D 里点一下突触小体（杯状的那一团）: In 3D, click the synaptic knob (the cup-shaped blob)
突触小泡移向前膜并融合，递质被释放到突触间隙、扩散到后膜与受体结合，后膜电位随即: Synaptic vesicles move to the presynaptic membrane and fuse, transmitter is released into the synaptic cleft, diffuses to the postsynaptic membrane and binds to receptors, and the postsynaptic potential changes right away (−70 → −55 mV, lesson setting)
相邻的两个神经元并不是直接接触的。: Two neighboring neurons don't touch each other directly.
突触由突触前膜、突触间隙与突触后膜构成；轴突末梢处有许多突触小泡。: A synapse consists of the presynaptic membrane, synaptic cleft and postsynaptic membrane; the axon terminal holds many synaptic vesicles.
递质由小泡释放、扩散过间隙、与后膜受体结合，引发后膜电位变化；随后被降解或回收。: Transmitter is released from vesicles, diffuses across the cleft and binds to postsynaptic receptors, changing the postsynaptic potential; it is then broken down or taken back up.
去掉突触小泡：没有递质，信号传不到下一个神经元。: Without synaptic vesicles: no transmitter, so the signal can't reach the next neuron.
图 2-8 的五步：到达 → 释放 → 扩散 → 结合 → 降解或回收。: The five steps of Fig. 2-8: arrival → release → diffusion → binding → breakdown or reuptake.
突触由突触前膜、突触间隙与突触后膜构成；递质由突触小泡释放、扩散过间隙、与后膜受: A synapse consists of the presynaptic membrane, synaptic cleft and postsynaptic membrane; transmitter is released from synaptic vesicles, diffuses across the cleft and binds to postsynaptic receptors, changing the postsynaptic membrane potential.
为什么兴奋只能单向传，而且比在纤维上慢？: Why does excitation pass only one way at a synapse, and more slowly than along a fiber?
看几秒：递质从哪一侧出现，后膜又要过多久才起变化: Watch for a few seconds: which side the transmitter appears from, and how long before the postsynaptic membrane responds
间隙里的递质全部来自突触前膜一侧，后膜一侧一个都没有；后膜电位比「兴奋到达前膜」: All the transmitter in the cleft comes from the presynaptic side, none from the postsynaptic side; the postsynaptic potential starts changing 0.5 physiological ms (0.05 s on screen) after “excitation reaches the presynaptic membrane”
递质只能由突触前膜释放: Transmitter can only be released by the presynaptic membrane
递质只存在于突触小泡中，只能由突触前膜释放，然后作用于突触后膜上。: Transmitter exists only in synaptic vesicles, can only be released by the presynaptic membrane, and then acts on the postsynaptic membrane.
因此神经元之间兴奋的传递只能是单方向的，例如从轴突传到下一个神经元的胞体或树突。: So excitation can pass between neurons in only one direction, e.g. from an axon to the cell body or dendrite of the next neuron.
突触处要经过化学信号的转换（有延搁），单位距离上比在神经纤维上慢得多。: At a synapse the signal must be converted into a chemical signal (with a delay), so per unit distance it's much slower than along a nerve fiber.
去掉这条：学生会以为突触能双向传，选择题必错。: Without this: students think synapses work both ways and get the multiple-choice question wrong every time.
单向看「递质从哪侧出现」；「慢」看「延搁有多长」。: For “one-way”, look at which side the transmitter comes from; for “slow”, look at how long the delay is.
递质只存在于突触小泡中、只能由突触前膜释放，所以神经元之间的传递只能是单方向的；: Transmitter exists only in synaptic vesicles and can only be released by the presynaptic membrane, so transmission between neurons is one-way; at a synapse the signal must be converted chemically (with a delay), so it's slower than along a nerve fiber.
把「可卡因」拨到「已加」，看间隙里的多巴胺和受体: Switch “Cocaine” to “Added” and watch the dopamine in the cleft and the receptors
转运蛋白不再回收多巴胺，间隙多巴胺停在 60 % 上不下来（界面 1.5 s 后: The transporters stop taking dopamine back up, and cleft dopamine stays stuck at 60 % (still 60 % after 1.5 s on screen); postsynaptic receptors drop from 100 % to about 65 % (a long-term change compressed into seconds, illustrative)
这类物质对神经系统的影响，作用位点往往在突触。: Substances like this usually act on the nervous system at synapses.
正常时多巴胺发挥作用后，会被突触前膜上的转运蛋白回收。: Normally, after dopamine acts, it is taken back up by transporters on the presynaptic membrane.
可卡因使转运蛋白失去回收多巴胺的功能：多巴胺留在间隙持续发挥作用，导致后膜上的多: Cocaine stops the transporters from taking back dopamine: dopamine stays in the cleft and keeps acting, which reduces the dopamine receptors on the postsynaptic membrane (the real loss of receptors takes days to weeks; the screen compresses it into seconds, illustrative).
去掉这条：只记住「毒品有害」，说不出为什么「戒不掉」。: Without this: students only remember “drugs are harmful” and can't say why “you can't quit”.
错误操作＝「吸一口」；后果＝多巴胺滞留、受体减少；请解释：为什么停药后更难受？: Wrong action = “take one hit”; consequence = dopamine lingers, receptors decrease; explain: why do you feel worse after stopping?
可卡因使突触前膜上的转运蛋白失去回收多巴胺的功能，多巴胺留在突触间隙持续发挥作用: Cocaine stops transporters on the presynaptic membrane from taking back dopamine, so dopamine stays in the synaptic cleft and keeps acting, reducing dopamine receptors on the postsynaptic membrane; once the drug wears off, the receptors are already fewer, so the user has to keep taking it: a vicious cycle.
降低膜外 Na⁺ 浓度，动作电位会怎样变？: If the Na⁺ concentration outside the membrane is lowered, how does the action potential change?
把膜外 Na⁺ 浓度往低处拖（100 % → 70 % 以下），盯住峰值和静息电: Drag the outside Na⁺ concentration lower (100 % → below 70 %) and watch the peak and the resting potential
峰值随膜外 Na⁺ 降低而降低：100 % 时 +30.0 mV、70 % 时: The peak drops as outside Na⁺ drops: +30.0 mV at 100 %, +22.6 mV at 70 %, +19.4 mV at 60 %, +15.6 mV at 50 %; the resting potential stays at −70 mV; you can try the 150 % side yourself (+38.5 mV)
动作电位幅度随膜外 Na⁺ 降低而降低: Action potential amplitude falls as outside Na⁺ falls
改变轴突外 Na⁺ 浓度，静息电位并不受影响。: Changing the Na⁺ concentration outside the axon doesn't affect the resting potential.
