太阳直射点的回归运动与四季、五带 · 3D 互动课件: Migration of the Subsolar Point: Seasons and Climate Zones · 3D Interactive Lesson
人教版选择性必修 1 · 第一章「地球的运动」（p.2–14，本课取 p.10–: PEP Elective Vol. 1 · Ch. 1 “Earth’s Motions” (pp. 2–14; this lesson uses pp. 10–14)
太阳直射点的回归运动与四季、五带: Migration of the Subsolar Point: Seasons and Climate Zones
学校所在地的正午太阳高度和正午太阳方向，一年里为什么有规律地变化？: Why do the noon Sun’s altitude and direction at your school change in a regular way over the year?
黄赤交角 23°26′ → 地轴指向不变: Obliquity of the ecliptic 23°26′ → the axis keeps pointing the same way
直射点在南北回归线之间一年往返一次: The subsolar point travels between the Tropics and back once a year
a = 90° − |φ − δ| → 纬度分布 + 季节变化: a = 90° − |φ − δ| → latitude distribution + seasonal change
太阳辐射年变化 → 四季；由低纬向高纬递减 → 五带: Yearly change in solar radiation → the seasons; decreasing from low to high latitudes → the five zones
正午太阳照到哪儿、照得多斜: Where the noon Sun shines, and how slanted
南北回归线之间：直射点一年往返的那条带: Between the Tropics: the belt the subsolar point crosses back and forth each year
纬度滑块所在处：球上小地平板 + 放大的当地地平面: Where the latitude slider is: a small horizon plate on the globe + an enlarged local horizon plane
热带 / 温带 / 寒带：以回归线和极圈为界: Torrid / Temperate / Frigid: bounded by the Tropics and the Polar Circles
太阳光为什么只能在南北回归线之间直射？: Why can sunlight strike vertically only between the two Tropics?
拖视角转一圈：找黄道平面、赤道平面和它们的夹角: Drag to rotate the view all the way round: find the ecliptic plane, the equatorial plane and the angle between them
两平面夹角 23°26′（黄赤交角）: The two planes meet at 23°26′ (obliquity of the ecliptic)
赤道平面与黄道平面之间的夹角叫黄赤交角，目前的黄赤交角是 23°26′。: The angle between the equatorial plane and the ecliptic plane is called the obliquity of the ecliptic; it is currently 23°26′.
地球在公转过程中，地轴的空间指向和黄赤交角的大小，在一定时期内可以看作是不变的。: As Earth revolves, the direction of its axis in space and the size of the obliquity can be treated as constant over a given period.
所以太阳直射的范围最北到达北纬 23°26′、最南到达南纬 23°26′，这两条: So the Sun’s direct rays reach at most 23°26′N and at most 23°26′S; these two boundary lines are the Tropic of Cancer and the Tropic of Capricorn.
去掉这一步：不知道直射点为什么只在这条带里，后面的季节变化就都成了背结论。: Without this step: you don’t know why the subsolar point stays in this belt, and the seasonal changes later become facts to memorize.
常考：黄赤交角是 23°26′（写成 23.5° 就错）；直射范围 ±23°26: Often tested: the obliquity is 23°26′ (writing 23.5° is wrong); the direct-ray range is ±23°26′; 66°34′ is a derived value — the textbook text does not state it.
因为黄赤交角 23°26′，地轴指向不变而地球在轨道上的位置在变，太阳光垂直照射: Because the obliquity is 23°26′ and the axis keeps its direction while Earth’s position in orbit changes, the point where sunlight strikes vertically can only travel back and forth between the Tropics, reaching 23°26′N at the farthest north and 23°26′S at the farthest south.
一年里，直射点怎样走完这一趟？: Over a year, how does the subsolar point make this trip?
把日期从夏至（6 月 21 日）拖到冬至（12 月 22 日），盯住球面上的直射: Drag the date from the June solstice (Jun 21) to the December solstice (Dec 22) and watch the subsolar point on the globe and its latitude on the console
球面正面的红点沿北京那条经线往南走、留下红色轨迹，依次划过北回归线、赤道（秋分: On the front of the globe the red dot moves south along Beijing’s meridian, leaving a red trail, crossing the Tropic of Cancer, the Equator (September equinox, Sep 23, 0.0°) and the Tropic of Capricorn in turn; the subsolar latitude falls from 23.4°N to 23.4°S, and the label by the red dot reads “Turning” at the June solstice, “Moving south” while dragging, and “Turning” again at the December solstice; in the small top-left view Earth moves along its orbit to the December solstice with its axis direction unchanged
一个回归年往返一次: One round trip per tropical year
夏至日（6 月 21 日前后）太阳直射北纬 23°26′，之后太阳直射点逐渐南移: On the June solstice (around Jun 21) the Sun is directly over 23°26′N; after that the subsolar point gradually moves south.
秋分日（9 月 23 日前后）直射赤道，冬至日（12 月 22 日前后）直射南纬: On the September equinox (around Sep 23) it is over the Equator, and on the December solstice (around Dec 22) over 23°26′S; after that it gradually moves back north.
直射点在南北回归线之间的往返运动，叫太阳直射点的回归运动；往返一次的周期是一个回: The subsolar point’s back-and-forth motion between the Tropics is called the migration of the subsolar point; one round trip takes one tropical year.
去掉这一步：只会背四个日期，说不出「回归」是什么意思，也接不上后面「季节为什么变: Without this step: you can only recite four dates, can’t say what the migration means, and can’t link it to “why the seasons change” later.
常考：二分二至的日期都带「前后」；北半球夏半年 186 天、冬半年 179 天；: Often tested: all equinox and solstice dates are “around”; the Northern Hemisphere’s summer half-year is 186 days and winter half-year 179 days; “gradually moves south / gradually moves back north” are the textbook’s words — the uneven speed is only a model result.
直射点在南北回归线之间以一年为周期往返，叫太阳直射点的回归运动；这个周期就是一个: The subsolar point moves back and forth between the Tropics with a period of one year; this is the migration of the subsolar point. The period is one tropical year, and the equinoxes and solstices are the four key dates on this route.
北京的夏至正午，太阳升到多高？: How high does the Sun climb at noon in Beijing on the June solstice?
把日期从夏至拖到冬至，盯住上方放大的北京地平面：太阳沿子午弧往哪边滑、夹角旁的读: Drag the date from the June solstice to the December solstice and watch the enlarged Beijing horizon plane above: which way the Sun slides along the meridian arc, and how the reading by the angle changes
正午太阳高度由 73.4° 降到 26.6°（就是教材算例的 73°26′ 和: The noon solar altitude falls from 73.4° to 26.6° (the textbook example’s 73°26′ and 26°34′); in the enlargement the Sun slides down the southern sky, and the pole’s shadow grows longer and always points north
φ = 当地纬度、δ = 直射点纬度（北正南负）: φ = local latitude, δ = subsolar latitude (north positive, south negative)
太阳高度是太阳光线与地平面的交角；在太阳直射点上，太阳高度是 90°。: Solar altitude is the angle between the Sun’s rays and the horizon plane; at the subsolar point it is 90°.
正午太阳高度是一日内最大的太阳高度，反映太阳辐射的强弱。: The noon solar altitude is the highest solar altitude of the day and reflects how strong the solar radiation is.
正午太阳高度可以按 a = 90° − |φ − δ| 计算，δ 在夏半年取正值: The noon solar altitude can be calculated as a = 90° − |φ − δ|, with δ positive in the summer half-year and negative in the winter half-year; Beijing (40°N) gets 73°26′ at the June solstice and 26°34′ at the December solstice. The angle between Beijing’s small plate on the globe and the horizontal rays is a; the enlargement above lays that patch of ground flat, and the number by the arc changes with the date.
去掉这一步：算不出任何一个地方的正午太阳高度，四季和五带只能靠背。: Without this step: you can’t calculate the noon solar altitude anywhere, and the seasons and five zones can only be memorized.
常考：套公式时 δ 的符号（冬至取负）；「90° − 当地纬度 + 23°26′: Often tested: the sign of δ in the formula (negative at the December solstice); “90° − local latitude + 23°26′” only holds north of the Tropic of Cancer.
正午太阳高度 a = 90° − |φ − δ|：直射点上 90°、晨昏线上 0: Noon solar altitude a = 90° − |φ − δ|: 90° at the subsolar point, 0° on the terminator, and elsewhere decreasing with the latitude difference from the subsolar point; Beijing at 40°N gets 73°26′ at the June solstice and 26°34′ at the December solstice.
同一天，为什么越往北太阳越低？: On the same day, why is the Sun lower the farther north you go?
把观测点从北京（40°N）一路拖到 80°N，看读数、中控台曲线的顶点，对照球缘: Drag the observer from Beijing (40°N) all the way to 80°N; watch the reading and the peak of the console curve, and compare with the row of angles along the globe’s edge
正午太阳高度由 73.4° 降到 33.4°；曲线一直在一处最高，那一处就是直射: The noon solar altitude falls from 73.4° to 33.4°; the curve always peaks in one place — the latitude of the subsolar point (23.4°N) — and decreases to the north and south; the row of angles along the globe’s edge decreases from 90.0° at the subsolar point to both sides (80°N 33.4°, 40°N 73.4°, Equator 66.6°, 40°S 26.6°) — the same thing as the curve
离直射点每远 1°，正午太阳高度小 1°: Each 1° farther from the subsolar point, the noon solar altitude drops by 1°
由直射点向南北递减: Decreasing north and south from the subsolar point
夏至峰在北回归线: June solstice peak at the Tropic of Cancer
同一天，离直射点纬度越远，正午太阳高度越小。: On the same day, the farther a latitude is from the subsolar point, the lower the noon solar altitude.
所以曲线（和真实的地球）最高处永远在直射点那条纬线上，它随日期南北移动。: So the highest point of the curve (and of the real Earth) is always on the subsolar latitude, which moves north and south with the date.
夏至的峰值在北回归线，冬至在南回归线，春分日和秋分日在赤道。: At the June solstice the peak is on the Tropic of Cancer, at the December solstice on the Tropic of Capricorn, and at the equinoxes on the Equator.
去掉这一步：会以为「越往南越热」永远成立，看不出峰值也在动。: Without this step: you’d think “the farther south, the hotter” always holds, and miss that the peak also moves.
常考：给出日期和纬度比较正午太阳高度的大小；读「二分二至日全球正午太阳高度」图（: Often tested: compare noon solar altitudes for a given date and latitude; read the “global noon solar altitude at the equinoxes and solstices” graph (lower half of textbook Fig. 1.16).
就纬度分布而言，正午太阳高度夏至日由北回归线向南北两方降低，春分日和秋分日由赤道: By latitude, the noon solar altitude decreases north and south from the Tropic of Cancer at the June solstice, from the Equator at the equinoxes, and from the Tropic of Capricorn at the December solstice.
facts A2.2 第 3 条（教材 p.11）、A2.4 第 8 条（p.1: facts A2.2 item 3 (textbook p.11), A2.4 item 8 (p.14)
本地正午太阳高度的最高值和最低值，什么时候出现？: When does the local noon solar altitude reach its highest and lowest values?
把观测点从 40°N 拖到赤道，盯住主读数下面那行「年内最高 / 最低」: Drag the observer from 40°N to the Equator and watch the line “Yearly max / min” under the main reading
「年内最高」由 73.4° 升到 90.0°，「年内最低」由 26.6° 升到: “Yearly max” rises from 73.4° to 90.0°, “Yearly min” rises from 26.6° to 66.6°; the zone reading changes from “North Temperate” to “Torrid”; the noon solar altitude now is 66.6°; in the enlargement the orange arc is the range the noon Sun covers in a year: at 40°N it lies entirely in the southern sky, and at the Equator it crosses the zenith, reaching 66.6° on both the north and south sides
夏至最大 · 冬至最小: Max at June solstice · min at December solstice
同一纬度上，正午太阳高度一年里有一个最高值、一个最低值。: At a given latitude, the noon solar altitude has one maximum and one minimum each year.
在北回归线及其以北的纬度带，夏至日达最大值、冬至日达最小值；在南回归线及其以南的: On and north of the Tropic of Cancer it peaks at the June solstice and is lowest at the December solstice; on and south of the Tropic of Capricorn it is the other way round.
在南北回归线之间各地，每年受到太阳直射两次，最高值就是 90°；赤道的最低值出现: Everywhere between the Tropics the Sun is directly overhead twice a year, so the maximum is 90°; the Equator’s minimum comes at the solstices and is 66°34′.
去掉这一步：说不出「什么时候最高」，也解释不了为什么只有热带能到 90°。: Without this step: you can’t say “when it is highest”, or explain why only the Torrid Zone can reach 90°.
常考：北回归线以北「夏至最大、冬至最小」；赤道只有二分日正午太阳高度是 90°；: Often tested: north of the Tropic of Cancer “max at the June solstice, min at the December solstice”; only at the equinoxes is the Equator’s noon solar altitude 90°; on a Tropic the Sun is overhead once a year (an inference, not a textbook sentence).
北回归线及其以北正午太阳高度夏至日最大、冬至日最小，南回归线及其以南反之；南北回: On and north of the Tropic of Cancer the noon solar altitude is greatest at the June solstice and least at the December solstice, and the reverse on and south of the Tropic of Capricorn; between the Tropics the Sun is overhead twice a year and the maximum can reach 90°.
facts A2.2 第 3 条（教材 p.11）、B2.1 ⑥、A2.4 第: facts A2.2 item 3 (textbook p.11), B2.1 ⑥, A2.4 item 8
正午的太阳，什么时候会跑到头顶的北边？: When does the noon Sun move to the north side of the zenith?
把观测点从 40°N 拖进热带（20°N），看放大件里太阳在天顶的哪一侧、杆影朝: Drag the observer from 40°N into the tropics (20°N) and see which side of the zenith the Sun is on in the enlargement, and which way the pole’s shadow points
正午太阳方向由「南方」变成「北方」，杆影翻到南边；再拖回 40°N 又变回「南方: The noon Sun’s direction changes from “South” to “North”, and the shadow flips to the south; drag back to 40°N and it returns to “South”; on the subsolar latitude it shows “Overhead”
北回归线以北恒在南 · 以南恒在北: North of the Tropic of Cancer always south · south of the Tropic of Capricorn always north
方向由观测点纬度与直射点纬度之差决定：观测点比直射点更北，正午太阳就在南方。: The direction depends on the difference between the observer’s latitude and the subsolar latitude: if the observer is farther north than the subsolar point, the noon Sun is in the south.
北回归线以北 φ 总是大于 δ，所以全年正午太阳都在南方；南回归线以南反之。: North of the Tropic of Cancer φ is always greater than δ, so the noon Sun is in the south all year; south of the Tropic of Capricorn it is the reverse.
只有在南北回归线之间，δ 会超过 φ，正午太阳的方向才随季节南北翻号。: Only between the Tropics can δ exceed φ, so only there does the noon Sun switch between north and south with the seasons.
去掉这一步：会把「正午太阳在南方」当成全球通用，热带的同学最容易记反。: Without this step: you’d treat “the noon Sun is in the south” as true everywhere — students in the tropics most easily get it backwards.

北回归线以北全年正午太阳在南方，南回归线以南全年在北方；南北回归线之间，一年里正: North of the Tropic of Cancer the noon Sun is in the south all year, and south of the Tropic of Capricorn in the north all year; between the Tropics it is sometimes south and sometimes north, and directly overhead when the subsolar point passes.

FeSO₄ + 2NaOH = Fe(OH)₂↓ + Na₂SO₄ · 敞口: FeSO₄ + 2NaOH = Fe(OH)₂↓ + Na₂SO₄ · open to air
「白色」是 Fe(OH)₂ 本来的颜色，不是没反应。: “White” is Fe(OH)₂'s own color, not a sign that nothing reacted.
变灰绿、变红褐是被氧化，氧来自溶解在溶液里的 O₂，不是来自 NaOH。: Turning gray-green, then red-brown, is oxidation; the oxygen comes from O₂ dissolved in the solution, not from NaOH.
φ 一路上升、颜色单调走下去：这就是「价态往上走」。: φ keeps rising and the color moves in one direction: this is “the oxidation state going up.”

曲线图上实线（敞口）与虚线（隔绝）分开，就是这一步的对照。: The solid line (open) and dashed line (air-excluded) separating on the graph is the control for this step.

主读数 0.0 → 100.0 %；c 由 0 / 75 → 75 / 0 mm: Main reading 0.0 → 100.0 %; c goes from 0 / 75 → 75 / 0 mmol/L; the solution turns from pale green to yellow-brown, the KSCN test flips from “no red” back to “red,” and 75 mmol/L is 50 % higher than the original 50
上层清液 + 几滴氯水 · 再滴 KSCN: Supernatant + a few drops of chlorine water · then add KSCN
氯水是「较强氧化剂」，把价态往上提。: Chlorine water is a “stronger oxidizing agent” that lifts the oxidation state.
这次变红比一开始更深，因为加铁粉那一步有铁粉溶解进来（总铁 50 → 75 mm: This red is deeper than at the start, because some iron powder dissolved in the iron-powder step (total iron 50 → 75 mmol/L); the chlorine water only oxidizes all 75 of Fe²⁺ back into 75 of Fe³⁺. The state changes; total iron does not.
教材的做法是「把上层清液倒入另一支试管」再加氯水：原管里还有铁粉，加进去会被铁粉: The textbook “pours the supernatant into another test tube” before adding chlorine water: the original tube still has iron powder, which would use up the chlorine water first.
去掉这一步：学生以为「铁粉把铁除掉了」，不知道它只是把价态改了。: Without this step: students think “iron powder removed the iron” and miss that it only changed the oxidation state.

「+2 价」和「+3 价」之间，到底丢了什么、又拿回了什么？: Between “+2” and “+3,” what exactly is lost and what is taken back?
看放大窗里 Fe²⁺ 与 Fe³⁺ 的粒子怎么换、电子往哪走（回去再拖一次铁粉: Watch how Fe²⁺ and Fe³⁺ particles swap in the magnified view and where the electrons go (go back and try the iron powder and the chlorine water once each)
放大窗里 Fe²⁺ 8 个 / Fe³⁺ 0 个（加铁粉后）↔ Fe³⁺ 8 个: Magnified view: 8 Fe²⁺ / 0 Fe³⁺ (after iron powder) ↔ 8 Fe³⁺ / 0 Fe²⁺ (after chlorine water); the total number of particles stays the same; with iron powder, electrons flow into Fe³⁺; with chlorine water, electrons flow out of Fe²⁺
价态不是「贴上去的标签」，就是电子的个数。: Oxidation state is not a “label stuck on”; it is a count of electrons.
换价态 = 换电子，所以必须有「能给出电子」或「能拿走电子」的另一方。: Changing state = changing electrons, so there must be another party that “can give electrons” or “can take electrons away.”
铁原子总数不变，变的只是每个铁原子手上的电子数——这就是为什么 φ 能来回走而总: The total number of iron atoms stays the same; only the number of electrons each iron atom holds changes. That's why φ can go back and forth while the total stays fixed.
去掉这一步：学生只会背「加铁粉还原、加氯水氧化」，不知道还原与氧化到底动了什么。: Without this step: students only memorize “iron powder reduces, chlorine water oxidizes” and don't know what reduction and oxidation actually move.
高频：氧化还原的电子转移方向；Fe²⁺ 与 Fe³⁺ 的价态差。: Frequently tested: the direction of electron transfer in redox; the difference in oxidation state between Fe²⁺ and Fe³⁺.
Fe²⁺ 与 Fe³⁺ 之间只差 1 个电子：Fe − 2e⁻ → Fe²⁺、F: Fe²⁺ and Fe³⁺ differ by only 1 electron: Fe − 2e⁻ → Fe²⁺, Fe − 3e⁻ → Fe³⁺; losing electrons is oxidation, gaining electrons is reduction (textbook wording).

教材的方案写得很清楚：先加少量稀硝酸（它「具有氧化性」），再滴 KSCN；补铁剂: The textbook's procedure is clear: first add a little dilute nitric acid (it “is oxidizing”), then add KSCN; an iron supplement is another type of sample tested the same way (vitamin C is reducing and can pull Fe³⁺ back to Fe²⁺, so iron supplements are often taken with it).
去掉这一步：学生会把「KSCN 不变红」当成「没有铁」，考到食品、脱氧剂、补铁剂: Without this step: students take “KSCN doesn't turn red” as “no iron” and get every question on food, oxygen absorbers and iron supplements wrong.
高频：检验食品或补铁剂中的铁元素为什么先加稀硝酸（或氯水）；「不变红」能推出什么: Frequently tested: why dilute nitric acid (or chlorine water) is added first when testing food or iron supplements for iron; what “no red” lets you conclude.
KSCN 只认 Fe³⁺，而食品里的铁大部分是 Fe²⁺，所以要先加少量稀硝酸（: KSCN only detects Fe³⁺, and most iron in food is Fe²⁺, so first add a little dilute nitric acid (which is oxidizing) to oxidize Fe²⁺ to Fe³⁺, then add KSCN (textbook Research & Practice procedure). Iron supplements are often taken with vitamin C because vitamin C is reducing (ascorbic acid is easily oxidized and acts as an antioxidant), and it can reduce oxidized Fe³⁺ back to Fe²⁺.

教材原话：含有 Fe³⁺ 的盐溶液遇到 KSCN 溶液时变成红色，可以利用这一反: Textbook wording: a salt solution containing Fe³⁺ turns red when it meets KSCN solution; this reaction can be used to test for Fe³⁺. KSCN only detects Fe³⁺, so “no red” only shows there is no Fe³⁺; it doesn't show there is no iron, and it doesn't prove there is Fe²⁺. Step 8 of this lesson falls right into this trap.
向 FeCl₃ 溶液中加入过量铁粉，充分反应后溶液的价态与浓度变化是: Excess iron powder is added to FeCl₃ solution. After full reaction, how do the oxidation state and concentration change?
Fe³⁺ 全部变成 Fe²⁺，c(Fe²⁺) 是原 c(Fe³⁺) 的 1.5: All Fe³⁺ becomes Fe²⁺; c(Fe²⁺) is 1.5 times the original c(Fe³⁺)
Fe³⁺ 全部变成 Fe²⁺，c(Fe²⁺) 与原 c(Fe³⁺) 相等: All Fe³⁺ becomes Fe²⁺; c(Fe²⁺) equals the original c(Fe³⁺)
Fe³⁺ 不变，只是颜色变浅: Fe³⁺ is unchanged; only the color gets lighter
Fe³⁺ 变成 Fe，有铁析出: Fe³⁺ becomes Fe; iron is deposited
2Fe³⁺ + Fe = 3Fe²⁺：2 mol Fe³⁺ 变成 3 mol F: 2Fe³⁺ + Fe = 3Fe²⁺: 2 mol Fe³⁺ becomes 3 mol Fe²⁺, so it's 1.5 times. This lesson calculated: 50 mmol/L FeCl₃ with excess iron powder becomes 75 mmol/L Fe²⁺, and KSCN then shows no red.
在上面那支管的浅绿色清液里滴加氯水，再滴 KSCN，现象与价态变化是: Chlorine water is added to the pale green liquid from the tube above, then KSCN. What happens, and how does the oxidation state change?
溶液变棕黄、滴 KSCN 变红，Fe²⁺ 被氧化成 Fe³⁺: The solution turns yellow-brown and red with KSCN; Fe²⁺ is oxidized to Fe³⁺
溶液仍浅绿、滴 KSCN 不变红，Fe²⁺ 没变: The solution stays pale green and shows no red with KSCN; Fe²⁺ is unchanged
溶液变棕黄但滴 KSCN 不变红: The solution turns yellow-brown but shows no red with KSCN
2Fe²⁺ + Cl₂ = 2Fe³⁺ + 2Cl⁻：氯水是较强氧化剂，把 Fe: 2Fe²⁺ + Cl₂ = 2Fe³⁺ + 2Cl⁻: chlorine water is a stronger oxidizing agent that oxidizes Fe²⁺ to Fe³⁺, so the color goes from pale green to yellow-brown and KSCN turns red again. This lesson calculated: c(Fe³⁺) goes from 0 back to 75 mmol/L, 50 % higher than the original 50.
按教材的方法检验食品中的铁元素时，先加少量稀硝酸再滴 KSCN，原因是: When testing food for iron by the textbook method, a little dilute nitric acid is added before KSCN, because
稀硝酸能把 Fe³⁺ 还原成 Fe²⁺: Dilute nitric acid reduces Fe³⁺ to Fe²⁺
稀硝酸具有氧化性，把 Fe²⁺ 氧化成 Fe³⁺，才能被 KSCN 检出: Dilute nitric acid is oxidizing; it oxidizes Fe²⁺ to Fe³⁺ so KSCN can detect it
稀硝酸只是用来调节酸碱性: Dilute nitric acid only adjusts the acidity
稀硝酸能把铁元素沉淀出来: Dilute nitric acid precipitates the iron
教材原话：加入少量稀硝酸（稀硝酸具有氧化性），再滴加几滴 KSCN 溶液。KSC: Textbook wording: add a little dilute nitric acid (dilute nitric acid is oxidizing), then add a few drops of KSCN solution. KSCN only detects Fe³⁺, and most iron in food is Fe²⁺. This lesson calculated: without dilute nitric acid, φ is only 5.0 % with red intensity 0.03 (barely visible); with it, 100.0 % and 0.60 (clearly red).
已隔绝空气：煮沸除氧、长滴管伸入液面下、煤油封住液面——白色沉淀保住了: Air excluded: boiled to remove oxygen, long dropper below the surface, kerosene seals the surface. The white precipitate is preserved
取消隔绝：空气里的 O₂ 又溶进来了，白色沉淀会先变灰绿、再变红褐: Air exclusion off: O₂ from the air dissolves in again, and the white precipitate will turn gray-green, then red-brown
已滴入 KSCN：只有含 Fe³⁺ 的那一支会变红: KSCN added: only the tube containing Fe³⁺ turns red
没有 KSCN：现在只能看溶液本身的颜色（棕黄 / 浅绿）: No KSCN: for now you can only see the solution's own color (yellow-brown / pale green)
已加入过量铁粉：Fe³⁺ 被还原成 Fe²⁺（2Fe³⁺ + Fe = 3Fe²: Excess iron powder added: Fe³⁺ is reduced to Fe²⁺ (2Fe³⁺ + Fe = 3Fe²⁺), and the red fades to pale green
铁粉撤掉了：没有还原剂，Fe³⁺ 就留在溶液里: Iron powder removed: with no reducing agent, Fe³⁺ stays in the solution
已加入氯水：Fe²⁺ 被氧化成 Fe³⁺（2Fe²⁺ + Cl₂ = 2Fe³⁺: Chlorine water added: Fe²⁺ is oxidized to Fe³⁺ (2Fe²⁺ + Cl₂ = 2Fe³⁺ + 2Cl⁻), and KSCN turns red again
氯水撤掉了：没有氧化剂，价态不会再往上走: Chlorine water removed: with no oxidizing agent, the state won't rise any further
已加入少量稀硝酸：它有氧化性，把 Fe²⁺ 氧化成 Fe³⁺，KSCN 才认得出: A little dilute nitric acid added: it is oxidizing and turns Fe²⁺ into Fe³⁺, so KSCN can detect the iron
没加稀硝酸：样本里的铁大多是 Fe²⁺，KSCN 看不出来——这时说「不含铁」就: No dilute nitric acid: most of the iron in the sample is Fe²⁺, which KSCN can't show. Saying “no iron” now is a misjudgment
异常 1：有人误加了氯水——φ 又跳回 +3 价，先把氯水关掉: Fault 1: someone wrongly added chlorine water. φ jumps back to +3; turn off the chlorine water first
异常 2：铁粉被滤掉了——没有还原剂，价态又弹回去，把铁粉加回去: Fault 2: the iron powder was filtered out. With no reducing agent, the state bounces back; add the iron powder back
已回到参考工况：① 沉淀站 · 敞口 · 静置 0 s · 全部试剂未加: Back to reference conditions: ① Precipitation station · open · 0 s standing · no reagents added
达标：铁的价态转化 · 压到 +2 价达标: Target met: Changing iron's oxidation state · Held at +2
本课目标：先在沉淀站看清「白 → 灰绿 → 红褐」是被 O₂ 氧化（并学会隔绝空: Lesson goal: first see at the precipitation station that “white → gray-green → red-brown” is oxidation by O₂ (and learn to exclude air) → identify +3 with KSCN → push the state down with iron powder and raise it with chlorine water → finally use the same method to test food for iron.

喀斯特地貌的形成与识别: Formation and Recognition of Karst Landforms
可溶岩 + 水 → 溶沟 → 洼地 → 峰丛峰林 → 孤峰残丘 · 地下溶洞: Soluble rock + water → solution grooves → depressions → peak clusters, peak forests → isolated peaks, residual hills · underground caves
徐霞客写的「峭峰离立，分行竞颖」——这些像从地里长出来的尖峰，是怎么一块岩层变出: Xu Xiake wrote of “sheer peaks standing apart, rising in rows as if vying to be tallest.” How did these spires, which seem to grow out of the ground, come from a single rock layer?
可溶性岩石的物质溶于水被带走、或重新沉淀: Material in soluble rock dissolves in water and is carried away, or is deposited again
溶沟：长条形 / 网格状，地面高低不平: Solution grooves: long strips / grid patterns, uneven ground
溶沟发展成洼地；底部平坦的坝子是农耕区: Grooves grow into depressions; flat-bottomed bazi are farmland
洼地边缘残留岩体：峰丛 → 峰林 → 孤峰 → 残丘: Rock left at depression edges: peak cluster → peak forest → isolated peak → residual hill
地下以溶洞为主；洞顶石钟乳向下、洞底石笋向上，接上成石柱: Underground, mainly caves; stalactites grow down from the ceiling, stalagmites up from the floor, and join to form columns
溶沟到洼地（坝子）这一段地表: The surface from solution grooves to depressions (bazi)
岩块下半的洞腔与洞内堆积（石钟乳 / 石笋）: The cave chamber in the lower half of the rock block and its deposits (stalactites / stalagmites)
什么样的岩石能被水「溶」出地貌？: What kind of rock can water “dissolve” into landforms?
拖动视角绕岩块看一圈：岩层的层理、裂隙，和上方落下的雨: Drag to rotate the view around the rock block: the bedding and fractures in the rock, and the rain falling from above
可溶岩块（层理 + 裂隙）+ 降雨；溶蚀速率 20.0 mm/ka（年降水 14: Soluble rock block (bedding + fractures) + rainfall; dissolution rate 20.0 mm/ka (annual precipitation 1400 mm, mean annual temperature 18 ℃); reaching the solution-groove stage takes 20.0 × 10⁴ years
溶于水并被带走 / 重新沉淀: Dissolved and carried away / deposited again
广西 · 贵州 · 云南最典型: Most typical in Guangxi · Guizhou · Yunnan
组成地壳的岩石有一部分是可溶性岩石，如石灰岩。: Some of the rocks that make up the crust are soluble, such as limestone.
在适当条件下，这类岩石的物质溶于水并被带走，或重新沉淀。: Under suitable conditions, material in these rocks dissolves in water and is carried away, or is deposited again.
地表和地下因此形成形态各异的地貌，统称喀斯特地貌；我国广西、贵州、云南最典型。: This creates landforms of many shapes above and below ground, together called karst landforms; in China they are most typical in Guangxi, Guizhou and Yunnan.
去掉这一步：学生会把喀斯特说成风蚀或流水搬运堆积。: Without this step: students describe karst as wind erosion or as material carried and deposited by running water.
易错：把喀斯特地貌的成因说成「风蚀」或「流水搬运堆积」——是物质溶于水被带走或重: Common mistake: attributing karst landforms to “wind erosion” or “transport and deposition by running water.” In fact, material dissolves in water and is carried away or deposited again.
可溶性岩石（如石灰岩）的物质溶于水并被带走、或重新沉淀，在地表和地下形成形态各异: Material in soluble rock (such as limestone) dissolves in water and is carried away, or is deposited again, forming landforms of many shapes above and below ground, together called karst landforms.
facts A2.1（p.66）、A5 #1/#2；B2.1 ②③、B3 第 1: facts A2.1 (p.66), A5 #1/#2; B2.1 ②③, B3 row 1
溶沟怎么变大成洼地？: How do solution grooves grow into depressions?
把「演化阶段」从溶沟拖到洼地：看地表从浅浅的沟槽变成一块宽凹地: Drag “Evolution stage” from solution grooves to depression: watch the surface change from shallow channels into a broad hollow
地表起伏 1 → 6 m；累积溶蚀深度 4 → 14 m；残余岩体占比 100: Surface relief 1 → 6 m; cumulative dissolution depth 4 → 14 m; remaining rock 100 % → 85 %; time to reach 20.0 → 70.0 × 10⁴ years
坝子是洼地的地方称呼: Bazi is a local name for a depression
溶沟呈长条形或网格状，地面高低不平、崎岖难行。: Solution grooves form long strips or grids, making the ground uneven and hard to cross.
溶沟进一步发展，可形成面积较大的洼地。: As solution grooves develop further, they can form large depressions.
底部平坦的洼地在云南、贵州叫坝子，是当地重要的农耕区——坝子是洼地的地方称呼，不: Flat-bottomed depressions are called bazi in Yunnan and Guizhou and are important local farmland; bazi is a local name for a depression, not a separate landform.
去掉这一步：「坝子」会被当成一种地貌类型。: Without this step: “bazi” gets treated as a landform type.
易错：把「坝子」当成地貌类型——它是洼地在云南、贵州等地的称呼。: Common mistake: treating “bazi” as a landform type. It is what depressions are called in places like Yunnan and Guizhou.
溶沟进一步发展可形成面积较大的洼地；底部平坦的洼地被当地人称为坝子，是重要的农耕: Solution grooves can develop further into large depressions; flat-bottomed depressions are called bazi by local people and are important farmland.
洼地边缘为什么立起一座座尖峰？: Why do pointed peaks rise one after another at the edges of depressions?
把阶段从洼地拖到峰林，盯住岩块正面的上沿：峰丛是一排尖峰连在一道墙上，峰林是尖峰: Drag the stage from depression to peak forest and watch the top edge of the rock block's front face: a peak cluster is a row of peaks joined on one wall; a peak forest has peaks cut all the way down to the flat ground, standing apart
地表起伏 6 → 24 → 42 m（峰值在峰林）；残余岩体占比 85 % →: Surface relief 6 → 24 → 42 m (peaking at the peak forest); remaining rock 85 % → 65 % → 45 %; cumulative dissolution depth 14 → 32 → 58 m
峰丛基座相连 · 峰林彼此分立: Peak cluster bases joined · peak forest peaks separate
起伏峰值在峰林（示意）: Relief peaks at the peak forest (illustrative)
洼地边缘残留的岩体常呈锥状耸立，构成峰丛、峰林。: Rock left at the edges of depressions often rises as cones, forming peak clusters and peak forests.
识别要点：峰丛的锥峰下部连成一整块基座，峰林的锥峰彼此分开。: How to tell them apart: in a peak cluster, the lower parts of the cone peaks join into one base; in a peak forest, the cone peaks stand apart.
起伏度在这里到峰值（42 m）：地面被切得最碎。: Relief peaks here (42 m): the ground is cut up the most.
去掉这一步：峰丛与峰林分不清——这是本课最高频的错。: Without this step: peak clusters and peak forests get confused, the most frequent mistake in this lesson.
易错：把峰丛与峰林颠倒或分不清——峰丛基座相连、峰林彼此分立，峰丛在峰林之前。: Common mistake: swapping or confusing peak clusters and peak forests. Peak cluster bases are joined, peak forest peaks stand apart, and peak clusters come before peak forests.
洼地边缘残留的岩体呈锥状耸立，构成峰丛、峰林；峰丛的锥峰下部连成基座，峰林彼此分: Rock left at the edges of depressions rises as cones, forming peak clusters and peak forests; the cone peaks of a cluster join at the base, those of a forest stand apart, and surface relief is greatest at the peak-forest stage.

峰林再溶下去会剩什么？: If a peak forest keeps dissolving, what is left?
把阶段从峰林拖到残丘：看锥峰越来越少、基座消失、最后只剩低矮岩块: Drag the stage from peak forest to residual hill: watch the cone peaks thin out, the base disappear, and only low rock blocks remain
地表起伏 42 → 30 → 12 m（先升后降，这一段在降）；残余岩体占比 4: Surface relief 42 → 30 → 12 m (rises then falls; this part falls); remaining rock 45 % → 25 % → 10 %; cumulative dissolution depth 58 → 88 → 120 m
峰林 → 孤峰 → 残丘: Peak forest → isolated peak → residual hill
起伏在峰林之后反而降下来: Relief actually falls after the peak forest
峰林可演变为孤峰，以至残丘：基座消失、只剩一两座孤立岩峰，最后是低矮零星岩块。: A peak forest can evolve into isolated peaks and then residual hills: the base disappears, only one or two isolated rock peaks remain, and finally there are low, scattered rock blocks.
起伏度先升后降（42 → 30 → 12 m），残余岩体从 45 % 降到 10: Relief rises then falls (42 → 30 → 12 m), and remaining rock drops from 45 % to 10 %.
顺序不能颠倒：孤峰不是演变的第一步。: The order can't be reversed: isolated peaks are not the first stage of evolution.
去掉这一步：学生把孤峰当成演变的起点。: Without this step: students treat isolated peaks as the starting point of evolution.
易错：把孤峰说成演变的第一步；把「越往后起伏越大」当规律。: Common mistakes: calling isolated peaks the first stage of evolution; treating “later stages always have more relief” as a rule.
峰林可演变为孤峰、以至残丘：基座消失、岩体越来越少、越来越低；起伏度在峰林之后反: A peak forest can evolve into isolated peaks and then residual hills: the base disappears, and the rock becomes ever smaller and lower; relief actually falls after the peak forest.
同样的岩石，为什么有的地方蚀得快？: With the same rock, why does it erode faster in some places?
把「年降水量」从 1400 拖到 600 mm：看溶蚀变慢、到达同一阶段要多等多: Drag “Annual precipitation” from 1400 to 600 mm: watch dissolution slow down and how much longer it takes to reach the same stage
Dissolution rate 20.0 → 8.6 mm/ka; reaching the peak forest takes 290.0 → 676.7 × 10⁴ years; comparison end point (2400 mm precipitation + 25 ℃ mean annual temperature): rate 39.1 mm/ka, time 148.4 × 10⁴ years
「溶于水」要有水、也要有热量：降水多、温度高，溶蚀就快。: “Dissolving in water” needs both water and heat: more rain and higher temperature mean faster dissolution.
同一个峰林阶段，降水 1400 mm 要 290.0 万年，降到 600 mm: For the same peak-forest stage, 1400 mm of rain takes 290.0 × 10⁴ years; at 600 mm it takes 676.7 × 10⁴ years.
所以喀斯特在我国西南发育得好——水热条件都够。: That's why karst is well developed in southwest China: there is enough water and heat.
去掉这一步：学生会以为喀斯特哪里都能长成峰林。: Without this step: students think karst can grow into peak forests anywhere.
常考：降水多、气温高 → 溶蚀快；反之到达同一阶段需要更久。: Common exam point: more rain and higher temperature → faster dissolution; otherwise, reaching the same stage takes longer.
喀斯特发育要在「适当条件」下：水多、温度高，溶蚀快，到达同一阶段的时间短。: Karst develops under “suitable conditions”: with plenty of water and high temperature, dissolution is fast and it takes less time to reach the same stage.

洞里那些「石头」往哪个方向长？: Which way do the “stones” in the cave grow?
把「洞内堆积时间」拖到 20.0 万年：盯住石钟乳的顶端往下走、石笋的顶端往上走: Drag “Cave deposition time” to 20.0 × 10⁴ years: watch the tip of the stalactite move down and the tip of the stalagmite move up
石钟乳与石笋各长到 10.0 m（洞高 12 m）；石钟乳顶端由 12 → 2: Stalactite and stalagmite each grow to 10.0 m (cave height 12 m); the stalactite tip goes from 12 → 2 m (downward), the stalagmite tip from 0 → 10 m (upward); forming a column takes 12.0 × 10⁴ years, and at 20.0 × 10⁴ years a column has already formed
接上成石柱（12 m 的洞要 12.0 万年）: Joined into a column (a 12 m cave takes 12.0 × 10⁴ years)
地下喀斯特地貌以溶洞为主；溶洞长数米到数百千米，常常呈层状分布。: Underground karst landforms are mainly caves; caves range from a few meters to hundreds of kilometers long and are often arranged in levels.
洞顶常见向下发育的石钟乳、石幔或石帘；洞底常见向上发育的石笋。: On cave ceilings there are often downward-growing stalactites, flowstone or draperies; on cave floors, upward-growing stalagmites.
两者接上就是石柱：12 m 高的洞要 12.0 万年。: When the two join, they form a column: a 12 m tall cave takes 12.0 × 10⁴ years.
去掉这一步：石钟乳与石笋的方向极易说反，也没有「洞高决定时间」这条量。: Without this step: the directions of stalactites and stalagmites are very easy to mix up, and there's no sense that “cave height sets the time.”
易错：把石钟乳和石笋的方向说反——洞顶向下、洞底向上；也易错在说成「水冲下来的泥: Common mistakes: mixing up the directions of stalactites and stalagmites (down from the ceiling, up from the floor); also saying they are “piles of mud and sand washed in by water.”
溶洞顶部向下发育石钟乳、石幔或石帘，底部向上发育石笋，两者连接起来形成石柱；洞越: Stalactites, flowstone or draperies grow down from the cave ceiling, stalagmites grow up from the floor, and when they join they form a column; the taller the cave, the longer it takes to join.
考核：把地表做到起伏最大的那一阶段，并让石钟乳与石笋刚好接上: Test: bring the surface to the stage with the greatest relief, and make the stalactite and stalagmite just join
两件事一起做：地表找到起伏最大的阶段；洞里让石钟乳与石笋接上（洞高 12 m）: Do both together: on the surface, find the stage with the greatest relief; in the cave, make the stalactite and stalagmite join (cave height 12 m)
达标的一组：阶段＝峰林（起伏 42 m、残余岩体 45 %）、洞内堆积 12.0: One passing set: stage = peak forest (relief 42 m, remaining rock 45 %), cave deposition 12.0 × 10⁴ years → stalactite and stalagmite each 6.0 m, both tips at the 6 m midpoint, column formed

观察根尖分生区组织细胞的有丝分裂: Observing Mitosis in Root-Tip Meristem Cells
各期细胞数 ÷ 计数总数 × 12 h = 该期时长: Cells in a phase ÷ total cells counted × 12 h = duration of that phase
一根洋葱根尖上，哪些细胞正在分裂？它们分裂一次各要多久？: On an onion root tip, which cells are dividing? How long does each stage of one division take?
50 个细胞里各期有几个: How many of 50 cells are in each phase
细胞数比 = 时长比: Ratio of cell counts = ratio of durations
解离、漂洗、染色、制片；根尖 2~3 mm，分生区在尖端后 0.16~1.6 m: Dissociate, rinse, stain, mount; root tip 2–3 mm, meristem 0.16–1.6 mm behind the tip
取样框里 50 个细胞，正方形的细胞排列紧密: 50 cells in the sampling frame; square cells, tightly packed
染色质、染色体、纺锤丝、细胞板: Chromatin, chromosomes, spindle fibers, cell plate
怎样把根尖做成能看清染色体的临时装片？: How do you turn a root tip into a temporary slide where chromosomes are visible?
按顺序点四个玻璃皿：解离 → 漂洗 → 染色 → 制片: Click the four dishes in order: dissociate → rinse → stain → mount
四个玻璃皿依次亮：解离 3~5 min（使细胞相互分离）→ 漂洗 3~5 min: The four dishes light up in turn: dissociation 3–5 min (separates the cells from each other) → rinsing 3–5 min (washes off the reagent) → staining about 10 min (crystal violet stains the chromosomes) → mounting (squash to spread the cells out)
解离：剪取根尖 2~3 mm，放进盐酸和酒精的混合液（1:1），用时 3~5 m: Dissociation: cut a 2–3 mm root tip and put it in a 1:1 mix of hydrochloric acid and ethanol for 3–5 min.
漂洗：放进清水里，用时 3~5 min，洗去药液、防止解离过度。: Rinsing: put it in clean water for 3–5 min to wash off the reagent and prevent over-dissociation.
染色：放进甲紫溶液约 10 min，使染色体着色；最后压片，使细胞分散。: Staining: put it in crystal violet solution for about 10 min to stain the chromosomes; finally squash it to spread the cells out.
去掉解离这一步：细胞挤在一起，压不开，看不清每一条染色体。: Skip dissociation: the cells stay stuck together, can’t be squashed apart, and individual chromosomes can’t be seen clearly.
解离使组织中的细胞相互分离开来；漂洗是洗去药液、防止解离过度（教材原话）。: Dissociation separates the cells in the tissue from each other; rinsing washes off the reagent and prevents over-dissociation (textbook wording).
制片流程固定为解离 → 漂洗 → 染色 → 制片：细胞先分开、再洗去药液、再让染: The slide-prep sequence is fixed as dissociate → rinse → stain → mount: first separate the cells, then wash off the reagent, then stain the chromosomes, and finally squash into a single clear layer of cells.
低倍镜下，哪一段细胞在分裂？: Under low power, which region’s cells are dividing?
在 3D 里点出「分生区」，再换到 40× 物镜: In 3D, click the “Meristem”, then switch to the 40× objective
根尖三段里，分生区的细胞呈正方形、排列紧密（教材的判别特征）；换到 40× 后视: Of the three regions of the root tip, meristem cells are square and tightly packed (the textbook’s identifying feature); after switching to 40× the field gets smaller and the cells bigger, and the world label now reads “400× magnification · field 450 µm”
有丝分裂常见于根尖、芽尖等分生区细胞。: Mitosis is common in meristem cells such as those of root tips and shoot tips.
分生区细胞呈正方形、排列紧密——这是教材给的判别特征。: Meristem cells are square and tightly packed — this is the identifying feature the textbook gives.
同一分生组织里各个细胞的分裂是独立进行的，所以一个视野里能看到不同时期。: Each cell in the same meristem divides independently, so one field of view shows different phases.
去掉找分生区这一步：在别的区段数，几乎找不到处于分裂期的细胞（根冠、伸长区的形态: Skip finding the meristem: counting in another region, you’ll find almost no dividing cells (the shapes of the root cap and elongation zone are this lesson’s schematic, not described in the textbook).
观察顺序：先低倍镜找到分生区，再换高倍镜；高倍镜下先找中期细胞。: Observation order: find the meristem under low power first, then switch to high power; under high power, look for a metaphase cell first.
有丝分裂常见于根尖、芽尖等分生区细胞；分生区细胞呈正方形、排列紧密，换到高倍镜才: Mitosis is common in meristem cells such as those of root tips and shoot tips; meristem cells are square and tightly packed, and only under high power can the shape of the chromosomes be seen clearly.
把「主角细胞」从间期拨到前期: Switch the “Featured cell” from interphase to prophase
染色质丝螺旋缠绕、缩短变粗成染色体；每条染色体含 2 条并列的姐妹染色单体，由一: Chromatin threads coil, shorten and thicken into chromosomes; each chromosome has 2 side-by-side sister chromatids joined by one centromere; the nucleolus breaks down and the nuclear envelope disappears; spindle fibers from the two poles form a spindle-shaped spindle; readings: 16 chromosomes, 32 DNA, 32 chromatids
染色质丝螺旋缠绕、缩短变粗，成为染色体。: Chromatin threads coil, shorten and thicken to become chromosomes.
每条染色体包括两条并列的姐妹染色单体，由一个共同的着丝粒连接。: Each chromosome consists of two side-by-side sister chromatids joined by a shared centromere.
核仁逐渐解体、核膜逐渐消失，细胞两极发出纺锤丝，形成梭形的纺锤体。: The nucleolus gradually breaks down and the nuclear envelope gradually disappears; spindle fibers from the two poles of the cell form a spindle-shaped spindle.
去掉纺锤体：染色体不能被牵引，就排不到赤道板上。: Without the spindle: chromosomes can’t be pulled, so they can’t line up on the equatorial plate.
间期复制完成后染色体仍是 16 条；多出来的是 DNA（32）和姐妹染色单体（3: After replication in interphase there are still 16 chromosomes; what has doubled is DNA (32) and sister chromatids (32).
前期：染色质凝集成染色体（每条 2 条姐妹染色单体），核仁解体、核膜消失，纺锤体: Prophase: chromatin condenses into chromosomes (each with 2 sister chromatids), the nucleolus breaks down, the nuclear envelope disappears and the spindle forms; the chromosome number is unchanged, and DNA is already 32.
中期，染色体排在什么位置？: In metaphase, where do the chromosomes line up?
16 条染色体的着丝粒都排到细胞中央的一个平面上（赤道板），着丝粒两侧都有纺锤丝: The centromeres of all 16 chromosomes line up on one plane in the middle of the cell (the equatorial plate), with spindle fibers pulling on both sides of each centromere; readings still 16 chromosomes, 32 DNA, 32 chromatids
着丝粒排列在赤道板上: Centromeres line up on the equatorial plate
赤道板与纺锤体中轴垂直: The equatorial plate is perpendicular to the spindle axis
每条染色体的着丝粒两侧都有纺锤丝附着在上面。: Spindle fibers attach to both sides of each chromosome’s centromere.
纺锤丝牵引染色体运动，使着丝粒排列在细胞中央的一个平面上。: Spindle fibers pull the chromosomes so that the centromeres line up on one plane in the middle of the cell.
这个平面与纺锤体的中轴垂直，叫赤道板；教材的观察顺序是先找中期细胞，再找前期、后: This plane is perpendicular to the spindle axis and is called the equatorial plate; the textbook’s observation order is to find a metaphase cell first, then prophase, anaphase and telophase.
去掉纺锤丝：染色体排不到赤道板，也就没有「赤道板」这个平面可看。: Without spindle fibers: the chromosomes can’t line up on the equatorial plate, so there is no “equatorial plate” plane to see.
赤道板是细胞中央的一个平面（位置），末期才在赤道板的位置出现细胞板（结构）。: The equatorial plate is a plane in the middle of the cell (a position); only in telophase does a cell plate (a structure) appear at its position.
中期：所有染色体的着丝粒都排列在赤道板上——一个与纺锤体中轴垂直的平面；每条染色: Metaphase: the centromeres of all chromosomes line up on the equatorial plate — a plane perpendicular to the spindle axis; each chromosome still has 2 sister chromatids.
后期染色体数为什么突然加倍？: Why does the chromosome number suddenly double in anaphase?
把「主角细胞」拨到后期，盯着丝粒: Switch the “Featured cell” to anaphase and watch the centromeres
每个着丝粒分裂成两个，姐妹染色单体分开成为 2 条染色体，被纺锤丝拉向两极；读数: Each centromere splits in two, the sister chromatids separate into 2 chromosomes and are pulled toward the poles by spindle fibers; readings: chromosomes 16 → 32 (doubled), DNA still 32 (unchanged), chromatids 32 → 0; each pole gets a set of 16, identical in shape and number
每个着丝粒分裂成两个，姐妹染色单体分开，成为两条染色体。: Each centromere splits in two, and the sister chromatids separate to become two chromosomes.
两条子染色体由纺锤丝牵引，分别向细胞两极移动。: The two daughter chromosomes are pulled by spindle fibers toward opposite poles of the cell.
结果是两极各有一套染色体，形态和数目完全相同，也与亲代相同。: As a result each pole has one set of chromosomes, identical in shape and number to each other and to the parent cell.
去掉着丝粒分裂：两条姐妹染色单体分不开，染色体数不会加倍。: Without the centromeres splitting: the two sister chromatids can’t separate, and the chromosome number doesn’t double.
后期染色体数加倍（16 → 32），DNA 分子数不变（仍 32）——说「后期: In anaphase the chromosome number doubles (16 → 32) while the number of DNA molecules is unchanged (still 32) — saying “DNA also doubles in anaphase” is wrong.
后期：着丝粒分裂，姐妹染色单体分开成两条染色体，染色体数暂时加倍到 32，DNA: Anaphase: the centromeres split, the sister chromatids separate into two chromosomes, the chromosome number temporarily doubles to 32 while DNA is unchanged, and each pole receives a set of chromosomes identical to the parent cell’s.
一个细胞怎样变成两个细胞？: How does one cell become two?
染色体变细长盘曲成染色质丝，纺锤丝消失，两极出现新的核膜和核仁；赤道板位置出现细: Chromosomes become long, thin coiled chromatin threads, spindle fibers disappear, and new nuclear envelopes and nucleoli appear at the poles; a cell plate appears at the equatorial plate and gradually spreads into a new cell wall; at the end of telophase each daughter cell has 16 chromosomes and 16 DNA, the same as the parent
动物细胞：细胞膜内凹缢裂: Animal cells: the cell membrane pinches in
两套染色体到达两极后，每条染色体逐渐变成细长盘曲的染色质丝。: Once the two sets of chromosomes reach the poles, each chromosome gradually becomes a long, thin coiled chromatin thread.
纺锤丝消失，出现新的核膜和核仁，形成两个新的细胞核。: The spindle fibers disappear, and new nuclear envelopes and nucleoli appear, forming two new nuclei.
植物细胞在赤道板的位置出现细胞板，逐渐扩展形成新的细胞壁。: In plant cells a cell plate appears at the equatorial plate and gradually spreads to form a new cell wall.
去掉细胞板：植物细胞分不成两个细胞（动物细胞不形成细胞板，靠细胞膜内凹缢裂）。: Without the cell plate: a plant cell can’t split into two cells (animal cells form no cell plate; their membrane pinches in).
植物细胞末期形成细胞板；动物细胞末期细胞膜内凹缢裂——两者的染色体行为相同。: Plant cells form a cell plate in telophase; in animal cells the cell membrane pinches in — the chromosome behavior is the same in both.
末期：染色体解螺旋成染色质丝，核膜核仁重建，植物细胞在赤道板处形成细胞板并扩展成: Telophase: chromosomes uncoil into chromatin threads, the nuclear envelope and nucleolus re-form, and in plant cells a cell plate forms at the equatorial plate and spreads into a new cell wall; one cell becomes two daughter cells, each with 16 chromosomes, the same as the parent.
一个视野里有多少细胞正在分裂？: How many cells in a field of view are dividing?
取样框里 50 个细胞：样本 1 间期 45、前期 3、中期 1、后期 0、末期: 50 cells in the sampling frame: Sample 1 has interphase 45, prophase 3, metaphase 1, anaphase 0, telophase 1 → 5 dividing (10.0%); Sample 2 has interphase 45, prophase 2, metaphase 0, anaphase 1, telophase 2 → also 5 (10.0%)
分裂期的细胞数远少于间期细胞数。: Dividing cells are far fewer than interphase cells.
一个视野不一定凑齐五个时期：样本 1 里没有后期，样本 2 里没有中期。: One field doesn’t always have all five phases: Sample 1 has no anaphase, Sample 2 has no metaphase.
把视野移到分生区一个新的区域再数一次，样本更大、比例更稳。: Move the field to a new part of the meristem and count again: a larger sample gives a steadier ratio.
去掉计数：只能说「间期细胞多」，说不出多多少，也算不出各期时长。: Skip counting: you can only say “there are many interphase cells”, not how many more, and you can’t work out each phase’s duration.
间期细胞最多（教材练习 1（1）的配套答案）：间期占细胞周期的 90%~95%。: Interphase cells are the most numerous (answer to textbook Exercise 1 (1)): interphase takes up 90–95% of the cell cycle.
同一分生组织里各个细胞的分裂独立进行；取样框的 50 个细胞里，处于分裂期的只有: Each cell in the same meristem divides independently; of the 50 cells in the sampling frame only 5 (10.0%) are dividing, and interphase cells are the vast majority.
用细胞数能算出各期有多长吗？: Can cell counts tell us how long each phase lasts?
切到样本 2 再点一次「记录一组」，让两个视野各记一行: Switch to Sample 2 and click “Record a set” again, so each field gets one row
两个样本合计 100 个细胞：间期 90、前期 5、中期 1、后期 1、末期 3: The two samples total 100 cells: interphase 90, prophase 5, metaphase 1, anaphase 1, telophase 3; scaled to 12 h: interphase 10.8 h, prophase 0.6 h, metaphase 0.12 h, anaphase 0.12 h, telophase 0.36 h; the dividing phase totals 1.2 h
各期时长 = 该期细胞数 ÷ 总数 × 12 h: Phase duration = cells in phase ÷ total × 12 h
细胞数比例约等于各期时长比例（前提：各细胞的分裂是随机、独立进行的）。: The ratio of cell counts is roughly the ratio of phase durations (assuming each cell divides randomly and independently).
间期 90 个 ≈ 90%，折算 10.8 h，是全周期里最长的一段。: Interphase 90 cells ≈ 90%, scaled to 10.8 h — the longest part of the whole cycle.
分裂期四期里前期最长：5 个 ≈ 5%，折算 0.6 h。: Of the four dividing phases, prophase is longest: 5 cells ≈ 5%, scaled to 0.6 h.
只记一个样本（50 个细胞）：末期只剩 1 个，比例误差太大。: Recording only one sample (50 cells): telophase has just 1 cell, so the ratio error is too large.
用「各期细胞数 ÷ 计数总数 × 细胞周期」估算各期时长——这是教材讨论 2 给: Estimate each phase’s duration as “cells in phase ÷ total cells counted × cell cycle” — the method given in textbook Discussion 2.
细胞数比 = 时期时长比：两个样本合计 100 个细胞里间期 90 个，折合 1: Ratio of cell counts = ratio of phase durations: of the 100 cells in the two samples, 90 are in interphase, equal to 10.8 h; 10 are dividing, equal to 1.2 h. Interphase cells are most numerous because interphase is the longest.
考核：估出分裂期大约有多长: Test: estimate how long the dividing phase lasts
记满两个分生区视野（各点一次「记录一组」），合计分裂期细胞 8–12 个，保持: Record two meristem fields (click “Record a set” once for each), with 8–12 dividing cells in total, and hold for 15 seconds
达标横幅；开考 6 秒时视野会滑到伸长区（细胞变长、不再分裂，不分期），主读数掉: Target met banner; 6 seconds into the test the field slides to the elongation zone (cells get long, stop dividing, no phases), the main reading drops to 0, and you must move the field back to the meristem and record again
8 ≤ 两个视野合计的分裂期细胞 ≤ 12: 8 ≤ dividing cells in both fields combined ≤ 12
两个样本各 50 个细胞，合计 100 个。: Two samples of 50 cells each, 100 in total.
只能数分生区的视野：伸长区的细胞已经不再分裂、不在细胞周期里，不分期（世界的示意: Only meristem fields can be counted: elongation-zone cells no longer divide, are not in the cell cycle and have no phases (this lesson’s schematic).
8–12 个对应 8%~12%，即 12 h 里的 1.0–1.4 h，与分裂期: 8–12 cells means 8–12%, i.e. 1.0–1.4 h of 12 h, consistent with the 1.2 h dividing phase.
没有新内容：前八步都用上就能达标。: Nothing new: using all of the first eight steps is enough to meet the target.
Dividing-phase duration ≈ share of dividing cells × cell cycle = 10% × 12 h = 1.2 h.
分裂期约占细胞周期的 10%，12 h 里约 1.2 h——用数出来的细胞数就能: The dividing phase takes about 10% of the cell cycle, about 1.2 h of 12 h — you can estimate the duration from counted cells.
已换物镜：倍数与视场见世界标签: Objective switched: see the world label for magnification and field

铜丝一插下去，实验管里立刻剧烈冒泡、管内气体变成红棕色，气体中 NO₂ 的体积分: As soon as the copper wire goes in, the test tube bubbles violently and the gas turns red-brown; the NO₂ volume fraction jumps from 0.0 % to 100.0 % and the solution turns from colorless to green; the control tube on the left also gives off red-brown gas. Pull the wire up and the bubbling stops at once; the red-brown stops building
常温 · 铜丝插入浓硝酸 · 尾气 NaOH 吸收: Room temp · Copper wire in conc. HNO₃ · Tail gas absorbed by NaOH
硝酸与金属反应不放氢气（放 H₂ 的是稀硫酸、盐酸那一路）；浓硝酸的还原产物是: Nitric acid reacting with metals gives no hydrogen (H₂ comes from dilute H₂SO₄ or HCl); the reduction product of conc. HNO₃ is NO₂, with N going from +5 to +4.
红棕色是 NO₂ 的颜色，NO 是无色的；两种气体都无色无味地记混，是这课最常见: Red-brown is the color of NO₂; NO is colorless. Mixing up which of the two is colorless is the most common mistake in this lesson.
教材练习第 6 题原文说浓硝酸这一支「反应剧烈进行，铜丝逐渐变细，溶液变绿，试管: Textbook Exercise 6 says of the concentrated tube: “the reaction is vigorous, the copper wire gradually thins, the solution turns green, and red-brown gas appears above”. The green is not a color change of copper ions: NO₂ dissolved in the acid looks yellow and Cu²⁺ looks blue; together they look green.

硝酸是很强的氧化剂：它把铜氧化成 Cu²⁺，自身被还原成 NO₂（N 由 +5: Nitric acid is a strong oxidizer: it oxidizes copper to Cu²⁺ and is itself reduced to NO₂ (N from +5 to +4, each N gaining 1 electron); NO₂ is a red-brown gas. The textbook pulls up the copper wire to stop the reaction at any time.
换成稀硝酸，气体怎么变成无色了？它跑到哪去了？: With dilute nitric acid, why is the gas colorless? Where did the red-brown go?
把实验工况从「浓硝酸」拨到「稀硝酸」，盯住颜色与三个读数: Switch the conditions from “conc. HNO₃” to “dilute HNO₃” and watch the color and the three readings
换成稀硝酸：气泡从「剧烈」变成「缓慢」，溶液从绿色变蓝色，管内气体无色、气体中: With dilute acid: bubbling goes from “violent” to “slow”, the solution turns from green to blue, the gas in the tube is colorless, and the NO₂ volume fraction drops from 100.0 % to 0.0 %; the control tube stays red-brown. A faint red-brown layer appears at the delivery tube mouth: the colorless gas turns red as soon as it meets air
常温 · 铜丝插入 · 尾气 NaOH 吸收: Room temp · Copper wire inserted · Tail gas absorbed by NaOH
浓、稀硝酸的还原产物不同（NO₂ / NO），但都不是氢气：N 分别被还原到 +: Conc. and dilute HNO₃ give different reduction products (NO₂ / NO), but neither gives H₂: N is reduced to +4 and +2 respectively.
稀硝酸实验中「试管中的气体略有红棕色」是 NO 被空气里的氧气氧化了，不是稀硝酸: In the dilute-acid experiment, the “slightly red-brown gas in the tube” is NO oxidized by O₂ in the air, not red-brown gas made by the dilute acid itself (textbook Exercise 6).
同样多的铜，稀硝酸放出的气体物质的量只有浓硝酸的 1/3：1 mol Cu 失: For the same amount of copper, dilute HNO₃ releases only 1/3 as many moles of gas as conc. HNO₃: 1 mol Cu loses 2 mol electrons, giving 2 mol NO₂ with conc. acid but 2/3 mol NO with dilute acid.
去掉这一步：学生会以为「硝酸和铜反应就是出红棕色气体」，考到稀硝酸就答错。: Without this step: students think “nitric acid + copper always gives red-brown gas” and get dilute-acid questions wrong.

Once NO meets O₂ in the air it instantly becomes red-brown NO₂ (2NO + O₂ = 2NO₂), so “colorless” is only temporary.
同一片铁片放进浓硝酸，怎么连气泡都没有了？: Why does an iron strip in conc. nitric acid give no bubbles at all?

HNO₃) still fizzes red-brown. Switch the conditions back to “dilute HNO₃” and the same iron strip bubbles steadily again

钝化不是「铁不与硝酸反应」，而是表面被浓硝酸氧化出一层致密薄膜，把内部金属盖住、: Passivation does not mean “iron doesn’t react with nitric acid”: conc. HNO₃ oxidizes the surface into a dense thin film that covers the metal inside and stops further reaction.
判据是气泡：钝化和铁遇稀硝酸这两格的 φ 都是 0.0 %，光看 φ 分不出来，: The test is the bubbles: passivation and iron in dilute acid both show φ = 0.0 %, so φ alone can’t tell them apart; you must check the “reaction rate” cell.

常温下铁、铝的表面被浓硝酸氧化，生成一层致密薄膜把内部金属盖住（钝化），反应很快: At room temperature, conc. HNO₃ oxidizes the surface of iron or aluminum into a dense thin film that covers the metal inside (passivation), so the reaction soon stops. That is why iron and aluminum containers can hold conc. HNO₃, yet the same iron still reacts in dilute acid.
尾气去哪了: Where Does the Tail Gas Go?
这股红棕色气体要是直接排到屋里，会怎样？: What happens if this red-brown gas is vented straight into the room?
把尾气导管插回 NaOH 溶液（起始是没接），看烟带和风险条: Put the tail-gas tube back into the NaOH solution (it starts disconnected) and watch the plume and risk bar
尾气未接时：导管口向上飘出一股红棕色烟带，风险条升到 0.85（报警），旁边写着: With the tail gas disconnected, a red-brown plume drifts up from the tube mouth and the risk bar rises to 0.85 (alarm), labeled “NOx escaping · toxic”. Put the tube back into the NaOH solution: the plume disappears, small bubbles keep rising in the beaker, and risk returns to 0.10, while the main reading doesn’t move at all (still 100.0 %)
尾气：NO、NO₂ + NaOH 溶液: Tail gas: NO, NO₂ + NaOH solution
导管末端浸入液面以下: Tube end below the liquid surface
尾气开关是安全开关：接不接它，主读数一格都不变（对照第 2 步的 100.0 %: The tail-gas switch is a safety switch: connected or not, the main reading doesn’t change (compare 100.0 % in Step 2).
导管要浸到液面以下才算「吸收」，悬在液面上方等于直排。: The tube must dip below the liquid surface to count as “absorbing”; hanging above the surface is the same as venting.
教材没有给 NOx 与 NaOH 反应的方程式，本课也不写，只照图5-14 的图: The textbook gives no equation for NOx + NaOH, so this lesson doesn’t either; it only follows the Fig. 5-14 caption: “absorb with NaOH solution”.
去掉这一步：学生做完实验就把红棕色气体排进实验室，还以为「开窗通风就行」。: Without this step: students vent red-brown gas into the lab after the experiment, thinking “opening a window is enough”.

NO 和 NO₂ 都是有毒气体。教材图5-14 右边那只烧杯里装的就是 NaOH: NO and NO₂ are both toxic gases. The beaker on the right of textbook Fig. 5-14 holds NaOH solution, with the tube end below the surface, to absorb the tail gas. Whether it is connected affects only safety and the environment, not how much gas you make.
浓硝酸为什么非得装在棕色瓶里、还得放阴凉处？: Why must conc. nitric acid be kept in a brown bottle in a cool place?
把浓硝酸从「透明瓶见光」换回「棕色瓶避光」，看瓶子和风险条: Switch the conc. acid from “clear bottle in light” back to “brown bottle in the dark” and watch the bottle and risk bar
透明瓶见光时，瓶口和瓶内出现红棕色气体，风险条升到 0.60（「浓硝酸分解 ·: In a clear bottle in light, red-brown gas appears at the neck and inside, and the risk bar rises to 0.60 (“conc. HNO₃ decomposing · reagent spoiling”); back in the brown bottle in a cool place, the red-brown disappears and risk returns to 0.10. The main reading stays at 100.0 % (it’s the acid in the bottle decomposing, not the gas in the tube)
分解产物里有 NO₂，所以「看见红棕色」本身就说明酸已经在分解。: One decomposition product is NO₂, so “seeing red-brown” already shows the acid is decomposing.
不只避光：受热一样分解，所以还要放阴凉处。: Not just light: heat decomposes it too, so it must also be kept cool.
这是保存问题不是反应问题：换掉瓶子，试管里的反应一点都不变。: This is a storage issue, not a reaction issue: changing the bottle doesn’t change the reaction in the tube at all.
去掉这一步：学生知道「棕色瓶」却写不出原因方程式，练习第 6(1) 题就丢分。: Without this step: students know “brown bottle” but can’t write the equation behind it, and lose marks on Exercise 6(1).
高频：硝酸盛放在棕色试剂瓶的原因（要求写方程式）；见光或受热分解的产物。: Frequent: why nitric acid is kept in brown reagent bottles (equation required); products of decomposition by light or heat.
浓硝酸见光或受热会分解：4HNO₃ = 4NO₂↑ + O₂↑ + 2H₂O，放: Conc. nitric acid decomposes in light or heat: 4HNO₃ = 4NO₂↑ + O₂↑ + 2H₂O. The NO₂ released turns the acid yellow and raises the pressure in the bottle, so it must be kept in a brown reagent bottle in a cool place. This is also the answer to textbook Exercise 6(1).

一束光就是一个个光子；只要 ν > νc，光再弱也立刻有电子出来: A beam of light is a stream of photons; as long as ν > νc, electrons come out at once, however weak the light
一个光子把 hν 全部交给一个电子；光强只加光子个数: One photon gives all of its hν to one electron; light intensity only adds more photons
电子交出逸出功 W₀ 才出得来，剩下 Ek = hν − W₀: An electron must pay the work function W₀ to get out, leaving Ek = hν − W₀

一层 24 个细胞，紫色的是液泡里的细胞液: One layer of 24 cells; the purple is the cell sap in the vacuoles

水为什么会穿过一层膜？: Why does water pass through a membrane?
盯住膜看几秒：数一数水分子往哪边走得多: Watch the membrane for a few seconds: count which way more water molecules move
膜下方有蔗糖分子，它们过不去；水分子两边都在穿，从上方（水多的一侧）下去的更多: Sucrose molecules below the membrane can't get through; water molecules cross both ways, but more go down from above (the side with more water)
水：相对含量高 → 相对含量低: Water: higher relative content → lower relative content
半透膜：水能过，蔗糖不能过: Semipermeable membrane: water passes, sucrose doesn't
渗透作用：水分子通过半透膜的扩散。: Osmosis: the diffusion of water molecules through a semipermeable membrane.
方向：从水的相对含量高的一侧，到相对含量低的一侧。: Direction: from the side with a higher relative water content to the side with a lower one.
玻璃纸是半透膜：水分子能自由透过，蔗糖分子不能。: Cellophane is a semipermeable membrane: water molecules pass freely, sucrose molecules don't.
去掉浓度差：两边水分子进出一样多，看不到净流动。: Without a concentration difference: water molecules move in and out equally on both sides, so there is no net flow.
渗透的两个条件：有半透膜，膜两侧有浓度差。: Two conditions for osmosis: a semipermeable membrane, and a concentration difference across it.
半透膜两侧存在浓度差时，水分子从水的相对含量高的一侧向相对含量低的一侧渗透，这就: When there is a concentration difference across a semipermeable membrane, water molecules move from the side with a higher relative water content to the side with a lower one. This is osmosis.
植物细胞里，哪一层相当于半透膜？: In a plant cell, which layer acts as the semipermeable membrane?
在剖开的细胞上点一下，找到原生质层: Click on the cut-open cell to find the protoplast layer
细胞剖开：外层是细胞壁，紧贴它的是原生质层，中间是紫色细胞液占满的中央液泡: Cell cut open: the outer layer is the cell wall, the layer right against it is the protoplast layer, and in the middle is the central vacuole full of purple cell sap
原生质层 = 细胞膜 + 细胞质 + 液泡膜: Protoplast layer = cell membrane + cytoplasm + vacuole membrane
细胞壁：全透，伸缩性小: Cell wall: fully permeable, not very stretchy
中央液泡占据细胞的大部分空间，把细胞质挤成一薄层。: The central vacuole takes up most of the cell, squeezing the cytoplasm into a thin layer.
细胞膜、液泡膜和两层膜之间的细胞质合称原生质层。: The cell membrane, the vacuole membrane and the cytoplasm between them together form the protoplast layer.
细胞壁对水全透，主要起保护和支持作用，伸缩性比较小。: The cell wall is fully permeable to water, mainly protects and supports the cell, and is fairly inelastic.
去掉「原生质层」这个概念：就说不清水是穿过哪一层进出液泡的。: Without the idea of a “protoplast layer”: you can't say which layer water crosses to get in and out of the vacuole.
质壁分离的「质」是原生质层，不是细胞质。: In “plasmolysis”, what pulls away from the wall is the protoplast layer, not the cytoplasm.
细胞膜和液泡膜以及两层膜之间的细胞质称为原生质层，它相当于一层半透膜；细胞壁对水: The cell membrane, vacuole membrane and the cytoplasm between them are called the protoplast layer, which acts as a semipermeable membrane; the cell wall is fully permeable to water.

细胞壁和原生质层都有一定程度的收缩。: Both the cell wall and the protoplast layer shrink to some extent.
原生质层比细胞壁伸缩性大，于是与细胞壁分离。: The protoplast layer is stretchier than the cell wall, so it pulls away from the wall.
去掉细胞壁（如动物细胞）：只会皱缩，看不到质壁分离。: Without a cell wall (as in animal cells): the cell just shrivels, with no plasmolysis.
记录表三项：中央液泡大小、原生质层位置、细胞大小。: Three items in the record table: central vacuole size, protoplast layer position, cell size.
外界溶液浓度大于细胞液浓度时细胞失水；原生质层比细胞壁的伸缩性大，原生质层与细胞: When the outside solution is more concentrated than the cell sap, the cell loses water; the protoplast layer is stretchier than the cell wall, so it gradually separates from the wall. This is plasmolysis.
细胞壁和原生质层之间，充满的是什么？: What fills the space between the cell wall and the protoplast layer?
看膜：水分子从哪条路走得多？: Watch the membrane: which route do more water molecules take?
水分子净流出细胞；大多经水通道蛋白，少数直接穿过磷脂双分子层: Water flows out of the cell overall; most goes through aquaporins, some directly through the phospholipid bilayer
分离后壁与原生质层之间充满外界溶液（学考通行结论；教材写的是细胞壁对水全透）。: After plasmolysis, the space between the wall and the protoplast layer is filled with outside solution (the standard exam answer; the textbook says the cell wall is fully permeable to water).
水分子更多借助水通道蛋白以协助扩散进出细胞。: Water molecules move in and out of cells mostly by facilitated diffusion through aquaporins.
顺浓度梯度，不消耗能量，属于被动运输。: It moves down the concentration gradient without using energy, so it is passive transport.

教材只给了用品和一张空表，这张表要怎么填？: The textbook only gives the materials and an empty table. How do you fill in that table?

并排的两支管里总有一支是对照：只改一个条件的那支叫实验管。: Of each pair of tubes side by side, one is always the control; the one with a single changed condition is the test tube.
读数栏把「看得见的现象」换成秒数，才比得出快几倍。: The readings panel turns “what you can see” into seconds, so you can tell how many times faster.
去掉变量控制：两管同时改了两个条件，比出来的差别说不清是谁造成的。: Without variable control: two conditions change at once, and you can't tell which one caused the difference.
常考「影响速率的因素有哪些」——浓度、温度、压强、催化剂，还有固体表面积。: Common exam item: “what factors affect rate?”: concentration, temperature, pressure, catalyst, and the surface area of solids.
教材的做法是变量控制：一次只改一个条件、其余全相同，再用「出现浑浊的时间」或「收: The textbook uses variable control: change one condition at a time, keep everything else the same, then turn speed into comparable numbers with “time until cloudiness appears” or “time to collect 10 mL H₂”.
加了同样多的酸，为什么稀的那一支浑浊得更慢？: The same amount of acid is added, so why does the more dilute tube cloud more slowly?
把稀释管的 Na₂S₂O₃ 从 2 mL 拖到 1 mL（另补 1 mL 蒸馏水: Drag the dilution tube's Na₂S₂O₃ from 2 mL to 1 mL (plus 1 mL distilled water), and watch both tubes' cloudiness and the main reading
实验管浑浊时间由 20.0 s 变成 40.0 s（c 由 0.050 变成 0: The test tube's cloudiness time goes from 20.0 s to 40.0 s (c from 0.050 to 0.025 mol/L); the control on the left stays at 20.0 s; on the same clock, the two tubes turn milky at different speeds
0.1 mol/L 各 2 mL · 25 ℃ · 总体积 4 mL: 0.1 mol/L, 2 mL each · 25 ℃ · total volume 4 mL
浓度减半 · 时间加倍: Half the concentration · double the time
稀释那支另加 1 mL 蒸馏水，两管总体积都是 4 mL，只有浓度不同。: The dilution tube gets an extra 1 mL distilled water, so both tubes have a total volume of 4 mL and differ only in concentration.
浓度按 0.1 mol/L × V / 4 mL 算出来，不是「看着稀一点」。: Concentration is calculated as 0.1 mol/L × V / 4 mL, not judged by “it looks a bit weaker”.
浑浊计时取「刚出现乳白」，两管用同一个标准才好比。: Cloudiness is timed at “milky just appears”; both tubes must use the same standard to compare.
去掉这一步的补水：体积不同、浓度算错，时间比变成 1.5 : 1，结论就说不圆了: Without the added water in this step: volumes differ, concentration is miscalculated, the time ratio becomes 1.5 : 1, and the conclusion no longer holds.
变量控制的写法是常考点：比较浓度必须控制温度、总体积、酸量，稀释管要补溶剂。: How to write up variable control is a common exam point: to compare concentrations, control temperature, total volume and acid amount, and add solvent to the dilution tube.
其他条件相同时，减小反应物浓度，速率减小、时间变长：浓度减半，时间加倍（本课按一: With other conditions the same, lowering reactant concentration lowers the rate and lengthens the time: half the concentration, double the time (this lesson uses a first-order relation, consistent with the textbook's qualitative conclusion).
A3.1、A4.4、A7.3、B2.1 算子 1/3 + D1: A3.1, A4.4, A7.3, B2.1 operators 1/3 + D1
同一支管放进热水，为什么几乎立刻浑了？: Why does the same tube cloud almost instantly in hot water?

水浴 25 → 45 ℃，浑浊时间由 20.0 s 掉到 2.4 s；冷水 15: Bath 25 → 45 ℃: cloudiness time drops from 20.0 s to 2.4 s; at 15 ℃ cold water it takes 64.7 s. Each 10 ℃ rise multiplies the rate by 2~4
升高温度 → 活化分子百分数增大 → 速率增大: Higher temperature → larger percentage of activated molecules → higher rate
冷水约 15 ℃ · 室温 25 ℃ · 热水约 55 ℃（温度计读水温）: Cold water ~15 ℃ · room temp 25 ℃ · hot water ~55 ℃ (thermometer reads water temperature)
两支管浓度相同（都是 2 mL 原管），唯一变量是水浴温度。: Both tubes have the same concentration (both 2 mL original); the only variable is the bath temperature.
教材给「每升高 10 ℃ 速率增大为原来的 2~4 倍」；本课的温度因子每 10: The textbook says “each 10 ℃ rise multiplies the rate by 2~4”; this lesson's temperature factor is about 3× per 10 ℃, within that range.
温度改的是「够能量的分子占多大比例」，不是把浓度改大。: Temperature changes “the fraction of molecules with enough energy”, not the concentration.
去掉这一步：只比浓度，学生会以为「越稀越慢」是唯一规律，遇到热水里几乎瞬间浑浊就: Without this step: comparing only concentration, students think “more dilute, slower” is the only rule, and can't explain near-instant cloudiness in hot water.
温度的影响非常显著（2~4 倍 / 10 ℃），常与浓度并列考，也常考「为什么低: Temperature has a very large effect (2~4× per 10 ℃); it's often tested alongside concentration, and so is “why reactions almost stop at low temperature”.
其他条件相同时，升高温度速率增大、降低温度速率减小；本课温度因子下每 10 ℃: With other conditions the same, raising temperature raises the rate and lowering it lowers the rate; this lesson's temperature factor is about 3× per 10 ℃ (textbook: 2~4×), so at 45 ℃ the cloudiness time is only about one-eighth of that at 25 ℃.
A3.1（温度组）、A3.3、A4.4、B2.1 算子 2/3 + D2: A3.1 (temperature set), A3.3, A4.4, B2.1 operators 2/3 + D2
只加一小撮黑色粉末，气泡为什么一下子密了？: Add just a pinch of black powder, so why do the bubbles suddenly get dense?
把「MnO₂ 粉末」拨到已加入，看那一管的气泡变成加催化剂时的样子；再拨回来对照: Switch “MnO₂ powder” to added and watch that tube's bubbles become catalyzed; switch it back to compare
关着时那管与空白管一样慢（1×）；加入后气泡速率升到 8×。加 FeCl₃ 的那: When off, that tube is as slow as the blank (1×); once added, the bubble rate rises to 8×. The FeCl₃ tube stays at 8×, and the blank bubbles slowly throughout (multiples are illustrative; the textbook only says both are faster than the blank)
10% H₂O₂ 各 2 mL · 少量 MnO₂ · 2 滴 1 mol/L: 10% H₂O₂, 2 mL each · a little MnO₂ · 2 drops 1 mol/L FeCl₃
三支管只有加入物不同，H₂O₂ 的体积与浓度都一样（各 2 mL 10%）。: The three tubes differ only in what's added; the H₂O₂ volume and concentration are the same (2 mL of 10% each).
空白管必须留着，否则「催化」这两个字就没了参照。: The blank tube must stay, or “catalysis” has nothing to compare against.
教材只说两种催化剂都比空白快、没比谁更快，所以本课给同一倍率，不排名次。: The textbook only says both catalysts are faster than the blank, not which is faster, so this lesson gives them the same multiple and doesn't rank them.
去掉空白对照：没法判断气泡是不是本来就该这么快。: Without the blank control: you can't tell whether the bubbles would be this fast anyway.
催化剂改变速率、改变反应历程，不改变反应热、不改变平衡转化率——这一句几乎是必考: A catalyst changes the rate and the reaction pathway, but not the heat of reaction or the equilibrium conversion. This is almost always tested.
催化剂改变反应历程、降低活化能，使活化分子数目增大、单位时间有效碰撞次数增加，速: A catalyst changes the reaction pathway and lowers the activation energy, increasing the number of activated molecules and effective collisions per unit time, so the rate rises; it doesn't change the heat of reaction or the equilibrium.
A3.1（催化剂组）、A5.6、A7.7、B2.4 + D3: A3.1 (catalyst set), A5.6, A7.7, B2.4 + D3
「快慢」能不能变成一个数？: Can “how fast” be turned into a number?
把硫酸从 1 mol/L 拖到 4 mol/L，看收集 10 mL H₂ 要多久: Drag the sulfuric acid from 1 mol/L to 4 mol/L and watch how long it takes to collect 10 mL H₂ and how the curve's slope changes
收集 10 mL H₂ 的时间由 64.0 s 变成 16.0 s，平均速率由: Time to collect 10 mL H₂ goes from 64.0 s to 16.0 s, and the average rate from 1.60×10⁻⁴ to 6.39×10⁻⁴ mol/(L·s); the curve's slope becomes 4 times steeper
2 g 锌粒 + 40 mL 硫酸 · 注射器量 10 mL H₂: 2 g zinc granules + 40 mL sulfuric acid · syringe measures 10 mL H₂
10 mL H₂ 在 25 ℃、101.325 kPa 下是 4.0876×10: 10 mL H₂ at 25 ℃ and 101.325 kPa is 4.0876×10⁻⁴ mol; divided by 40 mL of solution this gives Δc = 1.02×10⁻² mol/L.
速率用 H₂SO₄ 的浓度变化除以时间，单位 mol/(L·s)。: Rate is the change in H₂SO₄ concentration divided by time, in mol/(L·s).
只收集 10 mL（反应刚开始的一小段），得到的是这一段的平均速率。: Only 10 mL is collected (a short stretch at the start of the reaction), so the result is the average rate over that stretch.
去掉定量这一步：只知道「哪支快」，说不出快几倍，也没法选条件。: Without this quantitative step: you only know “which is faster”, not how many times faster, and can't choose conditions.
速率计算要写清「用哪种物质、哪一段时间内的平均速率」，这也是教材练习里反复出现的: A rate calculation must state “which substance, and the average rate over which time interval”; this format appears again and again in textbook exercises.
v = Δc/Δt：测出时间就能把快慢算成数；其他条件相同时，增大硫酸浓度速率增: v = Δc/Δt: measure the time and you can turn speed into a number; with other conditions the same, raising the sulfuric acid concentration raises the rate (1 → 4 mol/L shortens the time from 64.0 s to 16.0 s).
温度升高以后，瓶子里到底多了什么？: After the temperature rises, what exactly is there more of in the flask?
点一下台面上方那个放大箱，看里面的分子怎么撞: Click the magnified box above the bench and watch how the molecules inside collide
亮色（活化）分子明显变多：25 ℃ 约 4 %，45 ℃ 约 34 %，到 55: Bright (activated) molecules clearly increase: about 4 % at 25 ℃, about 34 % at 45 ℃, and nearly the whole box at 55 ℃; the percentage of activated molecules rises from 1.00× to 22.1× relative to 25 ℃ (magnified)
活化分子 + 有效碰撞 → 反应发生: Activated molecules + effective collisions → reaction happens
示意放大 · 60 个分子 · 亮色比例随温度变化: Magnified · 60 molecules · bright fraction changes with temperature
分子撞在一起不等于反应：只有能量够、取向对的碰撞才有效。: Molecules colliding doesn't mean they react: only collisions with enough energy and the right orientation are effective.
温度升高不增加分子总数，增加的是「够能量的那部分」的比例。: Raising the temperature doesn't add molecules; it raises the fraction that “have enough energy”.
催化剂不改分子能量，改的是门槛——活化能降下来，够能量的分子就多了。: A catalyst doesn't change molecular energy; it changes the threshold: with a lower activation energy, more molecules have enough energy.
去掉这一步：三个因素只能靠背，学生说不出为什么温度的影响比浓度更显著。: Without this step: the three factors can only be memorized, and students can't say why temperature has a bigger effect than concentration.
用碰撞理论解释浓度、温度、催化剂三条常一起考；要能分清「单位体积活化分子数」与「: Explaining concentration, temperature and catalysts with collision theory is often tested together; you must tell apart “activated molecules per unit volume” and “percentage of activated molecules”.
浓度增大 → 单位体积内活化分子数增多；温度升高 → 活化分子百分数增大；催化剂: Higher concentration → more activated molecules per unit volume; higher temperature → larger percentage of activated molecules; a catalyst lowers the activation energy → more molecules become activated. All three increase effective collisions per unit time and raise the rate.
两支管里的 Na₂S₂O₃ 不一样多、体积也不一样，这样比还公平吗？: The two tubes have different amounts of Na₂S₂O₃ and different volumes. Is that still a fair comparison?
把「补加蒸馏水」关掉（错误操作），看稀释管的浓度和时间怎么变；看完记得打开: Turn off “Add distilled water” (wrong action) and see how the dilution tube's concentration and time change; remember to turn it back on afterward
关掉补水：稀释管浓度由 0.025 变成 0.0333 mol/L，浑浊时间由: Water turned off: the dilution tube's concentration goes from 0.025 to 0.0333 mol/L, cloudiness time from 40.0 s to 30.0 s (10.0 s too short), and its ratio to the 20.0 s control from 2 : 1 to 1.5 : 1
同一组对照 · 只改一个条件: Same control set · change only one condition
总体积必须 4 mL = 2 mL 酸 + V(Na₂S₂O₃) + 补水: Total volume must be 4 mL = 2 mL acid + V(Na₂S₂O₃) + added water
错误操作 → 总体积只有 3 mL → c 由 0.025 变 0.0333 →: Wrong action → total volume only 3 mL → c from 0.025 to 0.0333 → cloudiness time from 40.0 s to 30.0 s (too short) → conclusion weakened.
计时标准要一致：看「刚出现浑浊」还是「完全浑浊」，时间能差一半。: Use a consistent timing standard: “cloudiness just appears” versus “fully cloudy” can differ by half the time.
温度没回到室温就换管比较，也属于没控制变量。: Switching tubes to compare before the temperature is back to room temperature also fails to control variables.
去掉这一步：学生会在实验报告里写出「浓度减半、时间不变」这样的错结论。: Without this step: students write wrong conclusions in lab reports, like “half the concentration, same time”.
误差分析常问「哪一步没有控制变量、结果偏大还是偏小」，答的时候要把链条写全。: Error analysis often asks “which step failed to control variables, and is the result too high or too low?”; answer with the full chain.
变量控制要求只改浓度、其余相同：稀释管必须补 1 mL 蒸馏水保持总体积 4 m: Variable control means changing only concentration with everything else the same: the dilution tube must get 1 mL distilled water to keep the total at 4 mL, or the concentration is miscalculated, the time is too short, and the difference is compressed.
A7.3、A4.6、A3.1 注文、B1 越界表 + D5: A7.3, A4.6, A3.1 note, B1 out-of-range table + D5

达标横幅「浓度对照复现成功」；水浴被抬到 45 ℃ 时浑浊时间掉到 2.4 s，: Target banner “Concentration control reproduced”; when the bath is raised to 45 ℃ the cloudiness time drops to 2.4 s, so drag it back to 25 ℃

不补水时间会偏到 30.0 s，差 10.0 s 就出界。: Without the water the time drifts to 30.0 s; 10.0 s off is out of range.

计时标准要前后一致：两管都取「刚出现乳白」。: Keep the timing standard consistent: time both tubes at “milky just appears”.
满分结构：变量控制（补水控体积）+ 现象计时 + 速率换算，三件事写全。: Full-mark answer: variable control (add water to fix volume) + timing the observation + rate calculation; write all three.
考核没有新结论：把「1 mL + 1 mL 水、总体积 4 mL、25 ℃」三件: No new conclusion in the test: only by handling “1 mL + 1 mL water, total volume 4 mL, 25 ℃” all at once does the cloudiness time land near 40.0 s.

研究浓度对速率的影响时，下列做法正确的是: When studying the effect of concentration on rate, which practice is correct?
两支管加不同浓度、不同温度的酸: Add acid of different concentrations and temperatures to the two tubes
稀释那支补加蒸馏水，使两支管总体积相同: Add distilled water to the dilution tube so both tubes have the same total volume
用不同体积的酸，其他都不管: Use different volumes of acid and ignore everything else
一支用水浴加热，另一支不放水浴: Heat one tube in a water bath and leave the other out
变量控制要求只改一个条件：比较浓度时温度、总体积、酸量都要相同，所以稀释管必须补: Variable control means changing only one condition: to compare concentrations, temperature, total volume and amount of acid must be the same, so the dilution tube must be topped up with solvent to the same volume.
关于温度对化学反应速率的影响，正确的是: Which statement about the effect of temperature on reaction rate is correct?
温度每升高 10 ℃，速率增大为原来的 2~4 倍: Each 10 ℃ rise multiplies the rate by 2~4
温度升高只影响平衡，不影响速率: Raising temperature affects only equilibrium, not rate
温度升高使分子总数变多: Raising temperature increases the total number of molecules
教材的口径是「温度每升高 10 ℃，化学反应速率通常增大为原来的 2~4 倍」；: The textbook says “each 10 ℃ rise usually multiplies the reaction rate by 2~4”; raising the temperature doesn't add molecules, it raises the percentage of activated molecules.
加入 MnO₂ 使 H₂O₂ 分解变快，下列判断正确的是: Adding MnO₂ speeds up the decomposition of H₂O₂. Which statement is correct?
MnO₂ 改变了反应的活化能，不改变反应热: MnO₂ changes the activation energy but not the heat of reaction
MnO₂ 提高了 H₂O₂ 的浓度: MnO₂ raises the concentration of H₂O₂
MnO₂ 使平衡向生成 O₂ 的方向移动: MnO₂ shifts the equilibrium toward producing O₂
MnO₂ 参与了反应并使反应放热更多: MnO₂ takes part in the reaction and makes it release more heat
催化剂改变反应历程、降低活化能，使活化分子数目增大；它不改变反应热，也不改变平衡: A catalyst changes the reaction pathway and lowers the activation energy, increasing the number of activated molecules; it doesn't change the heat of reaction or the equilibrium conversion.

This lesson uses a first-order relation: 4× the concentration gives 4× the rate and a quarter of the time, i.e. 16.0 s (the textbook only asks you to measure and compare; the seconds are lesson settings).
用碰撞理论解释「升温使速率增大」，最恰当的是: The best collision-theory explanation of “heating raises the rate” is
活化分子百分数增大，单位时间有效碰撞次数增多: a larger percentage of activated molecules and more effective collisions per unit time
温度升高使一部分原来能量较低的分子变成活化分子，活化分子百分数增大，有效碰撞次数: Raising the temperature turns some lower-energy molecules into activated molecules, so the percentage of activated molecules rises and effective collisions increase; it's not more molecules, and not a higher concentration.

少加了水，总体积只有 3 mL，浓度由 0.025 变成 0.0333 mol/: With less water the total volume is only 3 mL, concentration goes from 0.025 to 0.0333 mol/L (too high), the reaction is faster, and the time goes from 40.0 s to 30.0 s, so the reading is too low.
MnO₂ 已加入：该管气泡升到空白管的 8 倍（示意倍数）: MnO₂ added: that tube's bubbles rise to 8× the blank (illustrative multiple)
MnO₂ 未加入：该管气泡与空白一样慢（1×）: MnO₂ not added: that tube bubbles as slowly as the blank (1×)
未补蒸馏水：总体积只有 3 mL，浓度被抬高、浑浊时间偏小: No distilled water added: total volume only 3 mL, concentration raised, cloudiness time too short
已补 1 mL 蒸馏水：总体积 4 mL，只有浓度这一个变量: 1 mL distilled water added: total volume 4 mL, concentration is the only variable
