河流地貌的发育 · 3D 互动课件: Development of River Landforms · 3D Interactive Lesson
河谷加深、拓宽、延长：V 形 → 槽形: Valleys deepen, widen and lengthen: V-shaped → trough-shaped
长江镇江段的岸线为什么持续向北推移？: Why does the Yangtze's bank at Zhenjiang keep shifting north?
山区落差大 → 流速快 → 向下侵蚀为主: Big drop in the mountains → fast flow → mainly downcutting
落差减小 → 向两岸侵蚀加强 → 河谷拓宽: Drop decreases → lateral erosion strengthens → valley widens
凹岸侵蚀、凸岸堆积 → 河道更弯: Erosion on the concave bank, deposition on the convex bank → the channel bends more
流速减慢 → 搬运能力减弱 → 三种冲积平原: Flow slows → carrying capacity falls → three kinds of alluvial plain
落差大、流速快，以向下侵蚀为主，横剖面呈 V 形: Big drop and fast flow, mainly downcutting; V-shaped cross-section
出山口坡度骤减、流速减慢，粗颗粒就地堆积成扇: At the mountain mouth the slope drops sharply and flow slows, so coarse particles settle on the spot as a fan
河道弯曲，凹岸侵蚀、凸岸堆积，枯水露出成河漫滩: The channel bends; the concave bank erodes, the convex bank builds up, and at low water it's exposed as floodplain
入海处水下坡度平缓、流速减慢，泥沙在河口前方堆积并向海扩展: At the sea, the underwater slope is gentle and flow slows; sediment piles up in front of the mouth and spreads seaward
一条河从山里流到海，一路上留下了什么？: A river flows from the mountains to the sea. What does it leave along the way?
拖动视角，把整块沙盘转一圈: Drag to rotate the view all the way around the sand table
四个部位的名牌依次亮；等高线显示山地最高、河口最低；冲积平原上有 3 处村镇: The name tags of the four zones light up in turn; contour lines show the mountains highest and the river mouth lowest; there are 3 towns on the alluvial plains
整块沙盘是一条 40 km 长的河，从山地一直流到海。: The whole sand table is a 40 km river flowing from the mountains to the sea.
四个部位从上游到下游排开：山区河谷 → 山前冲积扇 → 曲流与河漫滩 → 河口三: The four zones run from upstream to downstream: mountain valley → piedmont alluvial fan → meanders and floodplain → river-mouth delta.
村镇都落在冲积平原上、洪水淹不到的地方（教材 p.37）。: The towns all sit on alluvial plains, out of reach of floods (textbook p.37).
去掉这一刻：不知道三种冲积平原各在哪一段，后面三步会把顺序记反。: Without this moment: students won't know where along the river each of the three alluvial plains lies, and will get the order of the next three steps backwards.
考点：三种冲积平原的位置与形成条件。: Exam points: locations and formation conditions of the three kinds of alluvial plain.
河流是塑造地表形态的重要外力：它一路侵蚀、搬运、堆积，把河谷加深、拓宽、延长，还: Rivers are a major external force shaping the land surface: as they erode, transport and deposit, they deepen, widen and lengthen their valleys, and build three kinds of alluvial plain: at the mountain front, along the middle and lower reaches, and at the mouth.
为什么山里的河谷又深又窄，还是个 V 形？: Why are mountain valleys deep, narrow and V-shaped?
把演化阶段拖回幼年期，看山区河谷的流速和它能搬动多大的石头: Drag the stage back to youth and look at the flow speed in the mountain valley and how big a stone it can move
流速 3.38 m/s；能搬动 152.0 mm 的卵石；冲淤判据＝「以向下侵蚀: Flow speed 3.38 m/s; can move 152.0 mm cobbles; erosion/deposition test = “mainly downcutting”
落差大 + 流速快 → 下蚀、溯源侵蚀: Big drop + fast flow → downcutting, headward erosion
幼年期纵剖面最陡（落差 145 m）: Youth stage has the steepest long profile (145 m drop)
V 形：深而窄、谷壁陡峭: V-shaped: deep and narrow, steep valley walls
幼年期河道纵剖面最陡，河床落差 145 m（示意）。: In the youth stage the channel's long profile is steepest, with a 145 m drop in the riverbed (schematic).
流速 3.38 m/s 时能搬动 152.0 mm 的卵石——水流是有力的。: At a flow speed of 3.38 m/s it can move 152.0 mm cobbles; the water is powerful.
「能搬动多大的颗粒」比单看流速更直观地说明搬运能力。: “How big a particle it can move” shows carrying capacity more directly than flow speed alone.
去掉这一步：会把 V 形谷当成「河水冲出来的浅沟」，不知道它以下蚀为主、也不知道: Without this step: students see a V-shaped valley as “a shallow ditch the water carved,” not knowing it's mainly downcutting or that valleys lengthen upstream.
考点：V 形谷 = 落差大、流速快 → 向下和向源头侵蚀为主。: Exam points: V-shaped valley = big drop, fast flow → mainly downward and headward erosion.
幼年期落差大、流速快、能量集中，侵蚀以向下和向源头为主，河谷不断加深、延长，所以: In the youth stage, the drop is big, the flow fast and the energy concentrated, so erosion is mainly downward and headward; the valley keeps deepening and lengthening, so it's deep and narrow with steep walls and a V-shaped cross-section (the valley head on the cut block retreats upstream stage by stage; that's headward erosion).
河谷后来怎样变宽变浅？: How does the valley later get wider and shallower?
把演化阶段从幼年期拖到老年期，看河谷切块的前切面: Drag the stage from youth to old age and look at the front face of the valley cut block
宽深比 10.0 → 60.0 → 200.0；剖面由窄深的 V 形变成宽而浅的: Width-to-depth ratio 10.0 → 60.0 → 200.0; the cross-section goes from a narrow, deep V to a wide, shallow trough
宽深比 = 谷宽 ÷ 谷深：10 → 60 → 200: Width-to-depth ratio = valley width ÷ valley depth: 10 → 60 → 200
切块取自山区河谷，对照教材图 2.27 a/b/c: Cut block taken from the mountain valley; compare with textbook Fig. 2.27 a/b/c
灰虚线：其余阶段的轮廓: Gray dashed lines: outlines of the other stages
宽深比是「谷宽 ÷ 谷深」：10 是 V 形谷，200 是宽而浅的槽形。: The width-to-depth ratio is “valley width ÷ valley depth”: 10 is a V-shaped valley, 200 is a wide, shallow trough.
剖面里能看到谷壁由陡变缓、谷底由窄槽变成宽平底；灰色虚线是其余阶段的轮廓，可直接: In the cross-section, the valley walls go from steep to gentle and the floor from a narrow slot to a wide flat bottom; the gray dashed lines are the other stages' outlines for direct comparison.
剖面同时露出地层，说明河谷是「切」进原来地面的。: The cross-section also exposes rock layers, showing the valley is “cut” into the original ground.
去掉这一步：只知道河谷「变宽」，说不出宽深比这个可量的判据，也不会把 V 形和槽: Without this step: students only know the valley “gets wider,” can't name the width-to-depth ratio as a measurable test, and can't match V-shape with trough.
考点：河谷横剖面由 V 形向槽形演化（本章要点 8）。: Exam points: a valley's cross-section evolves from V-shaped to trough-shaped (chapter key point 8).
落差减小以后，向下侵蚀减弱、向两岸侵蚀加强，河谷不断拓宽；经漫长过程，横剖面变成: As the drop decreases, downcutting weakens and lateral erosion strengthens, so the valley keeps widening; over a long time the cross-section becomes a wide, shallow trough.
水一出山，为什么先把大石头放下？: Why does the water drop the big stones first once it leaves the mountains?
把观察河段从山区拖到出山口，看流速和能搬动的最大粒径: Drag the observed reach from the mountains to the mountain mouth and watch the flow speed and the largest particle it can move
流速 2.90 → 1.45 m/s；能搬动的最大粒径 106.3 → 25.7: Flow speed 2.90 → 1.45 m/s; largest movable particle 106.3 → 25.7 mm; erosion/deposition test = “carrying capacity falls · deposition begins”
出山口：坡度骤减 → 流速减慢 → 粗颗粒卸下: Mountain mouth: slope drops sharply → flow slows → coarse particles unloaded
扇顶 63.3 mm 比扇缘 25.7 mm 粗: Fan apex 63.3 mm coarser than fan edge 25.7 mm
搬不动才堆: Dropped when it can't be carried
判据是「本段搬得动的最大粒径明显小于上游」——上游送来的粗颗粒在这里搬不动了。: The test is “the largest particle this reach can move is clearly smaller than upstream”: the coarse particles brought from upstream can no longer be carried here.
扇顶（63.3 mm）比扇缘（25.7 mm）粗，说明粗颗粒先落地。: The fan apex (63.3 mm) is coarser than the fan edge (25.7 mm), showing coarse particles settle first.
冲积扇是扇状堆积体，不是河谷。: An alluvial fan is a fan-shaped deposit, not a valley.
去掉这一步：会以为「流速小就堆」，说不出「搬不动才堆」这个因果。: Without this step: students think “slow flow means deposition” and can't state the cause: “deposited because it can't be carried.”
考点：冲积扇的形成条件（出山口、坡度骤减、流速减慢）。: Exam points: conditions for an alluvial fan to form (mountain mouth, sharp drop in slope, slower flow).
河流流出山区进入平原，地势趋于平缓、河道开阔、流速减慢，搬运的物质逐渐在山前沉积: When a river leaves the mountains and enters the plain, the land flattens, the channel opens up and the flow slows, so the material it carries gradually settles at the mountain front in a fan shape; when the fans of several rivers grow and merge, they form a broad piedmont alluvial plain.
河道弯了以后，冲和淤各在哪一岸？: Once the channel bends, which bank is eroded and which builds up?
把演化阶段从幼年期拖回壮年期，让河道弯起来: Drag the stage from youth back to maturity and let the channel bend
弯道附加系数 0.313；凹岸流速 1.09 m/s、凸岸 0.57 m/s；冲: Bend factor 0.313; concave bank flow speed 1.09 m/s, convex bank 0.57 m/s; erosion/deposition test = “concave bank erodes · convex bank builds up”
凹岸（外侧）v 1.09 · 凸岸（内侧）v 0.57 m/s: Concave bank (outer) v 1.09 · convex bank (inner) v 0.57 m/s
弯道外侧流速快 → 侵蚀；内侧流速慢 → 堆积: Faster flow on the outside of the bend → erosion; slower flow inside → deposition
凹岸＝弯道外侧: Concave bank = outside of the bend
凸岸＝弯道内侧: Convex bank = inside of the bend
凹岸是弯道外侧，凸岸是弯道内侧，不是「左岸右岸」。: The concave bank is the outside of the bend and the convex bank the inside, not “left bank, right bank.”
两岸流速差 1.09 : 0.57 就是冲淤差异的来源。: The 1.09 : 0.57 difference in flow speed between the banks is where the erosion/deposition difference comes from.
长江镇江段南岸是凸岸（堆）、北岸是凹岸（冲），所以岸线向北推移。: At Zhenjiang the Yangtze's south bank is convex (building up) and its north bank concave (eroding), so the bank line shifts north.
去掉这一步：只会背「凹岸侵蚀凸岸堆积」，一遇到真实河流就分不清哪一岸是凹岸。: Without this step: students only memorize “concave bank erodes, convex bank builds up,” and can't tell which bank is concave on a real river.
考点：凹岸侵蚀、凸岸堆积与岸线推移方向。: Exam points: concave-bank erosion, convex-bank deposition and the direction the bank line shifts.
河道弯曲后，凹岸（弯道外侧）水流快、受冲刷侵蚀、岸线后退；凸岸（弯道内侧）水流慢: Once the channel bends, the concave bank (outside of the bend) has fast water, is scoured and eroded, and retreats; the convex bank (inside of the bend) has slow water, collects sediment and builds out; so the channel bends more and the valley widens.
洪水退去以后，河边留下什么？: What's left beside the river after a flood goes down?
打开汛期，看水面漫上河漫滩: Turn on flood season and watch the water spill onto the floodplain
流速 0.83 → 1.05 m/s；水面漫上河漫滩；冲淤判据仍是「凹岸侵蚀 ·: Flow speed 0.83 → 1.05 m/s; water spills onto the floodplain; the erosion/deposition test is still “concave bank erodes · convex bank builds up”
凸岸堆积 → 枯水露出 → 洪水再淤: Convex bank builds up → exposed at low water → silted again by floods
河漫滩平原是冲积平原的主体: Floodplain plains are the main type of alluvial plain
沿河呈带状分布: Found in strips along the river
河漫滩是「凸岸堆积体露出水面」的结果，不是流水冲出来的。: A floodplain is “convex-bank deposits exposed above water,” not something carved by flowing water.
汛期来水量 × 1.8，流速 1.05 m/s、能搬动 11.9 mm，比平水期: In flood season inflow is × 1.8, flow speed 1.05 m/s, able to move 11.9 mm, stronger than at normal water, but the floodplain is still mainly depositional.
河漫滩平原是冲积平原的主体，沿河呈带状分布。: Floodplain plains are the main type of alluvial plain, found in strips along the river.
去掉这一步：会把河漫滩当成河道的一部分，不知道它是一次次洪水淤出来的。: Without this step: students see the floodplain as part of the channel, not knowing it was silted up flood after flood.
考点：河漫滩与河漫滩平原的形成（凸岸堆积 → 枯水露出 → 洪水再淤）。: Exam points: how floodplains and floodplain plains form (convex-bank deposition → exposed at low water → silted again by floods).
凸岸堆积成水下堆积体，升高扩大后在枯水季节露出水面成为河漫滩；洪水季节被淹没继续: Convex-bank deposition builds an underwater deposit that rises and grows until it's exposed in the dry season as a floodplain; in flood season it's submerged and keeps collecting sediment; many abandoned floodplains joined together make a broad floodplain plain.

On entry the switch is open, R = 10.0 Ω (unbalanced), R₁ = 0.0 Ω: after closing, the bulbs are clearly different. Balance at R = 6.0 Ω (= coil B's R_L) → branch current difference 0.000 A, bulbs equally bright; with R₁ = 3.0 Ω both reach 0.2500 A (rated 0.25 A). At the instant of closing: A₂ jumps to 0.2857 A (1.1429× A₁'s steady value, then falls back to 0.2500 A, about 30 % brighter than steady), A₁'s brightness ratio is still 0.00, E_L = −5.1429 V; t = 1τ = 0.0972 s: ratio 0.40, E_L = −1.8920 V; 3τ = 0.2917 s: 0.90 / −0.2560 V; 5τ = 0.4861 s: 0.99 / −0.0347 V.
The self-induced emf opposes (not prevents) the rise in current: the coil current grows slowly from 0 to the steady I∞ = 0.2500 A (τ = 0.0972 s, extension); the A₂ branch has no coil, so it lights at once and even overshoots. In steady state di/dt = 0 and E_L = 0, leaving only the coil's DC resistance of 6.0 Ω. So “both bulbs equally bright” means R = R_L, and “both glow normally” means R₁ = 3.0 Ω.

Furnaces and induction cookers want exactly this heat. To reduce it there are two ways: raise the resistivity (silicon steel), and stack mutually insulated silicon-steel sheets (cutting the eddy-current loops so each sheet's loop is smaller).

② 金属越活泼、还原性越强，它的正离子越难得电子，就越难被还原——方法不是背的，: ② The more reactive the metal and the stronger its reducing power, the harder its cation gains electrons and the harder it is to reduce. The method isn't memorized; it follows from the reactivity series.

④ 去掉这一步：学生只会背「铝用电解法」，说不出凭什么。: ④ Without this step, students just memorize “aluminum is made by electrolysis” and can't say why.

④ 去掉这一步：学生会以为「铝只是更贵一点」，不知道它根本不在同一条还原路线上。: ④ Without this step, students think “aluminum is just a bit more expensive” and miss that it isn't on the same reduction route at all.

② 冰晶石（Na₃AlF₆，熔点 1012 ℃）把氧化铝溶进去，混合熔体温度降到: ② Cryolite (Na₃AlF₆, mp 1012 ℃) dissolves the alumina, bringing the mixed melt below about 1000 ℃; industry actually runs at 940–980 ℃.

冰晶石与氟化铝配比按电解质初晶温度调整，别让过热度过大: Adjust the cryolite-to-AlF₃ ratio to the electrolyte's liquidus temperature so superheat doesn't get too large
定期检查阳极与侧壁，发现结壳变薄就安排检修: Inspect anodes and sidewalls regularly; schedule repairs when the ledge thins
记住这条链：槽温越高 → 槽电压越低但过热度越大 → 边部结壳化掉 → 槽衬蚀穿: Remember this chain: higher cell temperature → lower cell voltage but more superheat → side ledge melts → lining eroded through and leaks. Save power by lowering cell voltage, not by running hot.
本课目标：搞清「为什么铝只能电解」和「电耗的账怎么算」，最后在温度带里把吨铝电耗: Lesson goal: understand “why aluminum can only be electrolyzed” and “how the power bill adds up”, then keep energy below 13 100 and output above 2.30 within the temperature band for 15 seconds.
电解熔融氧化铝时，阴极和阳极的产物分别是: In the electrolysis of molten alumina, the cathode and anode products are
阴极（接电源负极）Al³⁺ + 3e⁻ → Al；阳极（接正极）2O²⁻ − 4: Cathode (to the negative terminal) Al³⁺ + 3e⁻ → Al; anode (to the positive terminal) 2O²⁻ − 4e⁻ → O₂↑. The O₂ released then burns the carbon anode, but the electrode product itself is O₂.
冰晶石在电解炼铝中的作用是: In aluminum electrolysis, cryolite acts as
催化剂，加快铝离子得电子: A catalyst that speeds Al³⁺ gaining electrons
熔剂，降低氧化铝的熔化温度: A flux that lowers alumina's melting temperature
还原剂，把铝还原出来: A reducing agent that reduces aluminum
燃料，提供反应热: A fuel that supplies reaction heat
冰晶石（Na₃AlF₆，熔点 1012 ℃）是熔剂：把 Al₂O₃ 溶进去，混合: Cryolite (Na₃AlF₆, mp 1012 ℃) is a flux: it dissolves Al₂O₃ and brings the mixed melt below about 1000 ℃ (industry 940–980 ℃). It isn't in the electrode reactions or the overall equation.
工业上不能用焦炭还原氧化铝制铝，主要原因是: Industry can't make aluminum by reducing alumina with coke mainly because
铝比碳活泼，碳在工业可行温度下还原不了 Al₂O₃: Aluminum is more reactive than carbon; carbon can't reduce Al₂O₃ at industrially feasible temperatures
焦炭会与铝生成合金: Coke forms an alloy with aluminum
按金属活动性顺序铝在碳之前，铝的还原性比碳强；把方向倒过来（用铁还原氧化铝）Δr: In the reactivity series aluminum comes before carbon, so aluminum is the stronger reducing agent; reversing the direction (reducing alumina with iron) has ΔrG° = +840.1 kJ·mol⁻¹ > 0, also not spontaneous. So only molten-salt electrolysis works.
其他条件不变，把系列电流从 300 kA 加到 400 kA，单槽日产铝和吨铝电: With everything else fixed, raising potline current from 300 kA to 400 kA changes output per cell and energy per tonne how
产量升、吨铝电耗不变: Output up, energy per tonne unchanged
产量升约 4/3、吨铝电耗也升一点: Output up about 4/3, energy per tonne up slightly too
产量升、吨铝电耗降: Output up, energy per tonne down
产量不变、吨铝电耗升: Output unchanged, energy per tonne up
产量与电流成正比（2.30 → 3.06 t/d）；但母线、导杆与熔体的欧姆压降: Output is proportional to current (2.30 → 3.06 t/d), but the ohmic drop across busbars, rods and melt grows with current: cell voltage 4.100 → 4.180 V, so energy per tonne actually rises a little, 12 861 → 13 112 kW·h/t.
铝热反应 2Al + Fe₂O₃ → Al₂O₃ + 2Fe 中，铝: In the thermite reaction 2Al + Fe₂O₃ → Al₂O₃ + 2Fe, aluminum is
铝由 0 价升到 +3 价，失电子、被氧化，做还原剂；铁由 +3 降到 0 价，: Aluminum goes from 0 to +3, loses electrons and is oxidized, so it's the reducing agent; iron goes from +3 to 0 and is reduced. Thermite releases 851.5 kJ·mol⁻¹ and can weld rails and smelt refractory metals.
电解熔融 NaCl 与电解 NaCl 水溶液，阴极产物分别是: The cathode products of electrolyzing molten NaCl and aqueous NaCl are, respectively
熔融得 Na、水溶液得 H₂: Molten gives Na, solution gives H₂
熔融得 H₂、水溶液得 Na: Molten gives H₂, solution gives Na
熔融 NaCl 里只有 Na⁺ 和 Cl⁻，阴极 Na⁺ + e⁻ → Na；水: Molten NaCl contains only Na⁺ and Cl⁻, so at the cathode Na⁺ + e⁻ → Na; in solution H₂O gains electrons more easily than Na⁺, so the cathode releases H₂ and forms NaOH. That's exactly why the word “molten” matters.
槽温从 955 ℃ 降到 940 ℃，吨铝电耗为什么反而升高: Why does energy per tonne actually rise when cell temperature drops from 955 ℃ to 940 ℃
因为熔体变黏、电阻变大，槽电压从 4.100 V 升到 4.280 V: Because the melt thickens and resistance rises, so cell voltage goes from 4.100 V to 4.280 V
W = 2980·U/η，槽温降到 940 ℃ 时 Al₂O₃ 溶不动、熔体电阻: W = 2980·U/η. At 940 ℃ Al₂O₃ dissolves poorly and melt resistance rises, so cell voltage goes 4.100 → 4.245 V; although current efficiency rises to 96.8 %, energy still goes up from 12 861 to 13 068 kW·h/t.
为什么「槽温越低越省电」这个说法不对: Why is “the cooler the cell, the more power it saves” wrong
因为低温时产量会掉到零: Because output drops to zero at low temperature
因为降温让槽电压升高、电耗先撞 13 100 线，而升温又让电流效率掉、产量不够: Because cooling raises cell voltage so energy hits the 13 100 line first, while heating cuts current efficiency and output falls short
因为低温时冰晶石会分解: Because cryolite decomposes at low temperature
因为低温时阳极不导电: Because the anode stops conducting at low temperature
两头的账都要算：降到 930 ℃ 电耗 13 441 kW·h/t（熔体变黏），: Both ends must be counted: at 930 ℃ energy is 13 441 kW·h/t (thick melt); at 990 ℃ current efficiency is only 0.908 and energy 13 111; both exceed 13 100. The feasible region is just the narrow band of 950–965 ℃ and 305–400 kA.

桌上这四摊东西，哪一摊在把硫「往上抬」、哪一摊在把它「往下压」？: Of the four setups on the bench, which one is “lifting” sulfur up, and which one is “pushing” it down?

H₂SO₄ + copper coil), an alcohol lamp below, a delivery tube leading into three receiving tubes side by side, plugged with cotton; ③ two test tubes with 1 mL Na₂S solution each + two droppers; ④ the oxidation-state window above the back of the bench. Main reading 100.0 % (magenta still red, not yet heated)
常温 → 加热 · 导管通入检验管 · 棉团吸收尾气: Room temp → heating · gas fed into test tubes · cotton absorbs exhaust
从左到右就是三件事：① 硫往下走（0 → −2）、② 硫往上走（+6 → +4）: Left to right it's three things: ① sulfur goes down (0 → −2), ② sulfur goes up (+6 → +4), ③ both ends meet in the middle (−2 and +4 → 0).
主站是 ②：一条导管把「发生」和「检验」连起来，气体是同一股；三支接收管同高并排: The main station is ②: one delivery tube links “generation” and “testing”, so it's the same gas stream; the three receiving tubes sit side by side at the same height for direct comparison.
品红、石蕊、KMnO₄ 对同一股 SO₂ 的反应各不相同 —— 第 6 步会把三: Magenta, litmus and KMnO₄ each respond differently to the same SO₂ — Step 6 compares all three tubes at once.
去掉这一步：学生不知道自己在看哪一摊，后面每换一个开关都对不上位置。: Skip this step and students don't know which setup they're looking at, so later switches can't be matched to a location.
常考：含硫物质的价态与类别（H₂S / S / SO₂ / H₂SO₄）一一对应: Common: matching sulfur compounds' oxidation states to their classes (H₂S / S / SO₂ / H₂SO₄).
这就是必修第二册第五章第一节 + 实验活动5 的四个实验，摆在同一张台面上：一个: These are the four experiments of Required Vol. 2, Ch. 5, Sec. 1 + Lab Activity 5 on one bench: one for sulfur and iron, one for conc. H₂SO₄, one for the three SO₂ tests, one for −2 and +4 comproportionating to 0.
把烧红的玻璃棒往粉末条一端一触，为什么整条都红了？: Touch one end of the powder strip with a red-hot glass rod: why does the whole strip glow?
把玻璃棒烧红，触到粉末条的一端（起始没加热）: Heat the glass rod red and touch one end of the powder strip (starts unheated)
玻璃棒烧红后触到粉末条的一端：红热从触及处向外蔓延，慢慢整条都红热；冷却后得到黑: The red-hot glass rod touches one end of the strip: the glow spreads outward from that point until the whole strip is red-hot; after cooling a black solid remains. S drops from 0 to −2 (gains 2 electrons); main reading stays 100.0 % (magenta unchanged)
灼热玻璃棒触及一端 · 硫粉 0.5 g + 铁粉 1.0 g: Hot glass rod touches one end · sulfur 0.5 g + iron 1.0 g
铁粉与硫粉按 1.0 g : 0.5 g 混，是为了让铁过量、硫用完（教材用量）: Iron and sulfur are mixed 1.0 g : 0.5 g so iron is in excess and sulfur is used up (textbook amounts).
红热一旦起来就能自己蔓延：反应放热，产物的温度足以点燃邻近的粉末。: Once the glow starts it spreads by itself: the reaction is exothermic, and the hot product ignites the neighboring powder.
「红热」说明这一步放热，与它「S 被还原」并不矛盾 —— 放热放的是能量，得失的: “Glowing red” shows the step releases heat, which doesn't contradict “S is reduced” — heat is energy released; reduction is about electrons (each S gains 2).
去掉这一步：学生只记得「硫是黄色的」，不知道硫也能当氧化剂把铁氧化成 FeS。: Skip this step and students only remember “sulfur is yellow”, not that sulfur can act as an oxidizer and oxidize iron to FeS.
高频：硫与变价金属反应（Fe 只到 +2，生成 FeS）；硫在这类反应里作氧化剂: Frequent: sulfur with metals of variable valence (Fe only reaches +2, forming FeS); sulfur acts as the oxidizer in these reactions.
硫与铁直接化合生成硫化亚铁：S 由 0 降到 −2、Fe 由 0 升到 +2，所: Sulfur and iron combine directly to form iron(II) sulfide: S drops from 0 to −2 and Fe rises from 0 to +2, so here sulfur is the oxidizer and iron the reducer. Textbook: “Sulfur is fairly reactive chemically and reacts with many metals and nonmetals.”
一样是硫酸，为什么这一支能冒出气体、还能把品红漂白？: It's sulfuric acid either way, so why does this tube give off a gas that can bleach magenta?
酒精灯已经点着：把通入的 SO₂ 从 0 拖到 10、20、30 mL，盯住品红: The alcohol lamp is lit: drag the SO₂ added from 0 to 10, 20, 30 mL and watch the magenta and both readings
通 0 → 5 → 10 → 30 mL：颜色残留 100.0 → 50.0 →: Adding 0 → 5 → 10 → 30 mL: color remaining 100.0 → 50.0 → 0.0 → 0.0 %, volume added 0.0 → 5.0 → 10.0 → 30.0 mL; the delivery tube bubbles steadily and the magenta fades layer by layer to colorless, while the other two tubes get no gas yet. S oxidation state +6 → +4
加热 · 浓硫酸 2 mL + 螺旋铜丝 · 棉团吸收: Heating · 2 mL conc. H₂SO₄ + copper coil · cotton absorption
这里出来的气体是 SO₂，不是氢气 —— 浓硫酸与金属反应不放氢气（放氢气要用稀: The gas here is SO₂, not hydrogen — conc. H₂SO₄ doesn't release hydrogen with metals (that needs dilute H₂SO₄).
品红 10.0 mL 就褪完，再通到 30.0 mL 也不会更白：褪色有上限，颜: Magenta is fully bleached at 10.0 mL; going to 30.0 mL makes it no whiter: bleaching has a limit, and color remaining stays at 0.0 %.
浓硫酸与铜的反应里只有一半的硫酸被还原（另一半起酸的作用生成 CuSO₄），所以: Only half the H₂SO₄ is reduced in the reaction with copper (the other half acts as an acid, forming CuSO₄), which is why H₂SO₄ has a coefficient of 2.
去掉这一步：学生会把「酸和金属就出氢气」套到浓硫酸上，也会以为冒出来的是酸雾。: Skip this step and students apply “acid + metal gives hydrogen” to conc. H₂SO₄, or think the gas is acid mist.
高频：浓硫酸与铜的方程式与配平；SO₂ 的漂白现象（品红褪色）。: Frequent: the equation and balancing for conc. H₂SO₄ with copper; SO₂ bleaching (magenta fades).
加热时浓硫酸把铜氧化：一份硫酸被还原成 SO₂（S 由 +6 降到 +4），另一: On heating, conc. H₂SO₄ oxidizes copper: one H₂SO₄ is reduced to SO₂ (S from +6 to +4), the other acts as an acid forming CuSO₄. The SO₂ forms an unstable colorless substance with magenta, so it fades — this is what “conc. H₂SO₄ is strongly oxidizing” means.
一样是「硫酸 + 铜 + 加热」，换成稀的行不行？: Same “sulfuric acid + copper + heat”, but would dilute acid work?
现在锅里是稀硫酸（起始就是稀的）：把酸换成浓硫酸，看品红还褪不褪: The flask now holds dilute H₂SO₄ (starts dilute): switch to conc. H₂SO₄ and see whether magenta still fades
稀硫酸这一侧一点反应都没有：管里不冒泡、颜色残留停在 100.0 %、已通入体积: Nothing happens on the dilute side: no bubbles, color remaining stays at 100.0 %, volume added is 0.0 mL, and the small reading says “Barely reacts”. Switch to conc. H₂SO₄ and it bubbles vigorously at once: color remaining drops to 0.0 %, volume added reaches 20.0 mL, S oxidation state +6 → +4. Turn off the lamp and conc. H₂SO₄ doesn't react either
稀硫酸 + Cu：不反应 | 2H₂SO₄(浓) + Cu =Δ= CuSO₄: Dilute H₂SO₄ + Cu: no reaction  |  2H₂SO₄(conc.) + Cu =Δ= CuSO₄ + SO₂↑ + 2H₂O
浓硫酸 + 加热，两个条件缺一不可: Conc. H₂SO₄ + heat: both conditions required
两个条件缺一不可：浓硫酸 + 加热。少一个就一点气体也没有（关掉酒精灯，浓硫酸同: Both conditions are required: conc. H₂SO₄ + heating. Missing either gives no gas at all (turn off the lamp and conc. H₂SO₄ doesn't react either).
判据是「品红褪不褪、已通入体积是不是 0.0 mL」，不是「有没有气泡」—— 稀: The test is “does magenta fade, is volume added 0.0 mL”, not “are there bubbles” — heated dilute acid gives off steam too.
浓硫酸有很强的氧化性，因为硫在 +6 最高价、还能把别人氧化；稀硫酸里硫酸已经电: Conc. H₂SO₄ is strongly oxidizing because S is at its highest state, +6, and can oxidize other substances; in dilute H₂SO₄ the acid is ionized to SO₄²⁻, which is much weaker as an oxidizer and only reacts with active metals to release hydrogen.
去掉这一步：学生背「酸 + 金属 → 氢气」，考到浓硫酸与铜就写成 H₂。教材思: Skip this step and students memorize “acid + metal → hydrogen” and write H₂ for conc. H₂SO₄ and copper. Question 2 of the textbook's Think and Discuss is exactly about this.
高频：浓硫酸与铜必须「浓 + 加热」；稀硫酸与铜不反应；实验室制氢气为什么用稀硫: Frequent: conc. H₂SO₄ and copper need “conc. + heat”; dilute H₂SO₄ doesn't react with copper; why labs make hydrogen with dilute rather than conc. H₂SO₄.
铜与稀硫酸怎么加热都不反应，只有浓硫酸才把它氧化、放出 SO₂。所以「浓硫酸有强: Copper doesn't react with dilute H₂SO₄ however hot it gets; only conc. H₂SO₄ oxidizes it and releases SO₂. So “conc. H₂SO₄ is strongly oxidizing” comes with conditions: concentrated, and heated.
已经褪成无色的品红，怎么加热一下红颜色又回来了？: Magenta already bleached colorless turns red again when heated. Why?
把已经褪成无色的品红溶液加热（起始未加热）: Heat the magenta solution that has turned colorless (starts unheated)
把褪成无色的品红溶液加热：红色回来了，颜色残留从 0.0 % 回到 100.0: Heat the colorless magenta solution: the red returns, color remaining goes from 0.0 % back to 100.0 %, while volume added is still 10.0 mL (so it's not “no gas was added”); the small reading says “Restored”
SO₂ + 某些有色物质 ⇌ 不稳定的无色物质: SO₂ + certain colored substances ⇌ unstable colorless substances
可逆是 SO₂ 漂白与氯水漂白最大的区别：氯水漂白过的品红，加热不会变回来。: Reversibility is the key difference between SO₂ bleaching and chlorine-water bleaching: magenta bleached by chlorine water doesn't return on heating.
「红色回来」不等于「SO₂ 消失了」：已通入体积还是 10.0 mL，只是那层无: “Red coming back” doesn't mean “SO₂ is gone”: volume added is still 10.0 mL; only the colorless substance has decomposed on heating.
所以工业上用 SO₂ 漂白纸浆、毛、丝，织物的白度会随时间和温度变化 —— 教材: That's why paper pulp, wool and silk bleached with SO₂ change in whiteness over time and with temperature — the textbook says these colorless substances “decompose easily”.
去掉这一步：学生只记住「SO₂ 能使品红褪色」，考到「加热后又变红」就答不出原因: Skip this step and students only remember “SO₂ bleaches magenta” and can't explain why it turns red again on heating.
高频：SO₂ 的漂白性与氯水漂白性的区别（可逆 / 不可逆）；品红褪色后加热复原: Frequent: SO₂ bleaching vs chlorine-water bleaching (reversible / irreversible); bleached magenta restored by heating.
二氧化硫的漂白是与某些有色物质生成不稳定的无色物质，这些无色物质受热容易分解，有: SO₂ bleaches by forming unstable colorless substances with certain colored substances; these decompose easily on heating and the original color returns — so SO₂ bleaching is reversible.
三支检验管与棉团: Three test tubes and the cotton
同一股气体，为什么这管只变红、那管紫色却褪了？管口的棉团又是干什么的？: Same gas, so why does one tube just turn red while another loses its purple? And what is the cotton at the mouth for?

兼顾反应速率、平衡转化率与催化剂的使用温度: it balances reaction rate, equilibrium conversion and the catalyst’s operating temperature

指示剂变色范围必背；「强酸强碱滴定为什么两种指示剂都能用」要能说成「变色点落在突: Indicator ranges must be memorized; for “why both indicators work in a strong acid–strong base titration”, say “the color-change point lies within the jump”.

末读数必须读到 0.01 mL，因为最后差的就是半滴。: The final reading must be read to 0.01 mL, because the last difference is just half a drop.
边滴边摇动锥形瓶，否则局部过量，颜色会提前变。: Swirl the flask while titrating; otherwise local excess makes the color change early.
去掉这一步：学生会以为「滴到 pH 7 就停」，而 pH 其实是一瞬间跳过去的。: Without this step: students think “stop at pH 7”, when the pH actually jumps past it in an instant.
常考「为什么接近终点 pH 会突变」，答的是浓度效应与计量点，不是「酸变强了」。: Common: “why the pH jumps near the end point”: the answer is the concentration effect and the equivalence point, not “the acid got stronger”.
开始时被中和的碱浓度大，加入少量酸对 pH 的影响不大（教材原话），所以只能靠指: At first the base being neutralized is concentrated, so a little acid barely affects the pH (textbook wording). So you must rely on the indicator’s sudden change at the end point, not watch the pH creep toward 7.
半滴到终点: Half a Drop to the End Point
最后这半滴到底改变了什么？: What exactly does this last half drop change?
粗滴先停在 21.00 mL（pH 9.99），再把「半滴微调」拧到 +0.04: Stop coarse titration at 21.00 mL (pH 9.99), then turn the “half-drop fine-tune” to +0.04 and watch the pH jump and the color change
粗滴到 21.00 mL 时 pH 9.99，半滴微调到 +0.04（合计 21: At 21.00 mL of coarse titration the pH is 9.99; after fine-tuning +0.04 (total 21.04 mL) the pH drops to 7.00. The half drop from 21.03 → 21.05 spans 4.77 pH units; phenolphthalein just turns from pink to colorless; jump 4.30–9.70
V(HCl) = 21.04 mL 到达等当点: V(HCl) = 21.04 mL reaches the equivalence point
突跃 4.30–9.70（等当点前后各 0.1 % 的体积）: Jump 4.30–9.70 (volumes 0.1 % either side of the equivalence point)
突跃不是「反应变慢了」，是溶液里 H⁺ 与 OH⁻ 谁过量在一瞬间对调。: The jump isn’t “the reaction slowing down”: it’s the instant H⁺ and OH⁻ swap which one is in excess.
酚酞由粉红变无色就停；再滴下去只会让 V 偏大、c 偏高。: Stop when phenolphthalein turns from pink to colorless; any more only makes V too large and c too high.
判终点要「半分钟内不变色」，因为空气中的 CO₂ 也会慢慢让颜色褪。: The end point needs “no color change within half a minute”, because CO₂ in the air also slowly fades the color.
去掉这一步：学生会把终点当成等当点，忽略指示剂变色点与 pH 7 之间那一点差。: Without this step: students treat the end point as the equivalence point, ignoring the small gap between the indicator’s change point and pH 7.
半滴的差别、终点与等当点的区别、为什么不看 pH 到 7 就停，三问常一起考。: The half-drop difference, end point vs. equivalence point, and why you don’t stop by watching the pH reach 7: these three are often tested together.
接近终点时极少量酸就引起 pH 突变，指示剂颜色突变表示反应已完全（教材原话）；: Near the end point a tiny amount of acid makes the pH jump, and a sudden indicator color change shows the reaction is complete (textbook wording). Within half a drop, 0.02 mL, the pH crosses phenolphthalein’s whole range, so the end point is “pink just turns colorless and stays so for half a minute”.
A4.3、A4.9、A3.2、B2.1 算子 8 + D2: A4.3, A4.9, A3.2, B2.1 operator 8 + D2
21.04 mL 这个数怎么变成浓度？: How does 21.04 mL become a concentration?
点一下滴定管，把末读数读出来: Click the burette to read the final reading
Initial reading 0.00 mL, final reading 21.04 mL, so V(HCl) = 21.04 mL; c(NaOH) = 0.1000 × 21.04 ÷ 20.00 = 0.1052 mol/L
V(HCl) 是末读数减初读数；本课把初读数调到 0.00，但这一步仍要写出来。: V(HCl) is the final reading minus the initial reading; this lesson sets the initial reading to 0.00, but you should still write the step out.
分母是量取的 20.00 mL，不是锥形瓶里混合后的总体积。: The denominator is the 20.00 mL measured out, not the total volume mixed in the flask.
三次滴定取平均值，误差明显偏大的数据要重做（教材方法导引）。: Average three titrations; redo any run with a clearly larger error (textbook method guide).
去掉这一步：知道用了多少却算不出多浓，滴定就白做了。: Without this step: you know how much you used but can’t work out the concentration, and the titration is wasted.
计算式与代入是必考：V 指滴定管读数差、分母是待测液体积，两者别混。: The formula and substitution are always tested: V is the burette reading difference and the denominator is the sample volume; don’t mix them up.
由 1 : 1 的计量关系算出待测浓度；教材例题用同一个算式把 27.84 mL: Calculate the sample concentration from the 1 : 1 stoichiometry; the textbook example puts 27.84 mL and 25.00 mL into the same formula to get 0.1149 mol/L.
箱子里最后一个 OH⁻ 是被谁带走的？: What took away the last OH⁻ in the box?
起点箱里 105 个 OH⁻、没有 H⁺；滴到等当点时最后一个 OH⁻ 与刚进来: At the start the box has 105 OH⁻ and no H⁺; at the equivalence point the last OH⁻ combines with an incoming H⁺ to form H₂O, leaving neither; any more and only H⁺ remains (magnified schematic, viewing the conical flask)
示意放大 · 1 个粒子 = 0.02 mmol · 正在看：锥形瓶: Magnified schematic · 1 particle = 0.02 mmol · Viewing: conical flask
每滴入 1 个 H⁺ 就消耗 1 个 OH⁻，所以计量关系是「物质的量 1 :: Each H⁺ added uses up one OH⁻, so the stoichiometry is “1 : 1 in moles”, not “equal concentrations”.
等当点两侧不会同时剩下 H⁺ 和 OH⁻，因为中和几乎进行到底。: H⁺ and OH⁻ are never both left over around the equivalence point, because neutralization goes almost to completion.
指示剂变色的原因也是离子数目的相对变化（教材资料卡片的解释）。: The indicator changes color because of the relative change in ion numbers too (as the textbook’s info card explains).
去掉这一步：学生只会背「半滴变色」，说不出半滴为什么足够。: Without this step: students only recite “half a drop changes the color” and can’t say why half a drop is enough.
微观解释题：为什么是 1 : 1、为什么恰好完全反应时呈中性、指示剂为什么在突跃: Microscopic explanation questions: why it’s 1 : 1, why it’s neutral at exact completion, why the indicator changes within the jump.
滴定的实质是 H⁺ + OH⁻ = H₂O：等当点 n(H⁺) = n(OH⁻): Titration is essentially H⁺ + OH⁻ = H₂O: at the equivalence point n(H⁺) = n(OH⁻) and the solution is neutral (pH 7.00); the indicator changes color because the pH crosses its range at that instant.
四个「小疏忽」，各让结果偏哪边？: Four “small slips”: which way does each push the result?
把「润洗」关掉（错误操作），看算出的浓度怎么变；再把气泡、读数方式（三档）、锥形: Turn “rinsing” off (wrong procedure) and watch how the calculated concentration changes; then flip the bubble, reading method (three settings) and conical flask switches one at a time
四个开关逐个拨，各偏一边：未润洗 → 读数 21.46 mL（偏大 0.42）→: Flip the four switches one at a time; each pushes one way: not rinsed → reading 21.46 mL (0.42 too large) → c 0.1073 (0.0021 too high); tip bubble → 0.1055 (high); looking up before, down after → 0.1047 (low); looking down before, up after → 0.1057 (high); flask rinsed with sample → 0.1068 (high)
每次只弄错一处，其余保持正确: Only one mistake at a time; everything else stays correct
润洗不到位 → HCl 被稀释 → 要多滴才到终点 → 读数差偏大 → c 偏高: Not properly rinsed → HCl diluted → more needed to reach the end point → reading difference too large → c too high.
尖嘴气泡在滴定中消失 → 读数差大于实际放出的体积 → c 偏高。: Tip bubble disappears during titration → reading difference larger than the volume actually delivered → c too high.
滴前仰视、滴后俯视 → 读数差偏小 → c 偏低 0.1047；反过来滴前俯视、: Looking up before, down after → reading difference too small → c low at 0.1047; the reverse, looking down before, up after → reading difference too large → c high at 0.1057; flask rinsed with sample → more base in the flask → c too high.
去掉这一步：学生把「偏高偏低」当口诀背，遇到两个错误同时出现就判断不出来。: Without this step: students memorize “high/low” as a rhyme and can’t judge when two mistakes happen together.
误差方向几乎每年考：要把「改变了哪个量 → 读数差变大还是变小 → c 偏哪边」: Error direction is tested almost every year: write out the full chain “which quantity changed → reading difference larger or smaller → which way c goes”.
每个错误都是先改变一个量、再把偏差传到 c：润洗不到位（0.1073）、尖嘴气泡: Each mistake first changes one quantity, then carries the error to c: poor rinsing (0.1073), tip bubble (0.1055), flask rinsed with sample (0.1068) and looking down before + up after (0.1057) all make the reading difference or the amount of sample too large → c too high; looking up before + down after (0.1047) makes the reading difference too small → c too low.
A7.1–A7.5、A4.11、B1 越界表 + D4–D7: A7.1–A7.5, A4.11, B1 limit table + D4–D7
考核：按教材实验活动2 完整做一次滴定: Test: do one complete titration following textbook Lab Activity 2
酚酞作指示剂，粗滴到 21.00 mL 再用半滴微调拧到 21.04–21.06: Using phenolphthalein, titrate coarsely to 21.00 mL, then use the half-drop fine-tune to reach 21.04–21.06 mL (pink just turns colorless), so the calculated c falls within 0.1052 ± 0.0002, and hold for 15 seconds; the reading method will be switched wrong partway through
达标横幅「中和滴定达标」；滴定中读数方式被拨成「滴前仰视 · 滴后俯视」（读数差: Target banner “Titration target met”; during titration the reading method is switched to “looking up before · looking down after” (reading difference 0.10 mL short, c falls to 0.1047); switch back to eye level and fine-tune dV
20.00 mL 待测 · 0.1000 mol/L HCl · 2 滴酚酞: 20.00 mL sample · 0.1000 mol/L HCl · 2 drops of phenolphthalein
先看四个开关：润洗、气泡、读数方式、锥形瓶——任一错位，c 就出界。: Check the four switches first: rinsing, bubbles, reading method, flask. If any is wrong, c goes out of range.
V 要落在 21.04–21.06 mL（酚酞已经褪色、且在半滴内），差一滴就超: V must fall within 21.04–21.06 mL (phenolphthalein already faded, within half a drop); one drop off and it’s out of tolerance.
指示剂必须是酚酞（教材指定），终点的判据是颜色不是 pH 读数。: The indicator must be phenolphthalein (as the textbook specifies); the end point is judged by color, not the pH reading.
满分结构：正确操作 + 半滴控速 + 平视读数 + 计量关系算浓度，四件事写全。: Full-mark structure: correct procedure + half-drop rate control + eye-level reading + stoichiometric calculation; write all four.
考核没有新结论：把「润洗 → 赶气泡 → 加酚酞 → 滴到半滴变色 → 平视读数: The test adds no new conclusion: only by handling all five, “rinse → clear bubbles → add phenolphthalein → titrate until half a drop changes the color → read at eye level”, does c fall within 0.1050–0.1054.
B3.1、B2.1 标准值表第 4–5 行 + D6: B3.1, B2.1 standard value table rows 4–5 + D6
课件附加 pH 计 · 教材按指示剂判断终点: pH meter added by the lesson · The textbook judges the end point by indicator
— 本课滴定 · ┄ pH 7 等当点 · ○ 两种指示剂的变色点: — This titration · ┄ pH 7 equivalence point · ○ change points of the two indicators
本班目标：半滴内变色 · c = 0.1052: Shift goal: color change within half a drop · c = 0.1052
Shift goal: phenolphthalein and all four switches correct; titrate coarsely to 21.00 mL, then fine-tune by half drops to 21.04–21.06 mL (faded); c = 0.1052 ± 0.0002, hold for 15 seconds
用 0.1000 mol/L HCl 滴定待测 NaOH 溶液，关于指示剂的选择: When titrating NaOH sample with 0.1000 mol/L HCl, the correct statement about choosing an indicator is
只能用酚酞，甲基橙变色太早: Only phenolphthalein works; methyl orange changes too early
酚酞与甲基橙都能用，因为变色范围都落在突跃内: Both phenolphthalein and methyl orange work, since both ranges lie within the jump
只能用甲基橙，酚酞在碱性溶液里不变色: Only methyl orange works; phenolphthalein doesn’t change in basic solution
强酸强碱滴定不需要指示剂: A strong acid–strong base titration needs no indicator
突跃 4.30–9.70，酚酞 8.2–10.0 与甲基橙 3.1–4.4 都落: The jump is 4.30–9.70; phenolphthalein 8.2–10.0 and methyl orange 3.1–4.4 both lie within it, and their end-point volumes differ by only 0.017 mL. The textbook specifies phenolphthalein for this experiment.
滴定前，酸式滴定管与锥形瓶的处理正确的是: Before titrating, the correct treatment of the acid burette and conical flask is
两支都用蒸馏水润洗 2~3 次: Rinse both with distilled water 2–3 times
滴定管用所要盛装的 HCl 润洗 2~3 次，锥形瓶不润洗、不必干燥: Rinse the burette 2–3 times with the HCl it will hold; don’t rinse the flask, and it needn’t be dry
滴定管与锥形瓶都用待测 NaOH 润洗: Rinse both the burette and the flask with the NaOH sample
锥形瓶必须烘干到完全无水: The flask must be oven-dried until completely free of water
滴定管要用所要盛装的溶液润洗，否则标准液被稀释；锥形瓶里待测液的量已由滴定管量准: The burette must be rinsed with the solution it will hold, or the standard solution is diluted; the amount of sample in the flask is already measured by burette, so rinsing would add more base and make the result high.
滴定管的「0」刻度在上。若滴定前仰视读数、滴定后俯视读数，则读出的体积与真实值相: The burette’s “0” mark is at the top. If you look up when reading before titration and look down after, compared with the true value the volume you read is
滴定管刻度自上而下增大：仰视使读数偏大、俯视使读数偏小，两者相减的读数差偏小，算: Burette marks increase from top to bottom: looking up makes a reading too large, looking down makes it too small, so the difference is too small and the calculated c is too low.
用酚酞作指示剂时，判断到达滴定终点的正确现象是: With phenolphthalein as the indicator, the correct sign that the end point is reached is
溶液由粉红色刚好变为无色，且半分钟内不变色: The solution just turns from pink to colorless and stays so for half a minute
溶液一出现浅粉红就立即停止: Stop as soon as the solution turns faint pink
滴入最后一滴后颜色明显变深: The color clearly deepens after the last drop
教材原话：因加入半滴酸后，溶液颜色从粉红色刚好变为无色，且半分钟内不变色。pH: Textbook wording: after half a drop of acid, the solution just turns from pink to colorless and does not change back within half a minute. pH 7.00 is the equivalence point, which is not the same as the end point.
酸式滴定管未用 HCl 润洗就开始滴定，其他操作都正确，则测得的 c(NaOH): If titration starts without rinsing the acid burette with HCl, and everything else is correct, the measured c(NaOH) is
管内残留水把 HCl 稀释（0.09804 mol/L），要多滴到 21.46: Water left in the burette dilutes the HCl (0.09804 mol/L), so it takes more, 21.46 mL, to reach the end point; the reading difference is too large and the calculated c goes from 0.1052 to 0.1073: too high.
某次滴定初读数 0.00 mL、末读数 21.04 mL，待测 NaOH 取 2: In one titration the initial reading is 0.00 mL and the final reading 21.04 mL, with 20.00 mL of NaOH sample and 0.1000 mol/L HCl. c(NaOH) is
换成酚酞：待测碱里呈红色，终点由粉红变无色: Switched to phenolphthalein: red in the basic sample; at the end point, pink to colorless
换成甲基橙：待测碱里呈黄色，终点由黄变橙: Switched to methyl orange: yellow in the basic sample; at the end point, yellow to orange
已用 HCl 润洗 2~3 次：标准液浓度不再被残留水稀释: Rinsed 2–3 times with HCl: the standard solution is no longer diluted by leftover water
未润洗：管内残留水把 HCl 稀释到 0.09804 mol/L，算出的 c 偏: Not rinsed: water left in the burette dilutes HCl to 0.09804 mol/L, so the calculated c is too high
尖嘴气泡已赶出：读数差 = 实际放出的体积: Tip bubble cleared: reading difference = volume actually delivered
尖嘴有气泡：气泡消失后读数差大于实际放出的体积，c 偏高: Bubble in the tip: once it disappears, the reading difference exceeds the volume actually delivered; c too high
平视凹液面最低处：读数准确: Eye level with the bottom of the meniscus: reading accurate
滴前仰视、滴后俯视：读数差偏小 0.10 mL，算出的 c 偏低: Looking up before, down after: reading difference 0.10 mL too small; calculated c too low
滴前俯视、滴后仰视：读数差偏大 0.10 mL，算出的 c 偏高: Looking down before, up after: reading difference 0.10 mL too large; calculated c too high
锥形瓶干燥、未润洗：瓶里只有量好的 20.00 mL 待测液: Flask dry, not rinsed: it holds only the measured 20.00 mL of sample
锥形瓶用待测液润洗过：瓶壁多出碱，算出的 c 偏高: Flask rinsed with sample: extra base on the walls; calculated c too high
异常：读数方式被拨成「滴前仰视 · 滴后俯视」——c 掉到 0.1047，先改回: Fault: reading method switched to “looking up before · looking down after”. c falls to 0.1047; switch back to eye level first
已回到参考工况：V 0.00 mL · 酚酞 · 四个开关全对: Back to reference conditions: V 0.00 mL · phenolphthalein · all four switches correct
本课目标：把教材实验活动2 的中和滴定走一遍——润洗、赶气泡、加酚酞、滴到半滴变: Lesson goal: work through the titration of textbook Lab Activity 2: rinse, clear bubbles, add phenolphthalein, titrate until half a drop changes the color, read at eye level, and calculate c(NaOH) from the stoichiometry; finally, complete one titration on your own and pass the test.

物质跨膜运输 · 3D 互动课件: Transport Across Cell Membranes · 3D Interactive Lesson
顺浓度 + 要蛋白 → 协助扩散；逆浓度 + 耗能 → 主动运输: With the gradient + needs protein → facilitated diffusion; against the gradient + uses energy → active transport
同一片细胞膜，为什么氧能自己穿过去、葡萄糖要好几个蛋白帮忙、K⁺ 还能逆着浓度往: It's the same cell membrane, so why does oxygen cross on its own, glucose need help from proteins, and K⁺ move in against its concentration gradient?
顺浓度、不要蛋白、不耗能: With the gradient, no protein, no energy
顺浓度、要转运蛋白: With the gradient, needs transport proteins
逆浓度、要载体蛋白、耗 ATP: Against the gradient, needs carrier proteins, uses ATP
大分子走囊泡、靠膜流动性: Macromolecules travel in vesicles, relying on membrane fluidity
一个动物细胞：细胞膜、细胞质、细胞核；细胞内一侧的浓度设为 100: An animal cell: cell membrane, cytoplasm, nucleus; concentration inside the cell is set to 100
磷脂双分子层与转运蛋白，物质的分子从这里过；上方是细胞外: Phospholipid bilayer and transport proteins, where molecules cross; outside the cell is above
膜内陷包住大分子形成囊泡；囊泡与膜融合把大分子放出: The membrane folds in around a macromolecule to form a vesicle; a vesicle fuses with the membrane to release a macromolecule
氧为什么能自己穿过细胞膜？往哪边走又由什么定？: Why can oxygen cross the cell membrane on its own? And what decides which way it goes?
把外界浓度从 120 拖到 0，看氧往哪边走: Drag the outside concentration from 120 to 0 and see which way oxygen moves
外界浓度 120（外面比里面多）时，氧净进入细胞，读数 +5.0（肺泡一侧）；拖: At an outside concentration of 120 (more outside than inside), oxygen moves into the cell, reading +5.0 (the alveolus side); dragged to 0, oxygen moves out instead, reading −25.0 — when the direction reverses, it matches the textbook's scene of carbon dioxide diffusing out of tissue cells; transport proteins and energy supply have no effect on oxygen, whatever their settings
顺浓度梯度 · 不耗能: Down the concentration gradient · no energy
氧和二氧化碳很容易自由地通过细胞膜的磷脂双分子层。: Oxygen and carbon dioxide pass freely and easily through the membrane's phospholipid bilayer.
肺泡一侧氧浓度高，氧扩散进细胞；组织一侧二氧化碳浓度高，二氧化碳扩散出细胞——同: On the alveolus side oxygen concentration is high, so oxygen diffuses into cells; on the tissue side carbon dioxide concentration is high, so it diffuses out of cells — same mechanism, two directions.
甘油、乙醇、苯等脂溶性小分子也走自由扩散。: Small lipid-soluble molecules like glycerol, ethanol and benzene also cross by simple diffusion.
去掉这一步：会以为物质过膜都要蛋白——与协助扩散的分界就丢了。: Skip this step and students assume everything needs a protein to cross — losing the boundary with facilitated diffusion.
判断：自由扩散需要转运蛋白——错。: True or false: simple diffusion needs transport proteins — false.
自由扩散顺浓度梯度进行，不需要转运蛋白、不消耗能量；方向由浓度差决定，两个方向都: Simple diffusion goes down the concentration gradient, needs no transport protein and uses no energy; its direction is set by the concentration difference, and it can go either way.
葡萄糖也是小分子，它能不能自己穿过去？: Glucose is a small molecule too. Can it cross on its own?
把转运蛋白从 10 个拖到 0，看葡萄糖还能不能进: Drag transport proteins from 10 down to 0 and see whether glucose can still get in
转运蛋白拖到 0：葡萄糖净流量从 +6.0 掉到 0.0，分子全挤在膜外进不去；: With transport proteins at 0, glucose net flux drops from +6.0 to 0.0 and the molecules crowd outside the membrane, unable to enter; switch the substance to oxygen and drag concentration to 60, and no protein setting affects oxygen (still −10.0)
细胞膜不是筛子：它对物质的进出有选择（课标 2.1.1 选择透过性）。: The cell membrane isn't a sieve: it's selective about what enters and leaves (curriculum standard 2.1.1, selective permeability).
不带电荷的无机小分子、脂溶性的有机小分子能自由扩散。: Uncharged small inorganic molecules and lipid-soluble small organic molecules can cross by simple diffusion.
离子和葡萄糖、氨基酸这样的小分子有机物必须借助转运蛋白。: Ions and small organic molecules such as glucose and amino acids must use transport proteins.
去掉这一步：会以为小分子都能自由扩散，把葡萄糖归错类。: Skip this step and students assume all small molecules diffuse freely, and misclassify glucose.
配套答案：相对分子质量小的物质或离子都可以通过自由扩散进入细胞内——错（p.72: Answer key: any substance or ion with a small relative molecular mass can enter cells by simple diffusion — false (p. 72 Exercise 1(1)).
细胞膜具有选择透过性：离子和葡萄糖、氨基酸等小分子有机物不能自由通过磷脂双分子层: The cell membrane is selectively permeable: ions and small organic molecules such as glucose and amino acids can't pass freely through the phospholipid bilayer and must use transport proteins.
蛋白多了，葡萄糖就进得快吗？它要不要能量？: With more proteins, does glucose get in faster? Does it need energy?
把转运蛋白从 5 个加到 10 个，比一比净流量: Increase transport proteins from 5 to 10 and compare net flux
同样的浓度差，蛋白从 5 个加到 10 个，净流量从 +3.0 涨到 +6.0；: With the same concentration difference, going from 5 to 10 proteins raises net flux from +3.0 to +6.0; switch the substance to oxygen and the number of proteins has no effect on it
J ∝（外界浓度 − 细胞内浓度）× 转运蛋白数量: J ∝ (outside concentration − inside concentration) × number of transport proteins
协助扩散借助膜上的转运蛋白，顺浓度梯度进行。: Facilitated diffusion uses transport proteins in the membrane and goes down the concentration gradient.
浓度差越大越快；转运蛋白越多也越快（两个系数只为让两条线分得开，不代表葡萄糖真的: A bigger concentration difference is faster; more transport proteins is also faster (the two coefficients just keep the two lines apart; they don't mean glucose is really faster than oxygen).
红细胞吸收葡萄糖就是协助扩散（要蛋白，但不耗能）；这一步也不用能量——关掉供能，: Red blood cells take up glucose by facilitated diffusion (needs protein, no energy); this step uses no energy either — turn off the energy supply and glucose flux doesn't change at all.
去掉这一步：会以为要蛋白就是主动运输，把被动与主动的分界弄反。: Skip this step and students think “needs protein” means active transport, flipping the passive/active boundary.
葡萄糖进入红细胞需要借助转运蛋白，但不消耗能量，属于协助扩散（p.72 练习 2: Glucose enters red blood cells with the help of transport proteins but uses no energy, so it's facilitated diffusion (p. 72 Exercise 2, option C).
协助扩散：借助转运蛋白、顺浓度梯度、不消耗能量；某些物质的运输速率还与转运蛋白的: Facilitated diffusion: uses transport proteins, goes down the concentration gradient, uses no energy; for some substances the rate also depends on the number of transport proteins.
转运蛋白只有一种吗？两种蛋白有什么不一样？: Is there only one kind of transport protein? How do the two kinds differ?
点一下膜上的转运蛋白，看它的形状: Click a transport protein in the membrane and look at its shape
通道蛋白是四根柱子围成的孔，分子穿过时不与它结合；载体蛋白像一把夹子，要先与分子: A channel protein is a pore ringed by four columns, and molecules pass through without binding to it; a carrier protein is like a clamp — it first binds the molecule, then changes its own shape to deliver it to the other side
转运蛋白 = 载体蛋白 + 通道蛋白: Transport proteins = carrier proteins + channel proteins
转运蛋白分载体蛋白和通道蛋白两类。: Transport proteins come in two types: carrier proteins and channel proteins.
载体蛋白只容许与自身结合部位相适应的分子通过，每次转运都要改变构象。: A carrier protein only lets through molecules that fit its binding site, and changes shape with every transfer.
通道蛋白只容许大小和电荷相宜的分子通过，不需要与分子结合；钾离子通道是典型。: A channel protein only lets through molecules of suitable size and charge, without binding them; the potassium channel is a classic example.
去掉这一步：会把「载体」和「通道」当同一个东西，遇到主动运输（要载体）就说不清。: Skip this step and students treat “carrier” and “channel” as the same thing, and can't explain active transport (which needs carriers).
配套答案：载体蛋白和通道蛋白的转运机制一样——错（p.67 练习 1（3））。: Answer key: carrier proteins and channel proteins transport by the same mechanism — false (p. 67 Exercise 1(3)).
转运蛋白分载体蛋白和通道蛋白：载体要与分子结合并改变构象，通道只让大小和电荷相宜: Transport proteins are carrier proteins and channel proteins: carriers bind the molecule and change shape; channels only let molecules of suitable size and charge pass, without binding.
细胞里的 K⁺ 比外面多得多（教材：红细胞内比血浆高 30 倍），为什么还能继续: There's far more K⁺ inside the cell than outside (textbook: 30 times higher in red blood cells than in plasma), so why can it keep taking K⁺ in?
把供能断掉，看 K⁺ 还进不进得去: Cut the energy supply and see whether K⁺ still gets in
有 ATP 时：外界浓度只有 20（远低于细胞内的 100），K⁺ 仍净流入，读: With ATP: outside concentration is only 20 (far below the 100 inside), yet K⁺ still flows in, reading +5.2, mode “Active transport”, energy “Uses ATP”; cut the energy and the reading becomes −0.8, the direction flips to “Out of cell”, and mode and energy switch to “Facilitated diffusion · channel protein” and “None” — the pump has stopped, leaving only leakage through channels
J = 泵（耗 ATP）− 漏（顺浓度）: J = pump (uses ATP) − leak (down the gradient)
逆浓度梯度 · 要载体蛋白 · 耗能: Against the concentration gradient · needs carrier proteins · uses energy
人红细胞内 K⁺ 浓度比血浆高 30 倍、轮藻高 63 倍、甲状腺滤泡上皮细胞的: K⁺ in human red blood cells is 30 times higher than in plasma, 63 times higher in Chara, and iodine in thyroid follicle cells is 20–25 times higher than in blood — all built up against the concentration gradient.
载体蛋白与离子结合后，在能量推动下改变构象，把离子送到另一侧。: After binding an ion, a carrier protein changes shape, driven by energy, and delivers the ion to the other side.
主动运输让细胞按需要吸收、排出废物和有害物质。: Active transport lets cells take in what they need and expel wastes and harmful substances.
去掉这一步：「耗能」就是一句空话，学生不知道能量断了会发生什么。: Skip this step and “uses energy” is just words; students don't know what happens when energy is cut.
配套答案：物质逆浓度梯度跨膜运输时，既要消耗能量，也要借助载体蛋白——对（p.7: Answer key: when substances cross the membrane against the concentration gradient, they need both energy and carrier proteins — true (p. 72 Exercise 1(4)).
主动运输：逆浓度梯度、需要载体蛋白、消耗 ATP。断了能量，泵停，剩下的只是 K: Active transport: against the concentration gradient, needs carrier proteins, uses ATP. Cut the energy and the pump stops; all that's left is K⁺ leaking down the gradient through channels — that's facilitated diffusion, not active transport.
蛋白质这么大，转运蛋白运不了，它怎么进出细胞？: Proteins are so large that transport proteins can't carry them. How do they get in and out of cells?
现在是「大分子（胞吞）」，把物质切到「分泌蛋白（胞吐）」，看方向反过来: It's now “Macromolecule (endocytosis)”; switch the substance to “Secretory protein (exocytosis)” and see the direction reverse
